programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Caféen færdiggøres, men Jan Eriks forretning lider. Steen har problemer med håndværkere. Jens Erik er stadig forelsket i Hanne.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Mercedes hyrer jysk band, Simon sur. Steen hjælper håndværker. Caféen åbner med succes. Steen taler med Natasja, Hanne med Jens Erik. Benedicte truer Hanne.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Steen vil ikke have Charlotte skriver mere om familien. Freja er jaloux på Mercedes, der skaffer Simon job. Hanne stopper som coach, Steen er bekymret. Jan Erik opfordrer Freja til at kæmpe for Simon.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Mercedes hjælper Simon med musikkarriere, har nye forretningsideer. Jan Erik finder ny til natklubben i hemmelighed. Freja tvivler på Simon, taler med andre om det. Jan Erik ser Jens Erik og Hanne mødes.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Freja is upset over Simons kontrakt med Mercedes. Jan Erik instruerer Kevin i at skabe kaos, Kevin presser Jan Erik for penge. Benedicte vil have natklubben lukket. Kevin skaber problemer og charmerer Mercedes. Freja finder graviditetstest hos Charlotte.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Jan Erik is upset over Kevin and Mercedes. Charlotte is gravid og vil have abort. Benedicte og Karl Erik diskuterer Jan Erik. Kevin giver Simon narko. Majse can't få børn.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Simon fejler Kevins opgave. Benedicte er vred på Majse pga. Jan Eriks aftale. Jan Erik får Steen anholdt for narkobesiddelse, plantet af Simon. "2900" lukker, Karl Erik støtter Steen.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Karl Erik sætter Jan Erik på plads. Charlotte og Majse mistænker Jan Erik. Freja konfronterer Hanne og opsøger Simons far, som afslører Simons mørke fortid. Steen løslades, men suspenderes. Jan Erik overtager KE Invest, men glemmer Kevin.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Jan Erik overtager, Gunnar forlader. Simon vender tilbage, mistænkt for narko. Gert elsker Charlotte, hun afviser. Charlotte overvejer abort. Steen deprimeret, afviser Hanne.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Karl Erik hyrer Camilla som vagthund. Charlotte ombestemmer sig ang. abort. Majse møder mystisk dame med barne-profeti. Jan Erik utilfreds med Camillas indblanding. Hanne overbeskytter Steen.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Jens Erik kræver husleje, Simon stjæler. Mercedes jagter Simon, Kevin hjælper. Hanne og Freja skændes. 2900 genåbner, få kunder. Cecilie og Steen mødes. Kevin truer Simon til at spille.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Steen, Hanne skændes om Cecilie, inddrager Jens Erik. Benedicte vinder bildiskussion med Karl Erik. De taler om Jan Erik. Majse lokker Jan Erik til fitness, hvor Steen, Cecilie er. Charlotte dukker op. Steen, Jan Erik bokser.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Camilla og Jan Erik er uvenner. Charlotte bløder og vil have Majse til at adoptere. Simon starter i fitness, Jens Erik er utilfreds. Camilla siger op, Jan Erik bliver vred over adoptionsplanen.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Jeg har ikke nok info om personen til at hjælpe. Jeg er en sprogmodel, jeg kan kommunikere, men min viden er begrænset. Kan jeg hjælpe med noget andet?

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Steen løber, Hanne søger svar. Karl Erik sagsøger Steen, men giver ham og Hanne en rejse. Steen, fornærmet, siger op og starter egen praksis med Camilla. Kevin presser stofmisbrugeren Simon. Kevin og Mercedes flytter sammen.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Jan Erik vil snyde Majse for arv. Camilla og Steen diskuterer fremtiden. Jan Erik afslører graviditet til Gert, som vil mødes med Charlotte. Benedicte og Lars har picnic.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Majse undersøger børnevenligt hjem. Mercedes opdager Simons stofmisbrug og vil hjælpe. Camilla og Steen indretter kontor. Karl Erik og Benedicte overlader KE Invest til Jan Erik. Camilla vil have Steen til at undgå Hanne i en investering.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Hanne og Freja vender hjem, spænding opstår da Hanne ser Camilla. Kevin presses af kreditor. Freja finder Simon, som skylder Kevin penge. Karl Erik strides om Jan Eriks ansættelse. Ejner fortæller om Benedicte og en ung mand. Simon trues af drengene.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Freja er væk, Hanne bekymret. Freja flygter fra forældrenes skænderier. Steen har ikke talt med Hanne om aktieoption. Benedicte og Lars mødes, Lars afslører sandheden. Hanne og Steen skændes voldsomt. Sex er centralt, men ikke altid kærlighedsbaseret.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Hanne opdager Steens investering. Benedicte har været sammen med Lars. Freja er påvirket af stoffer. Blinkenberg overvejer at skifte til Steen og Camilla. Gert informerer Jan Erik om Blinkenbergs planer og har potentiel ammunition mod ham.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Hanne leder efter Freja. Jan Erik vil have Karl Erik til at investere. Gert opfordrer Jan Erik til at snyde. Simon inviterer Steen og Hanne til tv med overraskelse. Mercedes og Jan Erik skændes.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Mercedes viser Jan Erik en optagelse, han bliver nervøs. Steen konfronterer Simon om angrebet. Majse indretter børneværelse, Jan Erik er utilfreds. Simons far opsøger Hanne, de taler om Simon.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Simon er populær, Mercedes og Kevin vil have ham tilbage. Kevin overvejer pres. Jan Erik får Karl Erik til at underskrive. Kevin gør noget uventet. Jeppe taler med Hanne om Lise. Kevin sælger kokain til Freja.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Hanne finder Freja bevidstløs efter narkotika. Mercedes' fest planlægges. Jan Erik chokeres over frieriet. Simon afslører Kevin. Mercedes tvivler, men overhører en samtale.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Freja i koma. Gert vil have barnet, fortæller Charlotte om Jan Eriks modvilje. Majse truer Jan Erik. Thomas og Jens Erik går i byen, ender i fitnesscenter. Simon vil fortælle Mercedes sandheden om Kevin.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Gert har snydt Jan Erik. Karl Erik opdager Gerts konkurs. Freja er i koma, Charlotte hjælper. Kevin opsøger Mercedes, Jan Erik ankommer med pistol. Majse har en idé til at hjælpe familien. Jan Eriks opførsel får konsekvenser.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Jan Erik overlever, men er på hospitalet i 3 måneder. Majse flytter ind hos Hanne og Steen. Kevin dømmes. Freja, Simon og Mercedes hygger, Steen henter Freja. K.E. Invest nær fallit, Benedicte kæmper. Karl Erik sælger fitness.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Karl Erik sælger Benediktes smykker til Sten og lyver for en investor. Simon vil hjælpe Freja, men hun afviser ham. Til Mercedes' fest føler Freja sig overvåget, mens Steen bekymrer sig om hende.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Stens investorer køber wellnesscentret og vil lave det om. Mercedes er jaloux på Simon og Freja. Charlotte beholder barnet, Majse er knust. Gert flytter ind hos Charlotte.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Benedikte bebrejder Hanne og Steen for deres ulykker. Hun og Karl Erik udlejer huset, flytter til kontoret. Mercedes fester, ignorerer Jan Erik. Freja kommer fuld hjem, Steen insisterer på behandling.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Benedikte får udskrevet Jan Erik da hun mener han har været et fjols længe nok. Eiler opsøger Karl Erik og spørger efter sin investering.. Jan Erik opsøger Majse, men hun afviser ham igen. Det ender med Sten smider ham ud.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Freja og Simon er kærester, han flytter ind. Mercedes foreslår fælles lejlighed, Freja afslår. Jan Erik vil vinde Majse tilbage, men afvises. Han sniger sig ind på Frejas værelse. Mercedes flytter hjem til Jan Erik.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Jens Erik er vred på Sten, det går ud over Jan Erik. Mercedes jogger, Jan Erik vil ikke med. Eiler vil se regnskabet, Karl Erik har en plan. Freja sniger sig ud, træt af isolationen med Simon.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Steen søger hjælp til Freja, hun lover at tale med Preben. Jan Erik drømmer om Majse, Mercedes opfordrer ham til at tage sig sammen. Jan Erik og Gert mødes, Jan Erik husker noget fra skudepisoden.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Majse får hjælp til skilsmisse, møder dreng der optager hende. Jan Erik erkender, Majse vil flytte hjem med krav. Karl Erik tilbyder Gert samarbejde, afvist. Gert og Charlotte i blade, alt godt.

programme.desc: The girls were greeted by Twiggy and ANTM: Cycle Seven participant Melrose who taught them the importance of having a memorable name.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Gets Thrown In The Pool

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls met with actress Tia Mowry (The Game) who taught them how to portray different characters through voice and movement.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls were greeted at their house by Cycle 2 participant April, who gave them advice on how to be a correspondent and conduct a good interview.
programme.sub-title: The Girls Who Go Down Under

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: In this special recap episode, never-before-seen footage about the journey of the five remaining contestants is revealed, including a heated argument between two girls and a staged mock elimination by all the girls.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Picks a Fight

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls met with the owner of Priscilla's Model Management, Priscilla Leighton Clark, and Australian model Jodhi Meares, who organized and booked several designers to meet them on Go Sees.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Blames The Taxi Driver

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls met with Aboriginal Elder Uncle Max and his niece Calita, who taught them about the native Australian art of storytelling through dance.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Does Not Want To Dance

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The three remaining models participated in a national photoshoot for Cover Girl's Lipshine Lip Color and a My Life as a CoverGirl commercial.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Becomes America's Next Top Model

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Tyra surprises the girls with a lounge singing performance, and the competition gets tough as strong personalities rise and the catfights begin.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Jay Manuel meets the models and introduces them to their new green form of transportation.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: J. Alexander shocks the girls with a scary lesson on perfecting their runway walk while wearing straightjackets.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Tyra gives the girls a sneak peek at their makeovers at a Beverly Hills salon. Most of the models get dramatic makeovers, but one is driven to the breaking point when she has to cut off all her hair.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Benny Ninja gives the girls a lesson on how to pose with movement. The models must pose in the air while jumping on a trampoline, some girls rise while others flop.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Is Afraid Of Heights

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Male model Tyson Beckford surprises the models at the house and gives them a lesson on being a spokesperson. Most pull off an impromptu sales pitch for their teacher, but a few have a hard time concentrating on their task.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Gets A Mango

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: With the finale only six weeks away, never-before-seen footage includes Bianca’s confrontations with Chantal and Ebony, and Jenah chips her tooth.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Runs Into The Glass Door

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Tyra surprises the girls and gives them an in-depth lesson about how to model in front of a moving camera. One model continues to get jealous and be very critical of her competition.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The models go to FIDM (Fashion Institute of Design and Merchandising) and are paired with a student designer to be their creative muse to design a dress.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Starts To Lose Her Cool

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: When the models arrive in China they are introduced to their new penthouse suite, and one model who is left without a place to sleep becomes very upset.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Challenged by J. Alexander to pose like statues in a park, the models find the task to be a little too realistic as they're swarmed by pigeons, and one competitor suspects another of stealing.

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: After Barney's New York Creative Director Simon Doonan and Twiggy teach the girls about the different British fashion trends, the competitors are sent to impress top London designers by dressing in each trend.
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Takes A Pill

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: With only three models remaining, the girls are first challenged to shoot a CoverGirl commercial and a national print ad, and after one competitor is eliminated, legendary photographer Gilles Bensimon shoots each of the final two girls.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Anthony Bourdain explores the vibrant, dynamic city of Shanghai.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: New Mexico has the largest Hispanic population per capita in the US. No better way to see the mash-up of cultures that make up this uniquely American State, than by what the people here are eating

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony explores Copenhagen, the economic and cultural center of Denmark.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony explores a few of the many faces of Miami. Chef Michelle Bernstein takes Tony out to an authentic Cuban breakfast and a late-night dinner at a gas station café in Doral.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: A country of only six million people where a vast percentage of the land is steaming hot jungle or a huge scrub desert known simply as The Chaco. This is one of the least known nations in the world.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Once Johannesburg was the most dangerous city in the world, but the end of the apartheid has lead to vast changes in the city. Tony visits the Johannesburg suburb of Hillbrow, and discovers the culture and, of course food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: With the slight relaxation of control by the government of Myanmar, Tony is finally able to explore one of the most fabled and beautiful areas of Asia.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Israel, the West Bank and Gaza are three locations Tony has never travelled to before.The intense and fraught relationship between these places is hard to understand but Tony will attempt to delve into the lives of those who live here, through their food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: After eight years, Tony returns to South Korea. And this time, he’s no stranger to kimchi. But just as Tony has changed, so has Korea.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony will explore several regions of Colombia from the mountains down to the Caribbean coast to the coca leaf growing inlands formerly controlled by drug cartels.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony accompanies world-renowned chef and restaurateur Daniel Boulud as they travel back to Daniel’s hometown of Lyon, France for a pilgrimage of the city’s rich food culture and its legendary chefs.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony heads back to his much-beloved Salvador, Brazil. The ever-present street festivals and the famous Carnival parade begin with sitting down with a local artist in the streets of the historic Pelo.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Roy Choi’s food reflects a new American idea of "natural" fusion. Bourdain examines the meeting point of Asian, Mexican, Latino culture in modern LA.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Las Vegas Nevada with his food author friend Michael Ruhlman. Whatever your need, whatever bad behaviour you’d like to display Las Vegas is the place that will allow it... for a price.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Shanghai. Forget the antiquated views you might hold about a communist-run, creativity-devoid State of androids. The modern China is a vibrant, dynamic monument to capitalism.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony explores what Burroughs called "Interzone," where artists sought escape from Western moral prohibitions and the possibilities of great empty spaces. But what is it like now?

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Mexico City and Oaxaca to meet who fight for the food, the art, and the lives they believe in. In the Santa Anita neighbourhood of Mexico City, Tony meets boxer Jorge Lacierva.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony explores a few of the many faces of Miami. Chef Michelle Bernstein takes Tony out to an authentic Cuban breakfast and a late-night dinner at a gas station café in Doral.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Are You The One?: Down The Rabbit Hole
programme.desc: När singlarna släpper loss på fest riskerar svartsjukan att sätta käppar i hjulet för ett par. Frustrationen stiger när huset inser att bara ett av de starka paren skulle kunna vara rätt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: Några gäster kommer med råd och tips om hur man hittar den rätta. Sanningsbåset avslöjar den skiftande dynamiken i huset.
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Stricking Out
programme.desc: Äntligen kan Kamie bekräfta ett par vid Parceremonin. Ett favoritpar får veta sitt öde. Ett annat ångrar sin separation.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Kiss And Tell
programme.desc: Will får sota för att ha bevarat sitt förhållande med Courtney samtidigt som han letade den rätta. Huset visar upp dolda talanger.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Were The One
programme.desc: Efter veckors debatterande om hur de ska hitta den rätta samarbetar nu singlarna i ett riskabelt försök att hitta äkta kärlek.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Tio singeltjejer och tio singelkillar tillbringar en månad ihop och försöker hitta sin perfekta partner. Om de lyckas får de dela på det största priset i MTV:s historia - en miljon dollar.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Temptation of Chris T
programme.desc: Chris T riskerar hela priset på en miljon dollar eftersom han inte kan släppa Shanley, och när Ryans dagböcker försvinner söker han tröst hos Kayla - som i sin tur söker tröst hos Wes.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Real 'G'
programme.desc: Det blir alltmer spänt mellan Jacy och Simone medan de kämpar om Johns gunst. Det tänder till mellan Brittany och Adam när de får åka till boom-boom-rummet , och i utmaningen avslöjar tjejerna pinsamma gamla saker om sig själva.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Karma's a Bitch
programme.desc: Utmaningen består i att killarnas ex avslöjar allt och sen tillbringar kvällen i huset. Brittany verkar inte fatta att Adam helt enkelt inte är intresserad. Coleysia och Ashleigh påbörjar egna romanser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Double Shot
programme.desc: Läget är spänt mellan John och Simone. Kayla blir intresserad av Wes igen, men hon håller ändå kvar vid Ryan. Gänget blir på glatt humör när de får skicka två par till sanningsbåset efter vattenfallstävlingen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Turn The Paige
programme.desc: Alla försöker att klura ut vilket som är nästa perfekta par. Kayla avslöjas när hon spelar ut Ryan mot Wes, och Simone försöker att splittra Chris T och Shanley för gott. Ett besök i sanningsbåset vänder upp-och-ned på huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It's So Hard... To Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Kaos råder i huset efter att Paige och Chris T visar sig vara ett par och de skickas på smekmånad. Shanley är uppriven för att hon och Chris T. skiljs åt. Och Kayla blir hysterisk när Ryan går iväg för att trösta Jessica.
programme.sub-title: It's So Hard... To Say Goodbye

programme.title: Are You The One?: Getting Dumped On
programme.desc: Kayla och Ryan grälar och hela huset vänder sig emot Kayla när hon avslöjar en känslig sak som kan hota Ambers förhållande med Ethan. En slipprig utmaning visar om vissa par klarar av att hänga ihop.

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party
programme.desc: Hela gänget släpper loss och har kul på vita festen, men John måste ta itu med det faktum att Jacy börjar få känslor för Scali. En strandtävling tvingar paren att sanda ner sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.desc: Alla i huset försöker lista ut hur de ska ta tillvara på sina sista chanser att hitta den rätta och vinna en miljon dollar. Jacy tar itu med sina motstridiga känslor för Scali och John och alla i huset försöker nysta ut den sista kärlekstriangeln.
programme.sub-title: Rub Down With A Happy Ending

programme.title: Are You The One?: Are You The One? Special Delivery
programme.desc: Deltagarna i säsong ett återförenas för den största händelsen i Ethans och Ambers liv - en bebis! Upptäck vad som hänt deltagarna medan de tillbringar en vild helg ihop för att fira med en sanslös babyhippa på AYTO-vis.
programme.sub-title: Are You The One? Special Delivery

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Too Many
programme.desc: Tio perfekt ihopparade killar och tjejer blir chockade när de får veta att den här säsongen blir tuffare än de trodde med tillkomsten av en elfte tjej. Paris och Pratt smider planer för att slippa sanningsbåset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Truth Will Cost You
programme.desc: Läget blir spänt när både Layton och Shelby hamnar i kärlekstrianglar. Killarna gräver upp saker om tjejerna i en tävling som kan skicka den elfte tjejen till sanningsbåset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears
programme.desc: När Shelby sätter stopp för sin kärlekstriangel leder det till tårar. John söker kontakt med Christina, men blockeras hela tiden av Brandon, som redan vet att de inte är ett par. Hela huset häpnar över att de har en oskuld i gänget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: Ett hångel på fyllan hotar att stjälpa ett av husets starkaste par. Anthony lägger an på Laytons förälskelse, Jenni. John lägger äntligen in en stöt på Christina. En chockerande parceremoni skakar om hela huset.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Tough as Nails
programme.desc: CJ seeks to disrupt Allen's search for serenity at a storage auction before the guy's head to a live auction to buy and sell. They uncover an unusual Marilyn Monroe statue, an industrial slip n' slide, and a bed of nails.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: To Pawn or Not To Pawn
programme.desc: On the brink of a major decision, Ton and Allen face-off with Carolyn at an auction in Covina. They win a "special effects unit" that contains big machines for crazy stunt work. The guys decide the fate of the shop.
programme.sub-title: To Pawn or Not To Pawn

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Louisiana Purchase
programme.desc: In Louisiana, Ton and Allen encounter some salty locals at a shipping crate auction, and navigate choppy waters at a boat auction. After spending a lot of cash, they find a tactical blast shield and a bass fishing boat.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice
programme.desc: 1978 Williams Disco pinball machine; 1898 dice popper gambling device; talking 1990s bar top breathalyzer; deadly fishing harpoon.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Once a Pawn a Time
programme.desc: Ton and Allen discover that owning a pawn shop is way more trouble than they expected. With bills stacking up, even an antique ammo collection and some classic football helmets may not be enough to put the guys in the black.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rock-et to Me!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen end up in a turf war at a Hollywood auction and at odds with each other over whether to gamble on what could be an antique slot machine. Allen attempts to fly a jetpack.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen vs. Ton
programme.desc: When Ton and Allen find themselves bidding against each other at an auction, the former partners battle it out in an epic showdown that leaves the fate of the pawnshop and their friendship in question.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Off the Deep End
programme.desc: Ton and Allen quarrel over bidding strategy at a rare auction on Catalina Island and must race against the clock to unload a one man submersible that could be worth big money… if they can make it work.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Friends in Hawaii Places
programme.desc: Allen &Ton enlist an assistant, Carolyn, and Allen's Hawaiian buddy, Junior, to help them battle local buyers. The guys find a WWII-era motor scooter and a stash of antique Polynesian tattoo tools that get used on Ton!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Always Money in Philadelphia
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, the guys face a shady bidder with inside information and former NFL star Vince Papale in a battle for a vintage football passing machine and a colonial musket that could be worth huge money if it's real.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: With Ton missing, Allen struggles to keep the pawn shop afloat while training Elle to work an auction. After a fierce bidding war with Caroline, pieces from a century old motorcycle may not be enough to save the day. ed.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Flying Ton, Creeping Allen
programme.desc: When a group of thugs try to bully Ton and Allen out of a Chinatown auction, the guys fight back, leading to a violent showdown and the discovery of both a rare Bornean blowgun and special effects wire harnesses.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Missouri Loves Company
programme.desc: On a visit to see Ton's sister in Missouri for some rafting and relaxation, the guys hit up a fast-paced live auction. After some tough losses, Ton and Allen score a ballista and an anvil set made for an explosive sport.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Brew-Phoria
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go all in for an electric car, but with the batteries missing, a pricey refurb is their only shot at a profit. Will a home brewing system and high-end air rifles help soften the blow, or will they take a big loss?

programme.title: Auction Hunters: You Got Served
programme.desc: After a crushing defeat, the guys leave an auction empty handed and scramble to find new merchandise at a yard sale. But questionable antique tennis rackets and an ancient special effects box may not earn them a cent.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rock and Roll
programme.desc: An auction in Whittier gets ugly when a buyer named Big Dave tries to take it all. After some tough losses, the guys win a state of the art food truck and an off-road rock crawler with dangerous consequences.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hook, Line & Printer
programme.desc: A last-minute auction in Norwalk proves challenging when Ton and Allen go toe-to-toe with a real life cowboy couple. When the dust settles, the guys uncover a 3D printer and a grappling hook gun they can't wait to shoot.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Machine Gun Ton
programme.desc: Ton and Allen battle a pair of vicious female auction hunters who have an axe to grind and bid based on spite rather than strategy. And a gatling gun & suit of armor are worth much less than the guys expected.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Risk & Reward
programme.desc: Ton & Allen arrive late to an auction. They uncover vintage bear traps and a bounty of street art. If the pieces belong to the artist, RISK, it could be their biggest score ever. If not, they'll be stuck with forged knockoffs.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 10
programme.desc: With the day of the eclipse upon them, the kids, along with a ragtag force of old friends, enact their long-planned invasion of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 11
programme.desc: As the invasion force fights their way to the Fire Nation capital, the kids help Aang find the Firelord in time for the eclipse, but after a few surprises.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 12
programme.desc: When the group seek refuge at the Western Air temple, they find someone they weren't expecting has been following them and hopes to join their group.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 13
programme.desc: As Zuko teaches Aang firebending, it turns out Aang isn't the only one who needs a lesson. The two set-out to learn the true meaning of Firebending from the original teachers.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 14
programme.desc: Sokka and Zuko head to the Fire Nation's most heavily guarded prison - the Boiling Rock - in hopes to find and break-out the captured invasion force.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 15
programme.desc: Sokka and Zuko have to rethink their escape plan after things go wrong. They end up getting help from a few unexpected sources.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 16
programme.desc: Katara sets out to confront the Fire Nation soldier who killed her mother. However, no one knows what she will do when she finds him.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 17
programme.desc: When the kids see a new play about themselves and all of their past adventures, they aren't happy with the production.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 18
programme.desc: The kids learn new information about Firelord Ozai's master plan and decide to strike sooner than planned, but they are unsure if Aang is ready.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 19
programme.desc: While Firelord Ozai begins his master plan, the gang tries to stop him. Meanwhile, Aang seeks advice from his past lives.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 20
programme.desc: Suki, Toph, and Sokka try to stop the Fire Lord's fleet before they hit land, while Azula prepares for her coronation day.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 21
programme.desc: Sokka and Toph manage to disable the airships while Zuko and Katara confront Azula. Aang finally faces off against the Fire Lord.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 1
programme.desc: Katara and Sokka, a brother and sister from the Southern Water Tribe, discover a twelve-year-old boy frozen in an iceberg. Katara wonders if this boy is the Avatar whom the world has been awaiting.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 2
programme.desc: Prince Zuko, a young Firebender whose mission in life is to capture the Avatar, tracks Aang down to the Southern Water Tribe village where Katara and Sokka live.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 3
programme.desc: Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 4
programme.desc: When locals of a small island discover Aang is the Avatar, they treat him like a celebrity.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 5
programme.desc: Aang takes Katara and Sokka to an Earthbender city. The kids cause damage and are brought before a crazy old king, who seems to enjoy messing with the kids' heads.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 6
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 7
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 8
programme.desc: During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 9
programme.desc: When Katara's desire to master Waterbending gets the best of her, the kids find themselves on the run from pirates.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 10
programme.desc: Our heroes' friendship is tested when they meet Jet, a charismatic teenager leading a band of rebels who are fighting against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 11
programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across. Aang quickly learns that this will be no easy task.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 12
programme.desc: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 13
programme.desc: When Sokka and Katara get too sick to travel, Aang goes out on his own to find a cure for them. But he is captured by Zhao and held prisoner inside an impenetrable fortress.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 14
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives but they are so reliant that they are blind to the imminent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 15
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 16
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 17
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 18
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 19
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao's Fire Navy fleet. Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn't a better way to use his Avatar abilities.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 20
programme.desc: Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan. Aang goes to the spirit world for help.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 1
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful `Avatar State' as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation. But it's more difficult than Aang thinks.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 2
programme.desc: On the way to Omashu, the kids meet some nomads who show them a shortcut through the `cave of two lovers'. When they get lost in the caves, they must trust in love to escape.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 3
programme.desc: The kids return to Omashu so that Aang can learn Earthbending from King Bumi; however, when they get there, they are shocked to find the city is now in Fire Nation hands.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 4
programme.desc: When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being `connected to the Earth' from an unlikely teacher.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 5
programme.desc: Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates `Avatar Day'. They learn that it is not a celebration of the Avatar, but a festival of anger for something Aang did in his past.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Ep 6
programme.desc: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament where they encounter Toph, a blind, but powerful Earthbender.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sokka's Master
programme.desc: When Sokka feels he's not contributing enough to the group, he seeks out a mysterious master to teach him the ways of the sword.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Beach
programme.desc: Zuko, Azula, Mai, and Ty Lee go on vacation to Lo and Li's beach house, where they learn much about themselves and each other.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar and The Firelord
programme.desc: Aang and Zuko are taken on parallel adventures that give them insight into their forefathers' pasts - but how does the tale of Roku and Sozin matter to them now?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Runaway
programme.desc: When Toph discovers a quick way to make cash, Katara disapproves, and the rift between them has disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Puppetmaster
programme.desc: In a Halloween installment, the gang looks into strange disappearances in a spooky town. There, an old lady named Hama teaches Katara some secret Waterbending techniques.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Nightmares and Daydreams
programme.desc: On the eve of the eclipse, Aang's anxiety gets the better of him. His dreams become nightmares, and soon he can no longer tell dream from reality.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion
programme.desc: It is the Day of Black Sun and the group meets up with the invasion force."The day has finally arrived and Aang is ready to take on the Fire Lord.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 1: The Invasion

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse
programme.desc: The eclipse has started and the gang only has a few minutes to get into an underground bunker and find and defeat Ozai.
programme.sub-title: The Day of Black Sun Part 2: The Eclipse

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Western Air Temple
programme.desc: The gang leaves the Fire Nation, humbled and embarrassed by the failure of the invasion. They head to the Western Air Temple.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Firebending Masters
programme.desc: Aang is ready to start his firebending training. However, as Zuko attempts to teach him, he realizes he has lost all his firebending power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 1
programme.desc: Sokka and Zuko break into The Boiling Rock Prison, the Fire Nation's highest security prison, to rescue Hakoda. When they develope an escape plan after finding Hakoda not there, other prisoners get involved and ruin it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 2
programme.desc: This episode is continuing the jailbreak from the previous episode. Sokka, Hakoda, Zuko and Suki form a new escape plan, but it is complicated by the arrival of Princess Azula.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Raiders
programme.desc: Katara and Zuko journey together to find the man responsible for the death of Katara's mother, Kya, who was killed in a Southern Water Tribe raid.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Ember Island Players
programme.desc: The gang goes to the theater to see a play about themselves, but are not happy with the production and the inaccurate portrayals of themselves.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King
programme.desc: Aang finds out that Ozai plans to burn down the Earth Kingdom with an airship fleet. He disappears during the night, having sleepwalked onto a mysterious moving island.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 2: The Old Masters
programme.desc: The gang find Iroh with June's help. Iroh suggests that Zuko challenge Azula for the position of Fire Lord, with Katara to help. The others decide to intercept the airship fleet.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 2: The Old Masters

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 3: Into the Inferno
programme.desc: Sokka, Toph and Suki begin destroying the airship fleet. Aang duels Ozai, but is soon overwhelmed because of his reluctance to kill him.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 3: Into the Inferno

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 4: Avatar Aang
programme.desc: Katara eventually defeats Azula by trapping her in ice, and heals Zuko. Sokka, Toph and Suki destroy the airship fleet.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Welcome to Republic City
programme.desc: Having mastered water, earth and fire, Avatar Korra is eager to begin her training in airbending, but trouble in Republic City interrupts her plans.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: A Leaf in the Wind
programme.desc: After hitting a snag in her airbending training with Master Tenzin, Korra pays a visit to the city's Pro Bending arena in search of inspiration.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Revelation
programme.desc: Korra attempts to infiltrate the Equalist movement and learn more about its mysterious leader.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Voice in the Night
programme.desc: Korra is recruited to join Councilman Tarrlok's task force, which seeks to rid the city of Equalists by force.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Spirit of Competition
programme.desc: Korra and her pro-bending teammates struggle to work together after romantic rivalries shake their foundation.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: And the Winner Is...
programme.desc: Korra and the Fire Ferrets ready themselves for the pro-bending championship as an evil threat looms over the arena.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Aftermath
programme.desc: Tensions mount when Korra begins to suspect an ally is working for the Equalists.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: When Extremes Meet
programme.desc: Korra faces off with Councilman Tarrlok as Equalist activity continues to rise in Republic City.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Korra attempts to understand her cryptic visions, while Tenzin and Beifong lead a search for Equalist hostages.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Turning the Tides
programme.desc: The Equalists begin their attack on Republic City.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Skeletons in the Closet
programme.desc: As the war intensifies, Korra goes undercover and discovers a secret about the anti-bending revolution. Meanwhile, her teammates hunt down an Equalist stronghold.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Endgame
programme.desc: In the season finale, Korra faces the mysterious leader of the Equalists as the war in Republic City comes to a head.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Rebel Spirit
programme.desc: Korra struggles to find a deeper connection with the Spirit World as she and the gang attend a Southern Water Tribe festival.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Southern Lights
programme.desc: Korra and Chief Unalaq journey into a dangerous maelstrom and find a source of great spiritual power.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Civil Wars Part 1
programme.desc: While tensions flare between the Northern and Southern Water Tribes, Korra struggles to remain neutral.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Civil Wars Part 2
programme.desc: When Korra's parents are wrongfully arrested, Korra fights for their freedom.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Peacekeepers
programme.desc: When the President of the United Republic refuses to help Korra, she decides to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a drug-abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he break down and take it?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Four adult siblings say they've been blacklisted by their mother from seeing their dying father, a claim their mother vehemently denies. Emotions run high when this fractured family comes together on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can they put an end to the fighting?
programme.sub-title: Blacklisted By Mom: Can We Speak To Our Dad Before He Dies

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Megan, her ex-boyfriend, Andy and his fiancee Caitlin, who have presented Dr. Phil with evidence supporting their allegation that it is Megan's own lifestyle & choices keeping her out of her son's life. Who is telling the truth?
programme.sub-title: A Father Accused, A Mother Blamed, The Truth Revealed Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How well do you know your teenager? Could your child be participating in risky or illegal activities right under your own roof?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How did 21-year-old Jenna go from being a straight-A UC Berkeley student and former beauty queen to abusing heroin and meth and used as sexual currency in a drug house? Her mom is desperate to save her only child and turns to Dr. Phil for intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pregnancy is a time of baby showers, nesting, indulging food cravings and being pampered. But Dr. Phil’s guests, Shayna, says she's been pregnant more than a year, and Zona, says she's been pregnant over 3 1/2 years, Both are looking for answers why.
programme.sub-title: A Woman Claims To Be Pregnant For 3 Years 7 Months

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's a parent's worst nightmare to learn their child was sexually abused, especially in their own home. Patty says her world ended the day she learned her husband was sexually abusing her 3 daughters. What warning signs did she miss?
programme.sub-title: Innocence Robbed: A Horrific Story Of Abuse

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heather's son, Brandon, 15, died of an accidental overdose at her home; authorities say the teen swallowed & snorted Heather's morphine pills while drinking vodka and beer. Acquitted of charges, Heather says her ex-husband Brian continues to blame her.
programme.sub-title: Acquitted By A Jury But My Ex-Husband Still Thinks I'm Guilty Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Emotions run high when Kim’s sisters meet boyfriend Stacy for the first time and Dr. Phil reveals a shocking secret from Stacy’s past. What explanation does Stacy offer? How much did Kim know? Plus, Dr. Phil's advice for the family moving forward. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Sister Intervention: The Boyfriend's Sordid Past Revealed Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some couples vow "for better or worse." With a 50% divorce rate in America, in the midst of marital crises ranging from separation to unfaithfulness, Dr. Phil helps manage rocky marriages. Dr.Phil tells how to survive infidelity or when to call it quits.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's hard to believe, but in America alone, there may be as many as 5,000 religious groups preying upon the weak and vulnerable, and all in the name of God. Dr. Phil's guests have warnings for you and your children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dustin, Chance & Nova say mom Sonya, is a liar & manipulator, neglecting them--deplorable conditions, no food, no hot water. They say mom bought fast food for herself & her boyfriend as they starved. Then she disappeared. Sonya says she doesn't remember.
programme.sub-title: Our Mother Is A Manipulator Who Abandoned Us As Children

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kalan says Giovanni made a major shift in his identity two days after he asked her to marry him. The army veteran changed his persona to superhero, wears a mask, and only answers to “Goose Wayne Batman.” Kalan won't walk down the aisle with a masked man.
programme.sub-title: My Fiance Believes He's A Superhero

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you and your beloved say "I do," it's "for better or worse." But what happens when all you feel is the "worse" part and wind up trapped in a bad marriage?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melissa says Destoni, 14, is an aggressive, violent bully. She's chased her sister with a butcher knife, yells at teachers in the hallways but Destoni crossed a line when she threatened to shoot her teacher and other students, causing suspension. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Expelled, Handcuffed & Violent: My 14-Year-Old Daughter Is Out Of Control Pt. 1

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jed Clampett and Shad Heller conspire to line up Shorty Kellems as a husband for the strong-minded widow, Elverna Bradshaw.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Granny competes against Mrs. Drysdale as artists and tells Jed about her uncle, the barn painter. Jed and Jethro go to an upscale gallery to buy a painting, but are mistaken for gardeners. Bessie the chimp dabbles with a paintbrush.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: As a favor to Jed Mr. Drysdale arranges for a playboy bank director (who normally only dates women half his age) to come court Granny, while Jed goes out with a beautiful woman who dates rich older men.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Mr. Drysdale gets Jed's old cabin from back home and sets it up in the Clampett's backyard to surprise Granny on her birthday. A coed with a sociology major thinks that they live there as the Drysdale's servants.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Heading to England, Jethro smuggles Ellie's turkey buzzard on the plane upsetting Mr. Drysdale and a fellow passenger. After landing, they try to meet with the Queen to give her their 80 million dollars. Their butler Faversham tries to clear things up.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jethro becomes a Hugh Hefner wannabe when he discovers some Playpen magazines in Mr. Drysdale's garage.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Mr. Drysdale is sick, and Dr. Granny springs into action with a chimp as a nurse. But Ellie's bear Fairchild has taken a liking to granny's flu remedy. During this, Mrs. Drysdale tries to impress society Mrs. Van Ransonhoff.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The last televised wrestling match was such a success that the promoter wants a rematch. Granny isn't interested until Rebecca's parents visit.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Ellie May loses another suitor to Miss Jane in another case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Granny insists she doesn't need glasses, although she carries on a conversation with a pet seal, thinking it's Elly's new boyfriend.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Mr. Drysdale casts Dash Riprock as Homer Noodleman, a potential new lover for Elly May.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Granny discovers Martians next door at the Drysdale mansion.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: When Miss Hathaway gets sick and Mr. Drysdale has to speak at a conference, Jed helps out by running the bank and having Elly be his secretary

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jethro finally gets his bill of health from Dr. Twombly so he can graduate the fifth grade, but Twombly really wants to talk to Grannie again

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Since Granny can't plant crops in their yard, Jed thinks the solution is to buy her a plot a land somewhere else. He figures a place called Happy Acres is the best spot to buy land, not realizing it's a cemetery.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: A long time employee of the Commerce Bank is being forcibly retired to make way for a new computer system. A chance meeting with the Clampetts gives him an idea about dealing with Mr. Drysdale.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Mrs. Drysdale hires a demolition man to remove the Clampett's cabin. Mr. Drysdale decides to occupy the cabin so it can't be removed. The Clampetts think a "homewrecker" is breaking up the Drysdale's marriage.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jethro brings home a friend, Armstrong Dueser McHugh III, who is coddled by a chauffeur who treats him as frail.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts visit Hooterville and Jed arranges to go into the airline business with pilot Steve Elliott.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jethro's running late for his graduation ceremony despite his new watch. Mrs. Potts of Jethro's school is afraid that his attendance will jeopardize her chances for a new endowment. Cousin Bessie saves the day.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Mrs. Drysdale has a garden party and 'invites' the Clampetts by mistake.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts (thereafter Mr. Drysdale) mistake the new neighbor's maidservant for the actual owner. Granny tries her best to set Jed up with her.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Mrs. Drysdale thinks she can get the hillbillies to move out by throwing herself at Jed. Meanwhile Granny is itching to fight her because she fell into the cement pond when Jed had to stop a fight between them earlier.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts begin to settle in their new home in Beverly Hills, California.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Mr. Drysdale buys Mammoth Pictures, a movie studio. Jed, Granny, Elly and Jethro try to "help" the studio, which is losing money, by working at the studio.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts prepare to go to Hooterville for Christmas.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jed cheers up Granny by pretending to be sick so she can doctor him

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jed, Granny, Elly May, and Jethro man the front lines against an expected invasion of grunion, which they believe to be hostile aliens.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies

programme.desc: Col. Blake asks the actor playing Gen. Grant to play along with Granny so that the Civil War movie can continue. Meanwhile, Jethro uses his 6th grade education to take the written test to enter the Reserves.

programme.desc: Breinholt får i den grad kamp til sit hår i dag. Vi rykker ud på kajen, hvor han skal lære sexy moves og spille “Smoke on the water” med selveste Sussi – der IGEN IGEN er blevet scammet online.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 114
programme.desc: Komikeren Mahamad Habane skal være far for første gang. Om han er klar til det, finder vi ud af, når Anders gennem-quizzer ham i diverse baby-tests. Find også ud af, hvem af Habanes co-Bros han vil giftes med - og hvem han vil slå ihjel.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 115
programme.desc: I dag er Spørgekassen byttet ud med SVEDEkassen, når radio- og TV-vært Sara Bro tager Anders med ind i varmen. Men før det bliver rigtig hot, kigger de lidt på insta-rullen fra Saras 50 års fødselsdag – som i øvrigt også er brandvarm

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 116
programme.desc: Sangerinden Mekdes laver venindebog med Anders for at finde ud af, om de to har noget som helst tilfælles. Til sidst får dagens gæst den vildeste gave, der er givet i Breinholts historie!

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 117
programme.desc: Thor om en vild koncert, han holdt for nylig. Men er dagens gæst i virkeligheden gabende kedelig – eller er han en rigtig jetsetter? Og hvad ville han redde, hvis hans lejlighed stod i brand?

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 118
programme.desc: NU bliver det vildt! Den legendariske trommeslager fra Metallica er i Danmark, så han tager på roadtrip med Anders. De to gamle venner snakker fortroligt om både kunst, barndommen i whiskeybæltet og en nylig sorg i Lars´s liv.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 119
programme.desc: Nygifte Tine Gøtzsche besøger Breinholts på Magneten og bliver fejret efter alle kunstens – og kærlighedens – regler. Hør om det mildest talt utraditionelle bryllup og se med, da Tine vandt prisen som “Årets Hotteste”.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 120
programme.desc: For at fejre én af Fyns fineste ambassadører Hjalmer Larsen bliver der serveret brunssviger, spillet helt ny musik og snakket om kærestens begejstring over Hjalmers overskæg. Og så får vi fornøjelsen af Hjalmers bare røv!

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 121
programme.desc: Heavy Metal-fan Magnus Millang får en flot growling-velkomst på Breinholts. Men der bliver også snakket om Magnus passion for fotografering – og ost. For hvem husker ikke Emmenthaler-krisen i 80´erne?

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 122
programme.desc: EM skal skydes i gang, og det fejrer Anders og Malte Ebert i Breinholts. Vi skal høre en bid af Maltes nye landsholdssang – og så har Anders planlagt en KÆMPE overraskelse, der kommer trillende med to fodbold-legender.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 123
programme.desc: Når Søs Egelind besøger Breinholts, er der tid til både vendespil, guest appearance fra Molly og kunstige tænder. Og selvfølgelig en inside-snak om nogle af Kongerigets største karakterer. Og hov – kommer Søs måske en lille afsløring til sidst?

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 124
programme.desc: I dagens afsnit får Anders sit livs største skideballe af selveste mr. “Sæt i gang!” – Jakob Kjeldbjerg. Netop hjemvendt fra Malaysia er han klar med klip og røverhistorier fra de sidste 20 år med Robinson.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 101
programme.desc: Sofie Linde er den allerførste gæst, Anders inviterer indenfor – og han har en kæmpe overraskelse til hende. Det involverer Langeland, en hemmelig aftale med nogle naboer og en 150 kg tung træfigur.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 102
programme.desc: Benjamin Hav, musiker og kgl. Hofleverandør, besøger Anders. De to får sig en solid snak om toiletvaner, billedkunst og deres forkærlighed for Søs Egelind.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 103
programme.desc: I dag kan du møde Nicklas Bendtner. Men hvad er det egentlig med ham og hatte? Hvad skal tv-serien om ham og hans nye kæreste Sus hedde? Oplev de to gamle venner på slap line.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 104
programme.desc: Anders har en hemmelig drøm om at få en hårtransplantation, den snak tager han med Kandis-Johnny. Kom også med når de to kører Amager tyndt med Kørequizzen: Ku´ du tænke dig at vinde en airfryer?

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 105
programme.desc: Stephanie Surrugue elsker luksus, så Anders har sørget for en piccolo og masser af drikkepenge. Vi skal også til bodyslam, og så er det Stephanie, der stiller de nærgående spørgsmål i Spørgekassen.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 106
programme.desc: Bad boy Mick Øgendahl besøger Breinholts, hvor Mick mansplainer arv og miljø for Anders. Han fortæller om, hvor berømt han er i Egypten – og hvorfor han ikke længere inviterer pressen til sine shows.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 107
programme.desc: Der er dømt Paradise-stemning i Breinholts i dag, hvor Rikke Gøransson er gæst. De to snakker om skønhedsidealer, graviditetsudfordringer og ´farsel´. Og lige pludselig er der BREEEEEEEEEEEV!

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 108
programme.desc: På besøg er en KÆMPE vinder, nemlig træner for herrelandsholdet i håndbold Nikolaj Jacobsen. Anders prøver at lure, hvordan man bliver en ægte vinder – og så skal vi se en sølvmedalje fuld af traumer.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 109
programme.desc: Han er kæmpe dyreelsker – passioneret lystfisker in spe – og har 2 mill. følgere på instagram. Alex Høgh fortæller om sin musikalske storhedstid – og om sin spritnye komedieserie på Viaplay.

programme.title: Breinholts: Episode 110
programme.desc: Har ’Breinholts’ fået ny vært? Denne gang er det Maria Fantino, der åbner ballet, men Anders får heldigvis lov til at komme med indenfor på Magneten.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The final four face go-sees and the final 3 is revealed.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The three remaining girls arrive in Buenos Aires for the Fashion Week. They have to work backstage.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The pressure mounts as the remaining two competitors face the glare of the press and the glamour of the modeling high-life before their final showdown.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: In the 90 minute season premiere 25 girls arrive at bootcamp and meet their host Elle Macpherson. They also come face to face with the other judges, fashion designer Julian MacDonald, stylist Grace Woodward and ex-male model Charley Speed.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: In the first week of the main competition, the final 14 move into their new model house and participate in a lingerie themed photo shoot. The girls then have their first official elimination of the main competition. One girl is sent home.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls receive their makeovers, but not all are happy with their new looks. The models are assigned a photoshoot wearing Links of London couture.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls meet Girls Aloud singer Nicola Roberts and take part in a photoshoot for Beat Bullying.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls take part in a posing challenge on Carnaby Street then film a commercial for Beyonce's new fragrance 'Heat'. The photoshoot involves being covered in chocolate which proves difficult for one girl who shows up hungover.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Alesha Dixon meets the models and tasks them with selling her new jewelry line on live television. After meeting Grace in Gatwick airport they are given £500 to go on a shopping spree. They are then whisked off to Spain to do a photoshoot in swim wear.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls take part in an acting challenge on the Hollyoaks set and one girl gets carried away on a night out with some of the cast members. The girls must do a horror style photoshoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The models face an icy photoshoot when they fly off to Norway.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: This week the girls do a beauty shoot for Revlon and some girls are pushed over the edge in a second shoot for 'Galaxy Ripple'.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: A challenge with Nicky Johnston sees one model facing harsh criticism. The girls then do a photoshoot with TV personality George Lamb and take part in a photoshoot with a London Rugby team for legendary photographer Terry O'Neill.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The final 5 arrive in Kuala Lumpar and meet with fashion legend Jimmy Choo to take part in a dance challenge. The photoshoot this week takes place at night for Baby G watches.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The final 4 are sent on go-sees around Kuala Lumpar and are sent to the jungle for their photoshoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The final 3 recreate some of Elle's most famous poses and there is a shock at elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: In the finale the three remaining models have their final photo shoot and the final two compete in a catwalk show and one girl is crowned 'Britain's Next Top Model'.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls immediately face their first challenge, posing in front of the press. They then meet stylist Hilary Alexander, who asks them when they lost their virginity and what they think about unprotected sex.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls take part in a catwalk challenge set by Otis Isles, the internationally respected casting director, model agent, and fashion producer, who tells them to dress in underwear.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at the English National Ballet School, where Lisa introduces them to ballet teacher Louise Halliday. They learn about the art of ballet to help with their movement.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls order a pizza and find Lisa Mail for the challenge the following morning. A huge fight breaks out between Stefanie and Louise.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are taken to Debenhams, where they get the chance to meet Caprice. They are given fifteen minutes to find an outfit for different occasions.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at a bar where they meet music video director Paul Hills. Their challenge is to star in a music video along with The Wolfmen.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls are woken up by a grueling morning workout from Celebrity Personal Trainer Nicki Waterman. Some struggle with the workout, especially Sherece.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive at Models 1, where they meet Mark Evans along with casting agents. They take a Polaroid shot for a casting. Mark announces that they will be going to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, but there are only four places on the plane.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive in Rio and excitedly explore the luxurious villa they will be staying in. On a rare day off, they are driven to Ipanema to play beach volleyball with local guys, and in the evening, they are joined for dinner by Lisa.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The top three girls take a cable car to Sugar Loaf Mountain to learn Samba dancing.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: All 14 girls are interviewed by the press where they are asked why they want to win. The models pair up and pick each partners best and worst features. The girls receive news about their first photoshoot and later find out it's a topless shoot in pairs.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls get a crash course in dance with top choreographer Supple and a runway lesson from top fashionista Jeanette. The winners get to take part in a fashion show featuring the work of top designer Scottee - whose dresses are all made out of paper.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls find out they're getting makeovers in a Lisa Mail. This weeks challenge is a bucking bronco advertisement for the cheesy "Britain's Next Top Model Hairspray". In this weeks photoshoot they have the added element of working with a small dog.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls took part in a challenge for Jai Kudo glasses. At the photoshoot the models are greeted by Gerry Deveaux and Giorgio Guidotti, of Italian fashion house, Primarni for a shoot for the latest collection by SportMax one of Max Mara's labels.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls meet with TV star, June Sarpong to learn interview skills and are judged by undercover magazine journalists. The claws are out as the girls critique each other during the challenge. Tension in the house builds.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: This week the girls learn some new choreography with Supple and in the photoshoot the girls are told they are to pose for an album cover. Lisa Snowdon treats everyone to cocktails with The Bar Wizards -finalists on last years Britain's Got Talent.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The models face an acting challenge which includes a steamy kissing scene with guest actor Guy Burnet. The photoshoot this week is a couture shot where each girl had to portray a different emotion.
