programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Caruso relinquishes his role as school bully after getting bullied himself. However, without Caruso to establish the school's power hierarchy and with everyone vying to fill his shoes, Chris and Greg realize they'd better come up with a fast solution.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Things take a literal turn for the worse when a license-less Chris volunteers to move his dad's car, but finds himself driving the car all the way to school as a result of trying to impress Tasha. Rochelle spends an interesting day at traffic court.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: As a result of their apartment being broken into, Julius and Rochelle decide it's a good idea to get a dog, something Chris has always wanted.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: With no extracurricular activities to his name, Chris decides to join the writing staff of the school newspaper.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: When Chris discovers that his long-standing crush, Tasha, likes 'bad boys,' he decides it's time to lose his 'nice guy' image and win over the girl of his dreams.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: When Chris' entire family comes down with the flu, Rochelle and Julius make arrangements for Mr. Omar to look after Chris until the family recovers.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: With Greg's father out of town, Chris invites Greg to stay at his house for the week.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: When a new student, Albert, enrolls at Corleone, Chris realizes that he has a lot more in common with Albert than just being the only two African American kids in school.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: With Christmas break right around the corner, Chris' holiday cheer turns to holiday blues when his teacher, Ms. Morello, assigns homework requiring each student to do a good deed over the break.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris and his family decide to take a trip down South to attend the funeral of Julius' distant relative.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris must come up with a school project for Earth Day, so he decides to collect cans, believing it will be an easy task and something Julius can help him accomplish.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: When Doc refuses to give Chris a raise, Chris goes out and gets a new job at the local Chinese restaurant.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: In an attempt to keep his younger brother, Drew, out of further trouble, Chris reluctantly agrees to skip school and accompany Drew on a mission to find his idol, hockey great Wayne Gretzky.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris is so desperate to raise the funds to go to a Run DMC concert that he jumps at the chance to participate in Mr. Omar's Black Funeral Directors' (BFD) scholarship fund.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: On a mission to become one of the 'cool' kids, Chris is caught with cigarettes and suspended from school.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris attempts to help Malvo, a criminal who was recently released from jail, turn his life around by going back to high school. Rochelle is alarmed by the parenting skills of one of Tonya's friend's parents and decides to share her wealth of knowledge.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris decides to buy his mother an expensive bottle of perfume for Mother's Day to pay her back for all the things she has done for him, but when he learns that it costs much more than he anticipated, Chris buys an imposter version of the perfume.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: After finding out that Tasha is going to 'spin the bottle' parties, Chris is determined to get an invitation to the next party so he can finally experience his first kiss.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: When Tasha breaks up with her boyfriend, Chris is more than happy to step in and serve as her escort for the Easter Pageant, but first, he has to figure out how to be in two places at the same time without his mother finding out.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris and Greg are without dates to the ninth-grade dance until Greg gets asked, leaving Chris as the odd man out. Ms. Morello suggests to Chris that he ask the only girl who hasn't been asked yet, Carrie White, and she accepts.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris' excitement about graduating from junior high school is ruined when Greg announces that he'll be going to a different high school in the fall.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: As a first-time high school student, Chris is really looking forward to attending a school with some diversity.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris agrees to help a classmate, Angel improve his grades if Angel will help him get the attention of Chris' latest crush, Maria. Rochelle reluctantly befriends an ex-con, Peaches who has moved back into the neighborhood, but her good deed backfires.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris is on cloud nine when a cute girl, Jenise Huckstable, invites him to the Tattaglia Homecoming Dance. However, his nerves take a turn for the worse when her father, Dr. Huxtable, wants Chris to come over to the house to meet him before the dance.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: When Julius and Rochelle decide to raise Mr. Omar's rent, Mr. Omar demands they bring the apartment up to code and moves in with Chris' family until the repairs are done.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris realizes that by helping the school's star running back and his friends with homework he is allowed to hang out with the cool kids. Greg tries to make him see that it's a bad idea.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: When Doc's obnoxious new girlfriend, Stacy, makes Chris' life a living hell, Chris decides it's about time he split up the happy couple. Meanwhile, Tonya starts wearing a bra to get the attention of the boys in her class.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Although he is supposed to be home watching Drew and Tonya, Chris sneaks out to go to the movies with his friends and witnesses a shoot-out outside the theater.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris is just starting to fit in at his new high school when he gets asked on a date by the dorkiest girl in school, Kelly, whom everyone calls 'Big Bird.'

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Julius realizes that the key to keeping Rochelle happy in their marriage is getting advice from 'The Oprah Winfrey Show.' Unfortunately, the plan backfires when Rochelle equates Julius' new attitude with an extramarital affair.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: When Rochelle orders a copy of her birth certificate, she realizes that she is actually one year younger than she thought she was and decides to start living her life with a new, younger attitude.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris is determined to spend New Year's Eve in Times Square, but Rochelle says Chris can only go if he finds a responsible adult to accompany him. The only problem is that the only people Chris can find to be his chaperone are two ex-convicts.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris and Greg decide to join the wrestling team to land a varsity jacket to impress the ladies.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris and Greg realize they'd better find fake IDs or they won't be able to go to the '18 and over' Fat Boys concert. Rochelle plans a surprise party for Julius.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Knowing that he needs to score well to help him get into college, Chris decides to cram for his PSAT test. When Rochelle makes the family attend a social event, Chris is left with no time to study and resorts to buying the PSAT answer key.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Coach Thurman witnesses Chris being bullied by Caruso and suggests Chris learn to box to defend himself.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris reluctantly agrees to hold onto a stash of marijuana for a criminal on the run, but he finds it difficult to find an appropriate hiding place that won't get him in trouble.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: As punishment for Chris' disruption of history class, Chris and his classmates are given the assignment of memorizing a famous speech from World War II and reciting it in front of the class.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader løfter
programme.desc: Da skoleavisen udgiver flere fordømmende artikler om Chris og hans formandskab, er Chris nødt til at forsvare sig mod Caruso og klassekammeraterne ved en rigsretssag.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader thanksgiving
programme.desc: Da Julius’ succesfulde lillebror Louis besøger familien til thanksgiving, begynder Julius at konkurrere i et forsøg på at lave det perfekte måltid.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader overtro
programme.desc: Da Julius låner Chris et par lykkesokker, bemærker Chris, at han ikke kan begå nogen fejl.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Kris
programme.desc: Da Julius låner Chris et par lykkesokker, bemærker Chris, at han ikke kan begå nogen fejl.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader æg
programme.desc: I et skoleprojekt om forældreskab får Chris og Greg et æg, som de skal passe, som var det deres eget barn, men opgaven viser sig at være udfordrende, da Chris’ mor beslutter sig for at vise ham, hvad forældrerollen virkelig går ud på.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader gangvagter
programme.desc: I håb om at få mere respekt fra sine klassekammerater og ikke længere være Carusos boksepude, melder Chris sig som gangvagt.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader snedage
programme.desc: Da Chris uforvarende kommer i skole på en ”snedag”, bliver han og rektor Edward fanget sammen, indtil de kan få fat i Chris’ forældre.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader vikaren
programme.desc: En videnskabeligt anlagt vikar gør Chris’ liv til et helvede ved at forvente mere af ham end af klassekammeraterne.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader at pjække
programme.desc: Da læreren miss Morello er væk i en dag, beslutter Chris og Greg sig for at pjække og tage i biografen og se ”Ghostbusters”.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader smykketyveri
programme.desc: Da Chris forpurrer Malvos forsøg på at stjæle en guldkæde fra Vanessa, giver Malvo Chris én dag til at finde en anden halskæde, ellers må han svare for følgerne.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader DJ's
programme.desc: Da nabolagets DJ bliver anholdt under en fest, overtager Chris tjansen og viser sig at være et stort hit blandt publikum.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader baseball
programme.desc: Chris står i et dilemma, da han skal vælge mellem at tage til baseballkamp med sin far og Drew eller gå i biografen med Tasha.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader hasardspil
programme.desc: Chris bliver Bed-Stuys yndlings bookmaker, da Doc opdager, at han har talent for at forudsige sportsresultater.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader frække vittigheder
programme.desc: Efter at have smuglyttet til sine forældres comedy-plader prøver Chris nogle frække vitser af på sine klassekammerater og opdager, at evnen til at få andre til at grine er nøglen til at blive populær. Men hans lærer har et andet synspunkt på sagen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader matematik
programme.desc: Hele Chris’ klasse regner med, at han kan lære alt om alegebra til en matematikkonkurrence, og Rochelle giver sig til selv at undervise Chris.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader sidste skoledag
programme.desc: Sidste skoledag nærmer sig med hastige skridt, og Chris beslutter sig for at tage hævn over Caruso for at have gjort de sidste to år af hans liv til et helvede.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader studievejlederen
programme.desc: Da Chris klarer sig dårligt til en eksamen sender miss Morello ham til skolens studievejleder, mr. Abbott.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Caruso
programme.desc: Uden Caruso til at opretholde skolens magtbalance og med alle dem, der prøver at overtage hans rolle, indser Chris og Greg, at de er nødt til at komme med en løsning.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader at køre
programme.desc: Alt går helt galt, da den kørekortløse Chris melder sig frivilligt til at flytte sin fars bil, men kommer til at køre bilen hele vejen til skolen i et forsøg på at imponere Tasha.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Blackie
programme.desc: Da der er indbrud i lejligheden, beslutter Julius og Rochelle sig for, at det er en god idé at få hund; noget, som Chris altid har ønsket sig.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader ungkarlehybelen
programme.desc: Da hele Chris’ familie får influenza, aftaler Rochelle og Julius med mr. Omar, at han skal passe Chris, indtil familien har det bedre.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Bed Stuy
programme.desc: For at blive noteret for en fritidsaktivitet melder Chris sig til at skrive på skoleavisen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader overnattende gæster
programme.desc: Gregs far er ude at rejse, så Chris inviterer Greg til at bo hjemme hos ham i en uge.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader mindsteløn
programme.desc: Da Doc nægter at give Chris lønforhøjelse, får Chris et nyt arbejde på den lokale kinesiske restaurant.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader den nye dreng
programme.desc: Da en ny elev, Albert, starter på Corleone, indser Chris, at han har meget mere til fælles med Albert end blot at være de to eneste sorte elever i skolen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Kwanzaa
programme.desc: Juleferien nærmer sig, og Chris’ ferieglæde bliver til feriedepression, da hans lærer, miss Morello, beder alle eleverne om at gøre en god gerning i juleferien.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader transportmyndighederne
programme.desc: Chris og hans familie beslutter sig for at tage en tur til Syden for at deltage i begravelsen af en af Julius’ fjerne slægtninge.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader slemme drenge
programme.desc: Da Chris opdager, at hans flamme, Tasha, elsker ”slemme drenge”, beslutter han sig for at lægge den ”flinke fyr” på hylden og vinde sin drømmepiges hjerte.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader det første kys
programme.desc: Da Chris hører, at Tasha tager til fester, hvor man leger flaskeleg, prøver han at få en invitation til næste fest, så han endelig kan få sit første kys.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader påske
programme.desc: Da Tasha slår op med sin kæreste, træder Chris gerne til for at eskortere hende til påskekonkurrencen, men først skal han finde ud af, hvordan han kan være to steder på én gang, uden at hans mor opdager det.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Gretzky
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at holde sin bror væk fra ballade siger Chris modvilligt ja til at pjække fra skole og tage med Drew ud på en mission for at finde hans idol, ishockeyspilleren Wayne Gretzky.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader BFD
programme.desc: Chris er så desperat for at skaffe penge til en koncert med Run DMC, at han griber muligheden for at ansøge om mr. Omars Black Funeral Directors’ (BFD) stipendium.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader eksfangerne
programme.desc: Chris forsøger at hjælpe Malvo, en vaneforbryder, som lige er blevet løsladt fra fængslet, med at ændre sit liv ved at gå tilbage til high school.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Jordens dag
programme.desc: Chris skal finde på et skoleprojekt til Jordens dag, så han indsamler tomme dåser i den tro, at det vil blive en let opgave, som Julius kan hjælpe ham med.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader at være cool
programme.desc: Chris er på en mission for at blive en af de ”cool” børn og bliver taget med cigaretter og bortvist fra skolen.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader gallafesten i 9. klasse
programme.desc: Chris og Greg har ingen dates til gallafesten i 9. klasse, men så bliver Greg inviteret med, så Chris må gå alene. Miss Morello foreslår, at Chris inviterer den eneste pige, der ikke har en date endnu, Carrie White, og hun siger ja.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader mors dag
programme.desc: Chris vil købe en flaske dyr parfume til sin mor til mors dag for at takke hende for alt det, hun har gjort for ham.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader dimissionen
programme.desc: Chris’ glæde over at dimittere fra high school bliver ødelagt, da Greg meddeler, at han skal på en anden high school til efteråret.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Tattaglia
programme.desc: Som førsteårselev i high school glæder Chris sig til at gå i en skole, der har lidt mere mangfoldighed.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Rochelle decides to host a neighborhood watch meeting after Julius' truck is stolen, but her good intentions quickly turn competitive when her new neighbor, Louise thinks she'd make a better block captain than Rochelle.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: After failing to make an impression at the town hall meeting, Chris realizes that he needs to deliver the best campaign speech of all time if he's going to win the election for class president.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: After Chris accidentally misleads the neighborhood into thinking he and Tasha are dating, Rochelle gets quite an earful from Tasha's grandmother, Louise

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris is honored when Doc finally entrusts him with watching the cash register, but the situation goes from good to really bad when Chris is robbed by the neighborhood's notorious repeat-offender, Malvo.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: Chris's new principal, Principal Edwards decides that the best way to solve the tension between Chris and Caruso is to pair them up as buddies on the school field trip.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris
programme.desc: After the school newspaper runs several inflammatory stories about Chris and his class presidency, Chris must defend himself against Caruso and his classmates at an impeachment hearing.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E19 - Nerve

programme.sub-title: Farscape: S1 E20 - The Hidden Memory

programme.title: Farscape: Farscape: S1 E22 - Family Ties

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When the victim of a violent crime is a member of law enforcement, the job of investigating becomes personal. At a United States border crossing, armed fugitives kidnapped a customs' inspector then vanished.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When gangs go to war, they don't care who gets in the way. In 1988 an innocent man was gunned down near Cleveland, Ohio, a victim of a deadly initiation.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 70s and 80s a gang of thugs wreaked havoc on the island of Puerto Rico. Organized, experienced and deadly they seemed beyond the reach of the law.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the United States, identity theft costs citizens billions of dollars. In some cases, it costs the lives of innocent people.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In this special episode, we take a closer look at cases previously featured on this series. Our goal is to explore more fully some of the investigative methods and techniques that have made the FBI the premier law enforcement agency in the world.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A burning body in a dark alley shed light on a cold-blooded killer. His partners in crime would tell the story, if they lived. In the underworld of the drug trade, even a childhood friend can quickly become an enemy.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1990s, one criminal terrorized an entire community. Witnesses refused to speak out. They knew the consequences could be deadly.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 1970s, the FBI had a working knowledge of anti-Castro terrorists operating in the United States. But then a new group appeared, more violent and aggressive than their predecessors.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980's the federal penitentiary in Atlanta held some of the country's most notorious prisoners. Castro called them undesirables. The U.S. government called them detainees. In 1987 they staged a bloody revolt.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: While camping with her family in Montana, a seven-year-old girl was abducted from her tent. No one in the campground witnessed the crime and the kidnapper left no clues.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Two young boys were the only witnesses to their mother's murder. The horrible crime appeared unmotivated, senseless and random.

programme.desc: En hyggelig aften derhjemme lyder uskyldig, men skabeer mere uro, end man skulle tro. Regler bliver brudt, og drengene ryger i hundehuset. Afsnittet indeholder den ultimative cliffhanger.

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia)
programme.desc: Velkommen til cirkusset. F-Boys og Nice Guys afsløret i dette hjertebankende afsnit. Ingen F-Boy eller Nice Guy er sikker på F-Boy Island.

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia)
programme.desc: Vis os din frække side! En hed kemi-test finder sted i dette afsnit. Molly, Sophie og Ziara får en forsmag på, hvad der venter dem efter F-Boy Island... Lækkert eller klamt (du bestemmer).

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia)
programme.desc: Alt afsløres i dette afsnit. Nice Guys får en advarsel, og F-Boys gør et sidste desperat forsøg på at bevise deres uskyld over for Sophie, Molly og Ziara. #F'dup"

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia)
programme.desc: Kærlighed og penge er prikken over i'et i den hjertebankende sæsonafslutning. Sophie, Molly og Ziara afslutter F-Boy Island Australia med et brag.

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia)
programme.desc: Krystal, Nicole og Ally leder alle efter kærligheden og har ét mål - at eliminere F-Boys. Alle tre er vilde med Joe, som kun har øje for Nicole. Men på Allys første date med Joe afslører han sine sande intentioner.

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia)
programme.desc: "Verdens største F-ooy, Caleb, er tilbage! Krystal, Nicole og Ally sætter drengene på prøve - fysisk og mentalt - for at finde ud af, hvem der er med for kærligheden, og hvem der kun er ude efter pengene.

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia)
programme.desc: Pigerne fortsætter deres mission om at afsløre F-boys - denne gang med bind for øjnene! De får hjælp af barpersonalet til at teste drengene for dårlig opførsel. Hvem går i fælden?

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia)
programme.desc: Joes besidderiske adfærd er dagens samtaleemne - og ikke den eneste advarselslampe. Rygter om, at han har en kæreste derhjemme, kommer også frem i lyset.

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia): Afsnit 5
programme.desc: Det går hedt for sig, da pigerne sætter drengene på prøve i seksuel kemi. En dybdegående gennemgang af drengenes sociale medier afslører nogle chokerende sandheder - vil det vende spillet på hovedet?

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia): Afsnit 6
programme.desc: Pigerne sætter Nathan på prøve for at finde ud af, hvem der er en F-Boy. På en gruppedate afdækker Ally flere advarselssignaler om Joe. Abbie chokerer drengene.

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia): Afsnit 7
programme.desc: Seans og Jacks rivalisering koger over til mixeren. Tre single-dates skaber to forbindelser, men er det slut for én af drengene? Og en chokerende eliminering."

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia): Afsnit 8
programme.desc: Pigerne har været i deres kærlighedsbobler i lang tid nu. I dag tager de hinandens drenge med på dates for at se, hvad de kan afsløre. Resultatet er kærlighedserklæringer, vandrende blikke og spændinger.

programme.title: Fboy Island (Australia): Afsnit 9
programme.desc: Spænd sikkerhedsselen til den mest chokerende finale! Hemmeligheder afsløres, hjerter knuses, løgne afsløres... og det er kun ved mansplainingen. Får pigerne deres 'happy ending' og en andel af de 50.000 dollars?

programme.title: FGIRL Island: Kvinder er for gode
programme.desc: Tre mænd begiver sig ud på en rejse for at finde en forbindelse med en af 24 smukke kvinder.

programme.title: FGIRL Island: Jeg er ikke klar til denne samtale
programme.desc: Benedict befinder sig midt i dramaet mellem Powerpuff-pigerne og Jazmanian Devil.
programme.sub-title: Jeg er ikke klar til denne samtale

programme.title: FGIRL Island: Rave-crashere
programme.desc: Fyrene indser, at deres evne til at spotte en ærlig kvinde er elendig. Nikki arrangerer en ravefest for deltagerne.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.

programme.title: The Killer Meteors
programme.desc: Mei Xing He is a local hero, as known as 'Killer Meteors', his secret weapon makes him invincible. However, when Hua Wu Bin, another powerful local character seeks his assistance, Mei Xing He will face the deadliest challenge of his life.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: After witnessing the murder of his father, Little Mute trains in Shaolin Temple for revenge and is taught by various teachers, one of which is clandestine.

programme.title: To Kill With Intrigue
programme.desc: After the execution of his family by a gang, Lei Shao-feng is spared by its afflicting leader who stands in the way of him becoming reunited with his love, as does a traitorous friend, who takes advantage of their predicament.

programme.title: Snake & Crane Arts of Shaolin [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: A martial arts book, which Hsu Yin-Fung (Jackie Chan) carries, is being highly sought by various clans and gangs, but he is in pursuit of someone himself.

programme.title: Dragon Fist
programme.desc: Tong Huo-wan (Jackie Chan) seeks redress from the man responsible for his master's death, but becomes entangled in a feud between a local clan and gangsters.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's Project A
programme.desc: Dragon Ma a lieutenant in the 19th-century Hong Kong marines battles Pirates that have been terrorizing local waters in this must-see adrenaline-pumping adventure delivers all the intense thrills and witty fun that Jackie Chan fans demand!

programme.title: Jackie Chan's Project A2 (A Gai Waak Juk Jaap)
programme.desc: Dragon Mao is assigned to lead the local police force but soon discovers that police corruption is running wild right under his nose. When he's framed for a jewelry robbery, Dragon Mao must fight to clear his name.

programme.title: Wheels On Meals
programme.desc: Action-packed and full of fun, set off on a wacky adventure with kung-fu fighting cousins Thomas and David whose simple life running a fast-food van in Spain is turned upside down by the beautiful pickpocket Sylvia.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1106
programme.desc: Imens de andre fruer nyder det italienske, er Amalie taget med sin mor Lotte på et lækkert slotsophold hjemme i Danmark. Amalies to døtre Josephine og Hannah er også med, men det giver nogle udfordringer.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1107
programme.desc: Tina render igen rendt ind i uheld, da familiens nye hjem bliver udsat for indbrud. Amalie og Karina er taget på holistisk retreat for at give slip på dårlige energier.

programme.title: Forsidefruer: Episode 1108
programme.desc: Janni og Karsten skal have opereret deres elskede hund Lola. Janni er meget nervøs for indgrebet – især da hun opdager, hvor ung dyrelægen er.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Hos Forsidefruerne er der røre i andedammen da Gunnvør og Oliver Bjerrehus vælger at annoncere en stor nyhed på Instagram.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Der fuld gang i den hos de travle Forsidefruer. Gunnvør og kæresten Oliver Bjerrehus skal til 3D scanning for at finde ud af om de venter sig en dreng eller pige.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Sarah Louise og Gunnvør, rejser til Dubai for at besøge deres veninde Tina Lund. I oliestaten får de rigtig tid til luksus, sol og forkælelse, men Sarah Louise oplever også en ny og skrap side af Tina Lund.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Janni Re har et vigtigt møde, der kan hjælpe hende på vej mod økonomisk uafhængighed af milliardær-manden Karsten. Men når Karsten hører om Jannis bedrifter bliver den garvede købmand ikke imponeret.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Janni Re skal som en del af sit arbejde for et nyt firma på PR-tur til Jylland, og det skaber en række udfordringer for Forsidefruen, der ikke føler sig tryg på motorvejen, og som ikke er vant til at forlade Nordsjælland.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Janni Re drømmer om at blive økonomisk uafhængig af Karsten. Hun tager derfor med sit nye vinfirma til Næsbyholm Slot, hvor hun vil prøve at imponere en række særligt inviterede indkøbere.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Veninderne Janni Ree og Amalie Szigethy frygter, at der bliver uro, da en ny kvinde træder ind i deres eksklusive kreds.Det er strandvejsfruen, Jackie Navarro, der blev kendt som letpåklædt model.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Forsidefruen Sarah Louise er meget spændt på at vise Janni og Jackie hendes nyerhvervede kontorlokaler på travbanen i Charlottenlund.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Forsidefruen Gunnvør går i fødsel, men faren til barnet, modellen Oliver Bjerrehuus, er ikke med på hospitalet. De to har nemlig ikke været på talefod i mange måneder.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Tina, Amalie og Janni besøger Gunnvør for at se hendes lille nyfødte dreng, som hun har fået med modellen Oliver Bjerrehus.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Konflikten mellem Gunnvør og Sarah Louise er brudt ud, og det er Sarah mildest talt træt af. De to fruer har stadig ikke fået snakket sammen, og nu har Janni inviteret alle fruerne ud på en lækker yacht.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Sarah Louise holder storslået fødselsdagsfest på et slot, og alle er inviterede. Hun bliver 35 år, og det skal fejres med rød løber, store kjoler og en privat sanger.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: I Sydfrankrig har fruerne Janni, Amalie, Jackie og Sarah Louise travlt med at dulle sig op, så de er ekstra lækre, da de skal feste på det hotteste sted i Cannes. Missionen er at finde en fyr til Amalie.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Amalie skal holde 1-års fødselsdag for sin lille datter Josephine, og fruerne og deres børn er inviteret. Tingene går dog ikke helt som planlagt, da Amalie aldrig har holdt en børnefødselsdag før.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Alle fruerne er samlet for første gang, siden den dramatiske middag i første sæson. Janni frygter dog, at der også bliver drama i aften, da der ulmer mange uforløste konflikter under overfladen.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: The Club
programme.desc: One haunted members only club and a bar full if spirits. Ghost Dimension capture ghostly goings on, inside of Aintree Conservative Club. A place never investigated before and has paranormal activity daily.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Souls Seeking Solace Gotts Park Mansion
programme.desc: The team encounters a spirit member joining them on the thermal imaging camera and appearing to leave its ghostly hand print behind.
programme.sub-title: Souls Seeking Solace Gotts Park Mansion

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Celebrity Special - The Black Horse in Pluckley Village
programme.desc: Bex and Sean are joined by reality TV star Charlie Doherty in the most haunted village in the UK and investigate the most haunted pub in the UK, The Black Horse.
programme.sub-title: Celebrity Special - The Black Horse in Pluckley Village

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Halloween Special Chillingham Castle
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Chillingham Castle for a Halloween investigation. The most haunted castle in the world. Reports of paranormal activity are daily here, so what will the team manage to capture tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Fort Crosby
programme.desc: Crosby Battery, also known as Crosby Point Battery and Fort Crosby, was an artillery battery situated between Crosby and Hightown in Lancashire, United Kingdom. The battery was used for port defence and anti-aircraft defence during WWII.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: The Lady in Grey
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate ruins of The Orangery in Merseyside and claims that the ghost of a grey lady is haunting the location. They capture some of the most compelling paranormal evidence they have ever encountered.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Who is There?
programme.desc: Could a cemetery be haunted? The team come head out to find out and contact restless souls that have been haunting the graveyard.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: House of Hauntings
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean head to New Mills and investigate a home situated on the grounds of death and destruction from the bombings of WW2. Will any of the spirits lost in this disaster come forward and make contact during the investigation today?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: What Haunts Inside?
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension is an exciting paranormal show that takes investigations to a whole new level.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: The Streets
programme.desc: Hidden underground for years in Keighley West Yorkshire. Ghost Dimension investigate haunted Victorian Streets, used during the war as bombing shelters.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Brookside
programme.desc: Multiple ghostly sightings have been reported that could be connected to the close, but what will Sean and Bex encounter during the day for a special Ghost Dimension Lock Down investigation?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Forgotten Souls of Errwood Hall
programme.desc: Sean heads to the Errwood Hall ruins in the Goyt Valley. It is said to be haunted by 3 spirits, and that it has its very own time slip. The investigation does not disappoint and although the hall is gone, the spirits remain.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: House of Horror
programme.desc: Blackpool is iconic for ghosts and tonight, Sean and Bex investigate a horror attraction which appears to have attracted some very real spirits that are spooking its customers.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Thackray Medical Museum
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters investigate Thackray Medical Museum, believed to one of Leeds most haunted buildings. Workers claim to have witnessed constant paranormal activity in the museum and one claim is that two Victorian ghosts are trapped...

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Liverpool's Secret Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Bex and Sean delve deep into Woolton Hall, a derelict mansion in Liverpool. They appear to be forced out of the building by an unknown force and it takes its toll on one of the team members.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo: Not a Very Fun Day at The Beech Caves
programme.desc: Witchcraft, demons and ghosts have all been reported to haunt these caves. Sean investigates this network of tunnels deep underground and uncovers that all is not as it seems. This is not a day out at the seaside at Beech Caves.
programme.sub-title: Not a Very Fun Day at The Beech Caves

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 1
programme.desc: Many urban explorers have encountered paranormal activity inside of the building, including child like figures, unexplained voices and strange knocking sounds. Will anything from the ghost dimension make contact?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Norris Green Mansion. A 17th Century building, which is believed to hold some of the most haunted spirits in Liverpool. Will they make contact its ghostly entities tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Girlfriends: I Pity The Fool
programme.desc: Joan's new boyfriend Marcus has been moving a bit too fast and she realizes her heart was not in the relationship in the first place.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Girlfrenzy
programme.desc: With Maya and Joan becoming close friends, Toni becomes jealous and feels she's losing her best friend.

programme.title: Girlfriends: The Importance of Being Frank
programme.desc: Joan starts dating her client's very attractive accountant Keith, only to be stalked by his estranged wife.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Everything Fishy Ain’t Fish
programme.desc: Joan learns that Maya's husband may be cheating on her and must face whether or not it's a good idea to tell her friend. Toni dates a City Councilman who can help further her career.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Never A Bridesmaid
programme.desc: Maya and her partner Darnell decide they want to renew their vows and have a formal wedding ceremony. Joan offers to help with the event and to have it at her home.

programme.title: Girlfriends: The Remains of the Date
programme.desc: Joan is determined to play the ultimate Halloween prank on William and succeeds. Meanwhile, Toni is left to deal with her dates strange sexual fetish for stuffed animals.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Fried Turkey
programme.desc: On a holiday that emphasizes togetherness, Joan struggles with feelings of loneliness and separation on Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Pregnant Pause
programme.desc: Baby has never been in Joan's vocabulary until she gets the scare of her life and a new perspective on her priorities. As a result, the girls come together to give their love and support, showing their true Girlfriend friendship.

programme.title: Girlfriends: The List
programme.desc: Dreading another dateless weekend, the girls and William try Maya's suggestion to make a list of what they want in a mate.

programme.title: Girlfriends: They’ve Gotta Have It
programme.desc: Joan's new boyfriend Sean has not made a move on her after three weeks of dating and she is beginning to wonder why.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Bad Timing
programme.desc: Joan begins to question her relationship with Sean when he gives her a power drill for Valentine's and doesn't hear from him for three days.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Old Dog
programme.desc: Joan decides it is time to give in on her three-month rule and she is finally going to have sex with her boyfriend Sean.

programme.title: Girlfriends: The Declaration of Lynndependence
programme.desc: Joan and Toni decide that Lynn needs to learn to be independent. They give her a week to find a job, then she is on her own.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Friends, Colleagues, Brothers
programme.desc: Joan discovers that being the only black woman at her firm has many disadvantages and she is constantly ignored and overlooked.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Diss-regard
programme.desc: Maya checks into the hospital for her fibroid surgery and Joan has trouble managing her time between her boyfriend and her friends.

programme.title: Girlfriends: The Burning Vagina Monologues
programme.desc: Joan is stressing because Sean hasn't told her that he loves her.

programme.title: Girlfriends: A Kiss Before Lying
programme.desc: Sean notices that Joan always flirts with Davis. He gets jealous and tells Joan that she can never see Davis again or go back to 847.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: Joan opens her mouth and tells Greg about Toni and Clay.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Jamaic-Up?
programme.desc: Joan takes the girls to the Sinbad Music Festival to help ease Toni to get over her breakup with Greg.

programme.title: Girlfriends: The Fallout
programme.desc: The ladies return home from their very eventful trip to Jamaica where Joan unintentionally ruined Toni's relationship.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Just Say No
programme.desc: Joan continues to suffer in her troubled friendship with Toni and her new relationship with her therapist, Dr. Bales.

programme.title: Girlfriends: A Full Court Conspiracy
programme.desc: Torn between her two worlds, Joan struggles with her professional duty while at the same time dealing with the guilt that she is not being true to herself or her beliefs.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Un-Treatable
programme.desc: Maya buys a dress that is too expensive knowing it might cause problems with her husband, Darnell. Joan treats herself to a trip to New York to visit her boyfriend, realizing the distance between the two of them is a problem.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Buh-Bye
programme.desc: Joan ends the friendship between her and Toni after finding out that Toni has been discussing her personal life with co-workers behind her back. Meanwhile, Lynn is trying to cope with her new living situation with Vosco, and his lack of a job.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Willie or Won’t He
programme.desc: Yvonne is concerned that William is never going to marry her because they have not set a date for the wedding. When Yvonne asks Joan for advice, Joan tries her best to stay out of it but ends up telling Yvonne to move in with William first to try it out.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Joan’s Birthday Suit
programme.desc: For her thirtieth birthday, Joan finds that she is happy with who she is, yet finds that she’s not so happy that her father is a nudist.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Trick or Truth?
programme.desc: When Toni loses her friend Joan, her man, and her gold card, it’s up to Maya and Lynn to help her get her life back together.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Maya Takes a Stan
programme.desc: Due to marital tensions at home, an emotionally fragile Maya finds herself falling into a fantasy affair with a handsome and empathetic new friend, Stan.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Mom’s the Word
programme.desc: Toni meets a great man but is dumped after she’s a bad influence on his eight-year-old daughter. Joan dates a movie star but is dumped when he begins to think she’s stalking him.

programme.title: Girlfriends: You Better Watch Out
programme.desc: Maya refuses to end her relationship with Stan, despite her girlfriends' repeated warnings to do so.

programme.title: Girlfriends: I Have a Dream House
programme.desc: As a gesture of his love, William buys a beautiful house for his fiance, Yvonne.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Sister, Sistah
programme.desc: Lynn's Caucasian sister, Tanya, travels to LA to help Lynn celebrate her Gotcha Day: the day when Lynn's childhood adoption to her Caucasian family became legal.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Willie or Won’t He II: The Last Chapter
programme.desc: The week of William and Yvonne's wedding is finally here and all goes smoothly until Yvonne discovers William never told his mother about Yvonne...ever.
programme.sub-title: Willie or Won’t He II: The Last Chapter

programme.title: Girlfriends: Can’t Stan Ya
programme.desc: After a horrid kiss, Maya finally realizes she must end her relationship with Stan. Afterward, however, Stan deviously becomes good friends with Maya’s husband, just to make Maya squirm as he says he may or may not tell her husband about them.

programme.title: Girlfriends: Take Me Out After the Ball Game
programme.desc: As the company softball season kicks off, Joan falls for her new teammate: a young new employee from the mailroom; however, things go sour when she publicly dismisses their relationship due to their age difference.
programme.sub-title: Take Me Out After the Ball Game

programme.title: Girlfriends: Child’s in Charge
programme.desc: Toni decides to make something of her life by opening her own exclusive real estate agency after she sells a four-point-two million-dollar property.

programme.title: Girlfriends: X Does Not Mark the Spot
programme.desc: Joan becomes more adventurous with her boyfriend Chris, but inadvertently takes Ecstasy at a club with him and has a bad trip that puts her into the hospital.
programme.sub-title: X Does Not Mark the Spot

programme.title: Girlfriends: The Taming of the Realtess
programme.desc: Toni is frantic as the grand opening of her real estate agency is less than a week away.

programme.title: Girlfriends: My Mother, Myself
programme.desc: Just before Mother’s Day, Maya is disturbed when her mother announces she’s selling the house and moving to San Bernardino with her boyfriend. Toni has issues when her mother shows up unannounced for Mother’s Day and continually embarrasses her.

programme.title: Happy Days: Football Frolics
programme.desc: To raise money for the big football game, the boys decide to start their own babysitting service. In Football Frolics, Richie, Potsie and Ralph have their hopes set on seeing the big football game of the year, but tickets can't be found anywhere.

programme.title: Happy Days: Two Angry Men
programme.desc: When Fonzie sets a pigeon coop atop the Cunningham garage and the roof caves, Mr. Cunningham sues to collect damages. In Two Angry Men, Laverne and Shirley prevail upon Fonzie to care for a coop of pigeons.

programme.title: Happy Days: Sight for Sore Eyes
programme.desc: After reading too many foreign car manuals, Fonzie is plagued with headaches and is forced to wear glasses for a few weeks, but fears glasses aren't cool.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie Loves Pinky Part II
programme.desc: The Malachi brothers sabotage Pinky's car the night before the demolition derby.

programme.title: Happy Days: The Physical
programme.desc: A short-tempered sergeant loses his tenuous grasp on discipline when the Fonz reports to the army recruitment center soon after draftees Richie, Ralph and Potsie check in for physicals.

programme.title: Happy Days: The Apartment
programme.desc: Personality quirks begin to fray nerves after best friends Richie, Ralph, and Potsie rent an apartment together.

programme.title: Happy Days: Hard Cover
programme.desc: Richie and Fonzie must think fast to outwit a tough housemother after they're caught past curfew in the college girls' dormitory.

programme.title: Happy Days: Hollywood Part 2
programme.desc: Soon after getting the bad news that the studio deemed his James Dean impression obsolete, and gave Richie's wholesome good looks a contract instead, the Fonz finds a bigger fish to fry.

programme.title: Happy Days: Hollywood Part 3
programme.desc: Richie must choose either a 5-year Hollywood contract or college in Milwaukee while the Fonz accepts the California Kid's challenge to perform a dangerous water ski jump...over a shark!

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonsilectomy
programme.desc: Forced to spend the night in the hospital's children's ward, Fonzie worries more about who will be making time with his girl at the Halloween party than the tonsillectomy he's scheduled for the next morning.

programme.title: Happy Days: My Cousin the Cheat
programme.desc: Fonzie is furious with his rebellious cousin, Chachi Arcola, after Chachi cheats on a school test using answers stolen from a tutoring session with Joanie Cunningham.

programme.title: Happy Days: Nose is for News
programme.desc: To prove to his college journalism professor that he has what it takes to be a good investigative reporter, Richie gets down and dirty to expose who's behind an illegal garbage collection scheme.

programme.title: Happy Days: My Fair Fonzie
programme.desc: Snobby Cynthia Holmes schemes with her obnoxious cousin, Skippy, to make the Fonz look foolish at a country club soirée.

programme.title: Happy Days: Bye Bye Blackball
programme.desc: Richie, Ralph, and Potsie endure the harassment of "hell week" to prove themselves worthy to enter their college fraternity, Phi Kappa Nu.

programme.title: Happy Days: Joanie's First Kiss
programme.desc: Sophomore Joanie Cunningham gets basic back-seat defense tips from Richie and Fonzie before her first "car date" with a senior boy, and then cramps her older brother's style when she and her date show up at his college "make-out" party.

programme.title: Happy Days: Richie Almost Dies
programme.desc: What begins as a humorous escapade with a motorcycle turns into a tragic vigil for the Cunninghams and their friends.

programme.title: Happy Days: Do You Want to Dance
programme.desc: Fonzie's latest romantic interest, a ballet teacher, is secretly yearning to turn professional and dance with the greats in New York. Fonzie, however, has trouble accepting that she may forgo their relationship to pursue her dreams of fame.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fearless Malph
programme.desc: When Ralph Malph is hypnotized to cure his fright after a tornado warning is posted, Ralph's loss of fear causes him to tempt fate by suggesting that the Fonz needs training wheels for his stupid motorcycle

programme.title: Happy Days: Smokin' Ain'T Cool
programme.desc: Joanie believes she has to smoke to fit in with the cool girls. She ignores the pleas from her family to stop, until the Fonz defines what cool really means

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie's Blindness
programme.desc: In a poignant, change-of-pace episode titled Fonzie's Blindness, Al barges through the kitchen door at the drive-in and hits Fonzie in the head with a tray of food.

programme.title: Happy Days: Casanova Cunningham
programme.desc: When Richie is caught two-timing Lori Beth for a pretty baton twirler, the Fonz has to step in and give Richie a few lessons in love.

programme.title: Happy Days: Richie Gets Framed
programme.desc: Richie and the Fonz visit a massage parlor to escape the pressures of a heated class presidency race, and Richie's opposition photographs the sheet-clad candidate with a pretty masseuse.

programme.title: Happy Days: Potsie Quits School
programme.desc: When troubles with his studies and an insulting professor cause Potsie to quit school, the Fonz comes up with an ingenious but offbeat plan to help his friend.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie'S Funeral (Part 1)
programme.desc: In Part I, Fonzie is called to make emergency mechanical repairs on a stalled hearse and inadvertently discovers thousands of dollars in counterfeit money hidden in the coffin.

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie'S Funeral (Part 2)
programme.desc: In Part II, after Fonzie discovers thousands of dollars in counterfeit money in a hearse, the counterfeiters attempt to silence him.

programme.title: Happy Days: The Duel
programme.desc: The Fonz defends America's pride and saves Richie's hide when he matches blades with a French fencing champion, who not only insults the country, but makes nasty remarks about Joanie

programme.title: Happy Days: Fonzie Gets Shot
programme.desc: During a week-end at Potsie's uncle's hunting cabin, Fonzie is accidentally shot in the vicinity of his favorite jeans' back pocket.

programme.title: Happy Days: American Musical
programme.desc: Struggling to write a school essay on America's immigrant history, Chachi is inspired by Fonzie's colorful story told to the tune of an imagined melting pot melody.

programme.title: Happy Days: Grandma Nussbaum
programme.desc: Grandma Nussbaum teaches Fonzie and Chachi a lesson in growing old gracefully when they try to convince the feisty granny to move into a retirement home.

programme.title: Happy Days: A Night at the Circus
programme.desc: Howard's teen-aged niece, K.C., comes to stay with the Cunninghams after a scandal closes her Houston boarding school while Fonzie hopes a night at the circus will help him win little Heather's heart when nothing else seems to work.

programme.title: Happy Days: Where the Guys Are
programme.desc: After tricking Fonzie into going to a single's camp to help him get over losing steady girlfriend Ashley, Potsie, Chachi and Roger get suckered into a sauna by three con-girls.

programme.title: Tiny House Nation
programme.desc: A family of four prepares to move out of its large house near Dallas and into a tiny house; John and Zack attempt to maximize space for the homeschooled children and the sentimental record collection that the father just can't part with.

programme.title: Tiny House Nation

programme.desc: Marty deals with his newest clients, hip-hop clothing moguls Dre Collins and Lukas Frye, who have divergent attitudes and plans for their company, DollaHyde. Jeannie defines her new role. Clyde turns to Marty for help.

programme.title: House of Lies
programme.desc: Marty and Jeannie launch a duplicitous plan to remove Lukas from DollaHyde. Clyde woos Marissa, a big client to bring to Kaan & Associates; and Doug deals with his feelings about having a baby with Sarah.

programme.title: House of Lies
programme.desc: Marty is tested by Dre and considers a double cross. Meanwhile, Jeannie learns that Lukas has become suspicious of their plan. A displaced Clyde tries to make headway with Marty, while Doug makes a fatal mistake.

programme.desc: Marty and Jeannie have different approaches on how to deal with Lukas' attempts to sabotage DollaHyde. The relationship between Roscoe and Lex becomes a problem for Marty.

programme.title: House of Lies
programme.desc: Marty and the team execute a plan to wrestle Marissa's family's media company away from her siblings. Jeannie encourages Marty to let Clyde out of the doghouse. Doug and Sarah's relationship is tested.

programme.title: House of Lies
programme.desc: Marty and the Pod accompany Lukas on a tour through his old neighborhood. Monica seeks help from Kaan & Associates on a new food product. Roscoe is embarrassed by Lex.

programme.title: House of Lies
programme.desc: Jeannie reaches out to an old friend for help, causing an issue between her and Marty about their future with DollaHyde. Clyde creates friction between Monica and her client, Vincent; and Doug makes a play for Caitlin.

programme.title: House of Lies
programme.desc: Emotions run high as Marty and Jeannie deal with the aftermath of a tragic event. Meanwhile, Doug attempt to reconcile with Sarah, and Marissa makes a business decision that affects her relationship with Clyde.

programme.desc: Kaan & Associates get a serious legal blow. Jeannie attempts to rectify the situation, fearful she is the one responsible for it. Roscoe finds an constructive outlet to help work through his relationship issues.

programme.desc: Marty and The Pod are sent to Phoenix to clean up a mess at a very powerful sports franchise caused by the impending divorce of its high-powered owners; Jeannie has dinner with an old flame but is deflated when she finds out his real intentions.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy plays the dominant parent role in their son's life. Realizing that he needs to spend more time with his son, Ricky agrees to spend his vacation at home to care for little Ricky.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: The Ricardos are hosting an evening with friends. When the last guest to arrive introduces his date—all the men at the party fawn over her. Disgusted by the men's behavior, Lucy and Ethel begin to doubt their own feminine wiles.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy and Ricky's thirteenth anniversary is rapidly approaching. In an outward show of affection, they buy each other gifts—golf clubs for Ricky and fur for Lucy.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: The Ricardos are being interviewed for a "day-in-the-life" magazine article on happy married couples. The interviewer arrives at 7 AM just in time to encounter Lucy making breakfast in a frilly lace apron, while Ricky walks in wearing a smoking jacket.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: The Mertzes get a pair of new tenants. Sam and Nancy Johnson are from Texas and reportedly have inside knowledge of a certain oil stock that is about to shoot through the roof. Lucy and Ethel are excited by the prospect, but Fred and Ricky have doubts.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: How long can Ricky Ricardo go, without losing his temper? When Lucy buys a new hat for $49.50, Ricky goes ballistic. To make a point, Lucy bets Ricky the cost of the hat that he'll lose his temper long before her next purchase.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Hurt that no one seems to care for his home movies, Ricky declares that he will never show them another feature of his...not even the TV pilot he's creating. Jealous of his project, Lucy enables the help of the Mertzes and creates her own musical western.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky scoffs at his wife and Ethel when they adamantly participate in the hunt for the "Bonus Buck" that will win them prize money from a newspaper contest. Later, Ricky discovers one of the lucky bucks in his own wallet.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy desperately wants to accompany her husband on his concert tour of Hawaii, but Ricky can't afford to bring her along. Unsatisfied, Lucy decides she'll win a trip for herself and neighbors, The Mertzes, by entering a television game show contest.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: In an attempt to compete with her wealthy friends, Lucy pledges $500 (that she doesn't have) to charity. Luckily, Ethel spots an ad in Billboard magazine willing to pay $500 to anyone willing to perform a stunt to publicize a new movie, Women From Mars.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy wants to be a published author after hearing about another housewife who made a fortune doing it. Ricky and the Mertzes don't like it when they discover Lucy's book plays too close a resemblance to real life including anecdotes from their own lives.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy organizes an orchestra among her girlfriends, but it plays so horribly that she asks her bandleader husband, Ricky, to come to a rehearsal and give them some advice. His direction does little to help.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy decides to try a new look, despite her husband Ricky's objections. She borrows a black wig from her hairdresser Roberta, who tells Lucy it makes her look like a whole different person. With that in mind, Lucy decides to play a little trick on Ricky.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky becomes interested in a diner that is for sale so the Ricardos and the Mertzes all buy it together. Right away, Ethel and Fred feel they are doing all the work while Lucy and Ricky have all the fun.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy's mother writes to ask if she and her husband "Xavier" would be so kind as to entertain "a friend's roommate's cousin's middle boy, Ernest" when he visits New York.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy and Ricky, tired of the extensive visit by their cousin Tennessee Ernie, try to get rid of the likeable character by pleading poverty. Ernie then tries to help his gracious hosts out of their fiscal desperation.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Golf pro, Jimmy Demaret, visits Lucy and Ethel on the green to show them how the game is really played after they're misled by Ricky and Fred. Lucy and Ethel decide they'll learn how to play golf to spend more time with their husbands.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky books a two-month summer job in Maine and decides to take Lucy and Little Ricky. For the summer, they want to sublet their apartment at a profit, but their friends and landlords, the Mertzes, are not in favor.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky Ricardo hires business manager Mr. Hickox to solve the family budget problems. Lucy, dissatisfied with her new $5 per month allowance, manages to find a loophole in the business manager's system.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy agrees to help her neighbor Fred Mertz impress an old vaudeville buddy who's in town for a visit. Lucy poses as the Mertzes maid "Bessie" to make Barney Kurtz believe Fred hit it big in real estate.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy feigns a crisis to test Ricky's love after hearing a story about a woman whose husband ignored her pleas for help while being robbed—she assumes Ricky would turn his back on her too.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy plays Cupid and tries to bag a bachelor for a husband-hungry girlfriend. Lucy organizes an evening to show her unmarried friends, Dorothy and Sam, how wonderful marriage is.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky agrees reluctantly to host a new television show, sponsored by Phipps Department Store, and learns they'd like him to host with his wife Lucy. When Lucy finds out that Ricky didn't want her in the show, she sets out to sabotage the program.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: When Ben Benjamin arrives at the Ricardos' apartment, Lucy mistakes Ben Benjamin, a Hollywood talent scout, for a burglar and nearly ruins Ricky's chance for a film career.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy sees Ricky's screen test as an opportunity to get discovered as a new movie star.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy Ricardo meets her Spanish-speaking mother-in-law for the first time and her efforts to be a gracious host turn disastrous. Lucy's inability to speak Spanish and her in-law's inability to understand Lucy's pantomime erects a wall of misunderstanding.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Despite the reservations of her husband, Lucy decides to help Fred pick out a birthday present for Ethel. She picks out a pair of toreador pants, which Ethel thinks are unflattering as well as too big.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky Ricardo paces the floor, awaiting word from Hollywood about his screen test. Lucy can't use the phone for fear the line will be busy when Ben Benjamin tries to call for Ricky.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: A movie contract for Ricky necessitates a change in scenery and the hanging of a "for rent" sign on the Ricardos' New York home. The Mertzes, willing to give up tenants but not friends, sign on for the trip.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: For their trip out west, Ricky buys a new car to replace the old, beat-up one Fred bought. Lucy convinces her husband to teach her how to drive it. After one driving lesson, Ricky is a harried and beaten man.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy's mother wants to join the Ricardos on their road trip out west. As anticipated, Ricky blows his stack when he hears that Lucy's mother wants to go along, and continues to complain that everyone's going on the trip.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: The Ricardos and the Mertzes have a hard time finding accommodations that will please everyone on their trip to California. Ricky is driving and sacrifices his passengers' appetites for the sake of making mileage.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: The Ricardos and the Mertzes are arrested when they're caught speeding in Bent Fork, Tennessee. Although Ricky just wants to pay the fine, Lucy protests that they are being treated unfairly.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy decides to break into show business by writing a play about a Cuban tobacco picker and entering it in her women's club play competition. Of course she wants Ricky to star in it but he refuses.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: The Mertzes enjoy an evening singing around the piano with the Ricardos in their apartment. When they retire for the night and Lucy and Ricky continue singing, Ethel phones them demanding quiet.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy is reading "The Mockingbird Murder Mystery" when Ethel reads her fortune and tells her death is near. Later she overhears a conversation between Ricky and his agent and she jumps to the wrong conclusion that he's trying to do away with her.
programme.sub-title: Lucy Thinks Ricky Is Trying To Murder Her

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: To celebrate the Mertzes' wedding anniversary, Fred and Ricky want to go to a prizefight, but the girls want to get dressed up and go to a nightclub. An argument ensues and Lucy threatens to find two other escorts if their husbands won't take them.
programme.sub-title: The Girls Want to Go to A Nightclub

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy decides Ricky's love is growing cold so she takes Ethel's advice she learned from a book, How to Keep the Honeymoon from Ending. Her attempt to dress up for breakfast doesn't yield any response from Ricky.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: One of the girls in Ricky's show quits, creating a vacancy which Lucy wants to fill. She goes down for an audition and can have the part provided she loses twelve ponds in four days to fit into the previous singer's size 12 outfit.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: When Ricky cuts off Lucy's allowance and charge accounts because of her careless spending, Lucy finds herself short of funds. Ethel has tickets to a radio quiz show that has a cash prize of $1,000.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Network television scouts are going to check out Ricky's band and Lucy tries to "get into the act" in order to be discovered as well. Of course Ricky will not hear of it.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy becomes interested in numerology and advises Ricky that it is a good day for him to make any deals he can. However, she soon realizes that she consulted the horoscope from yesterday's newspaper.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: When Ricky leaves his clothes around the living room, Lucy gets angry and divides the room in half so Ricky can be as messy as he likes - on his side!

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky brings home a $3,500 mink coat to be used in his nightclub act, and Lucy assumes it's her anniversary present. Trying to get the coat away from her becomes a problem because Lucy not only wears it while she does housework, she even sleeps in it.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ethel Mertz interprets a gossip column item to mean that Ricky is interested in one of the chorus girls in his nightclub. Ricky assures Lucy that it's just publicity.
programme.sub-title: Lucy Is Jealous of Girl Singer

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy opens a telegram addressed to Ricky from the War Department ordering him to appear at the Army's Fort Dix. This letter plus the drills Ricky and Fred have been practicing in the living room convince the women that their husbands have been drafted.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy learns that Ricky needs a dancer for his Parisian nightclub act and is determined to get the part. Fred offers to teach her how to dance but Ethel arranges instead to have the nephew of the woman who runs the French laundry to give pointers.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ethel wants Ricky to headline a benefit for her women's club. Lucy will only try to arrange it if she is on the bill as well. After hearing Lucy's terrible singing voice, Ethel is less than eager, but eventually agrees.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy buys a costly dress, and when Ricky tells her to take it back or pay for it herself, she decides to get a job. She answers an ad for a babysitter and finds herself in charge of high-spirited twin boys who are to appear in an amateur contest.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy's neighbor Miss Lewis has a crush on Mr. Ritter, the local grocer but istoo shy to invite him to dinner. Trying to play Cupid, Lucy invites him for her but he gets the idea that Lucy has fallen for him. Apparently Mr. Ritter is fond of Lucy as well.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: In a deception planned to convince Ricky that she ought to be in his new nightclub act, Lucy pretends to have a nervous breakdown. She consults a book on abnormal psychology that reveals three complexes she assumes.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy decides to break into show business by writing a play about a Cuban tobacco picker and entering it in her women's club play competition. Of course she wants Ricky to star in it but he refuses.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: The Mertzes enjoy an evening singing around the piano with the Ricardos in their apartment. When they retire for the night and Lucy and Ricky continue singing, Ethel phones them demanding quiet.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky needs a ballet dancer and a burlesque comic for his club's new musical revue. Lucy wants the ballet gig and takes dance lessons from a strict instructor. Learning the disciplined art is much more difficult than she imagined.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Peggy, a teenage neighbor, breaks up with her boyfriend Arthur because she is infatuated with Ricky. Lucy tries to help the clumsy schoolboy learn how to dance in order to win back Peggy's affections. To complicate matters more, Arthur falls for Lucy.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy and Ethel are eager to get a closer look at the belongings of the O'Briens, new neighbors in the building. They snoop around in their apartment while they are away and when they hear the O'Briens return, Lucy is trapped in the closet.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: After the Mertzes have a quarrel the Ricardos try their best to get them back together. Lucy invites each of them to dinner without the other knowing. The Mertzes finally reconcile but in the process, the Ricardos squabble.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy hates the mustache that Ricky grows for a potential movie role and demands that he shave it off. When he refuses, Lucy gets a fake beard and glues it on her face. To teach Ricky a lesson, she kisses her husband with the beard on when he arrives home.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: When Ricky forbids Lucy from gossiping, she tapes her mouth shut but reveals the latest rumor to Ethel through charades. However, it seems it's the proverbial black pot and kettle when Ricky shares with Fred a spicy tidbit about one of his band members.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy and Ethel are tired of their dishpan hands and demand dishwashers from their husbands. They also don't think the Society Matrons League, a club they want to join, would approve. Their husbands believe they have it easy compared to the olden days.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: A close inspection of her marriage license convinces Lucy that she and Ricky are not legally married. Because his name is misspelled on the certificate, Lucy insists Ricky go through the entire courtship and ultimately the marriage ceremony again.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky discovers a wad of cash in Lucy's purse and closet full of strange valuables and assumes they're all her ill-gotten gains. He doesn't realize Lucy has been legitimately collecting for her club's fundraising bazaar.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy feels left out when Ricky's two Cuban friends visit and converse mainly in Spanish. When she learns that little Renita, someone Ricky once danced with, is coming to town, she insists they reunite for a number.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Lucy and Ethel acquire a walk-in meat freezer. In an attempt to save money, they order two sides of beef, not realizing this is a tremendous amount. Hundreds of pounds of meat and $483 later, they must figure out a way to unload the beef.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: Ricky is the emcee for a television variety show and Lucy wants to appear in one of its commercials. To prove to her husband that she has screen presence, she removes the inner parts of their TV set, gets into it, and does a commercial as he arrives home.

programme.title: I Love Lucy
programme.desc: As a publicity stunt to further Ricky's career, Lucy pretends she's an exotic princess from "Franistan" who has traveled halfway around the world to see Ricky perform. She books a suite at the Waldorf-Astoria and gets a lot of press attention.
