programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po's friend Peng returns to the Valley of Peace, everyone is excited...except for Po. What no one else knows is that Peng is actually evil Tai Lung's nephew. Now Po has to admit to powerful Peng that he is the one who skadooshed his uncle.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: As the annual Winter Festival approaches, Po doesn't have enough money to buy his dad the present he deserves, so he takes a job as a bounty hunter to capture a dangerous escaped convict for the reward. But Po's plan doesn't go as smooth as he hoped.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po takes on the challenge of training a lovable but klutzy member of the Emperor's family. However, will Po's training be enough to protect them both from the evil designs of a traitor in their midst?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: After dealing Taotie yet another humiliating defeat, Po is horrified to learn that the villainous warthog has had a full on nervous breakdown. Po is determined to heal his spirit and Taotie is eager to change his evil ways...or is he?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po's fake love letter prank on Monkey backfires, the duo's relationship is put to the test in a story of jealousy, betrayal and, yes, even kidnapping.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is sad when he learns that everyone has been invited to a dinner party except for him, due to his poor table manners. Will Shifu be able to teach Po proper etiquette AND foil the attack of evil Temutai and his army?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Shifu's ex-girlfriend, Mei Ling, visits the Jade Palace, Po decides to try and get them back together, despite the fact Mei Ling is now Shifu's most hated enemy.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and Tigress must track down and stop a messenger from delivering a scroll that could thrust China into all-out war!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Crane's mom visits the Valley of Peace. Crane reveals to Po that his mom hates Kung Fu so he promised her that he would never have anything to do with it. Crane asks Po and the others to help him keep his secret from his mom.
programme.sub-title: Mama Told Me not to Kung Fu

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Self-conscious about his size, Mantis ingests a growth potion that makes him huge. Mantis is initially thrilled with the results, but soon his large size puts the entire village and his friends in grave danger.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: With Po and the Furious Five at each other's throats, Shifu takes them all on a disastrous road trip.
programme.sub-title: The Secret Museum of Kung Fu

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Fung finds an old scroll with instructions for making living terra cotta warriors, and soon it's up to Po and the Five to stop his monstrous clay creation.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po is possessed by the ghost of evil Master Ding, it's up to Tigress to save him before Ding can unleash his powers and enslave the Valley of Peace.
programme.sub-title: The Spirit Orbs of Master Ding

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Master Chao visits the valley to oversee a Tournament. Shifu is convinced that Po and Master Chao want to replace him. Shifu's old enemy, Pai Mei, arrives in the middle of the tournament and threatens to destroy Shifu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Master Yao returns to the Jade Palace and announces that he's offering the Valley of Peace a one-day "Wonder and Wisdom Exchange." Anyone who brings him a new wonder will be allowed to ask him a single question.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po saves a girl from some bandits, only to learn that she's engaged to be married to the Dragon Warrior

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: During a fight with Tong Fo, Po is struck by lightning, giving him the power to read minds.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Thanks to Po, Hundun opens up his own noodle shop in the village, threatening to put Mr. Ping out of business.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Over Po's objections, Shifu calls in a noble Samurai prawn to help take down a villain from Japan.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Shifu suggests Po takes a vow of silence to help him focus, but his plan goes awry when the panda starts an armed conflict by keeping his mouth shut.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Once deemed a hero, cobra Fu-xi has turned renegade and is attacking the Valley of Peace. When the villagers adopt an anti-snake sentiment, will Viper help stop Fu-xi...or join him?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: The local thugs love Mr. Ping's soup so much, the noodle shop becomes a villain hangout...with Mr. Ping as their unknowing crime boss!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po befriends a group of young (and adorable) orphans-who also happen to be stealing money and goods from the villagers. Will Po be able to reform the kids or fall into the clutches of their evil leader?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Fed up with his constant complaining, Shifu puts lazy Po in charge of training the Furious Five. Things go from bad to worse when the Croc Bandits receive training from a mysterious kung fu master and become the new heroes of the Valley of Peace.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.desc: During a fight with Tong Fo, Po is struck by lightning, giving him the power to read minds.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Thanks to Po, Hundun opens up his own noodle shop in the village, threatening to put Mr. Ping out of business.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Over Po's objections, Shifu calls in a noble Samurai prawn to help take down a villain from Japan.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Shifu suggests Po takes a vow of silence to help him focus, but his plan goes awry when the panda starts an armed conflict by keeping his mouth shut.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Once deemed a hero, cobra Fu-xi has turned renegade and is attacking the Valley of Peace. When the villagers adopt an anti-snake sentiment, will Viper help stop Fu-xi...or join him?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: The local thugs love Mr. Ping's soup so much, the noodle shop becomes a villain hangout...with Mr. Ping as their unknowing crime boss!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po befriends a group of young (and adorable) orphans-who also happen to be stealing money and goods from the villagers. Will Po be able to reform the kids or fall into the clutches of their evil leader?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Fed up with his constant complaining, Shifu puts lazy Po in charge of training the Furious Five. Things go from bad to worse when the Croc Bandits receive training from a mysterious kung fu master and become the new heroes of the Valley of Peace.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is named Head of Imperial Security when klutzy Lu Kang returns to the Valley of Peace as emperor. When an evil menace rises to take over all of China, Po has to turn to some surprising allies in order to save the day.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Shifu sends Po to shut down an underground fight club, the panda disobeys his master and joins the club instead.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Five have to stop a famine by bringing a maniacal gang of food-thieving rats to justice. But, will Po's weakness for food alienate himself from his friends and the very villagers he is trying to help

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po discovers the seeds of Shuyong: magical items that can actually take the user back in time. After Po disobeys Shifu, evil Fenghuang steals one of the seeds, putting the entire world in danger.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po's qi is out of balance. He and his friends attempt to re-harmonize the panda using the tradition of musical kung fu. They better work fast, as only Po can stop the destruction of the Eternal Chord and un-creating the universe.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po has to help Master Yao after Taotie and Bian Zao steal the Mystic Secrets of Kung Fu right out of the master's head.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Shifu's evil ex-girlfriend Mei Ling is back...and back together with Shifu! Dubious Po must find out if she is on the level or just using Shifu for her own criminal gain.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and Monkey discover a small village and meet an impostor claiming to be the Dragon Warrior. Po is determined to expose the fraud but could end up doing more harm than good.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po throws a party and invites the First Furious Five to attend, everyone is shocked to learn that Shifu may not be the courageous hero that they thought he was.

programme.title: Winners and Sinners
programme.desc: Fem vänner som just kommit ut ur fängelset försöker hålla sig fria från brott, men hamnar oavsiktligt i ett triadkrig. Denna film visas utan undertexter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
programme.desc: Sköldpaddorna tror att deras fiende Shredder är död sedan han fallit i sopkrossen i slutet av föregående film. Fotklanen har fått reda på deras gömställe i kloakerna och därför bor de tillfälligt hos journalisten April.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III
programme.desc: Det hela börjar med att en magisk spira transporterar deras goda vän April genom tid och rum, ända till samurajernas Japan. Leonardo och gänget ger sig genast av efter henne, och måste nu besegra den elake Lord Naringa för att rädda den inspärrade April.

programme.title: Black Mask
programme.desc: En överlevande från ett supersoldatprojekt måste kämpa mot sina gamla kamrater som en maskerad hjälte. Denna film visas utan undertexter.

programme.title: Royal Warriors
programme.desc: Michelle Yip är kung fu-expert. Michael Wong, som arbetar med flygsäkerhet, är förälskad i henne. Yamamoto är tystlåten, hårdkokt och har lämnat Tokyos poliskår för att tillbringa tid med sin familj. Denna film visas utan undertexter.

programme.title: The Prodigal Son
programme.desc: Leung upptäcker att hans far iscensätter alla hans matcher för att vinna. Upprörd över detta hittar han en riktig mästare för att lära sig kung fu. Denna film visas utan undertexter.

programme.title: Winners and Sinners
programme.desc: Fem vänner som just kommit ut ur fängelset försöker hålla sig fria från brott, men hamnar oavsiktligt i ett triadkrig. Denna film visas utan undertexter.

programme.title: Armor of God 2: Operation Condor
programme.desc: Jackie anlitas för att hjälpa FN att hitta nazisternas guld som är gömt i Sahara. Eftersom det finns andra som vill ha guldet följer massor av kung fu-slagsmål och komedi. Denna film visas utan undertexter.

programme.title: The Canton Godfather SV
programme.desc: Wah anländer till Hongkong, och vet knappt ordet av innan han blivit avlurad sina pengar. Han köper en ros från en fattig blomförsäljare som menar att hennes blommor för med sig lycka och välgång. Och mycket riktigt, Wah finner snart att turen har vänt.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men
programme.desc: Efter att ha bevittnat mordet på sin far tränar ”Little Mute” i Shaolin-templet för att hämnas, där han undervisas av olika lärare. Denna film visas utan undertexter.

programme.title: Winners and Sinners
programme.desc: Fem venner bliver løsladt fra fængslet. De har bestemt sig for at leve hæderlige liv fremover, og sammen starter de et rengøringsfirma. Men samme dag løslades også en sjette fange og hans planer er at tjene penge på falskmøntneri.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III
programme.desc: Et magisk scepter transporterer deres gode ven April gennem tid og sted, helt til samuraiernes Japan. Leonardo og de andre tager straks af sted efter hende og skal nu besejre den onde Lord Naringa for at redde den indespærrede April.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
programme.desc: Skildpadderne tror, at deres fjende Shredder døde, da han faldt i affaldsknuseren i slutningen af den foregående film. Fodklanen har opdaget på deres skjulested i kloakkerne, og derfor padderne hos journalisten April.

programme.title: The Big Boss DA
programme.desc: Knægten fra byen, Cheng har en fortid fuld af ballade, men får lov til at tage ud til sine fætre på landet for at arbejde på deres fabrik, forudsat, at han ikke roder sig ud i noget. Da familien pludselig forsvinder har Cheng ikke noget valg...

programme.title: Armor of God
programme.desc: Jackie Chan spiller en eventyrer, der sammen med sin hjælper må tage til Europa, da en religiøs sekt kidnapper hans ungdomskærlighed for at afpresse ham og få fingre i den tredje del af den legendariske rustning Armour of God.

programme.title: Wheels on Meals DA
programme.desc: Thomas og David lader livet gå sin gang, og kører med deres madbod gennem Barcelonas gader. Men hverdagen bliver pludselig afbrudt, da de efter et møde med en motorcykelbande møder en smuk lommetyv, Sylvia, som søger beskyttelse mod banden.

programme.title: Fist of Fury DA
programme.desc: Da Chen Zhen vender tilbage til sin gamle kampsportsskole, bliver han mødt af den tragiske nyhed, at hans mester er død. Snart opdager han, at der er mystiske omstændigheder omkring mesterens død, og han bestemmer sig for på egen hånd at søge hævn.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donatello, Rafael, Michelangelo og Leonardo er muterede grønne ninja-skildpadder som elsker pizza og lever under New York. Derfra tager de kampen op mod den ondskabsfulde forbryder Shredder og hans hær af sortklædte krigere.

programme.title: Winners and Sinners
programme.desc: Fem venner bliver løsladt fra fængslet. De har bestemt sig for at leve hæderlige liv fremover, og sammen starter de et rengøringsfirma. Men samme dag løslades også en sjette fange og hans planer er at tjene penge på falskmøntneri.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: The Secret of the Ooze
programme.desc: Skilpaddene tror at deres fiende Shredder er død etter at han falt i søppelknuseren i slutten av forrige film. Fotklanen har fått vite om deres gjemmested i kloakken og derfor bor de midlertidig hos journalisten April.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles III
programme.desc: Det hele begynner med en at en magisk spire transporterer deres gode venn April gjennom tid og rom, helt til samuraienes Japan. Leonardo og gjengen drar med en gang etter henne, og må nå beseire den onde Lord Naringa for å redde April.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men
programme.desc: Etter å ha vært vitne til drapet på sin far, trener «Little Mute» i Shaolin-tempelet for å ta hevn, der han blir undervist av ulike lærere. Denne filmen vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Lucky Stars NO
programme.desc: En informant på ferie i Thailand blir kontaktet og drept av mafiaens lakeier, men i sitt siste åndedrag forteller han til fullmektige Woo at han sendte et brev med informasjonen til en venn hjemme i Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Canton Godfather
programme.desc: Wah vet knapt ordet av det før han har blitt fralurt pengene sine. Han legger de siste slantene på en rose fra en blomsterhandler som mener at blomstene hennes fører med seg lykke og velstand. Og riktig nok ser Wah snart at flaksen har snudd.

programme.title: The Killer Meteors
programme.desc: Hua Wu Bin blir kalt The Killer Meteor takket være hans unike hemmelige kampkunster, som har gjort ham til en helt i hjemtraktene. Når en adelsmann blir forgiftet av sin kone, blir Hua leid inn for å få tak i en kur og beseire henne.

programme.title: Dragon Lord
programme.desc: Jakten på kjærligheten og rampestrekene til Dragon og barndomsvennen Buller blir avbrytt når de hører at en gjeng begynner å smugle kinesiske nasjonal skatter utenlands. Denne filmen vises uten undertekster.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: 16-Year-Old Surrogate Stole Our Baby
programme.desc: Sarah was Dawn and Derek's surrogate, but took off while five months pregnant. Sarah claims that they took advantage of her. Who are the baby's rightful parents?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Ever Have My Baby?
programme.desc: Since he never saw evidence of her pregnancy, Robert is here to find out if his ex-girlfriend Sara was ever pregnant with their child. What will his lie detector results reveal?
programme.sub-title: Did You Ever Have My Baby?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Do I Have a Child With a Gay Man?
programme.desc: Are Tracy and Latonia's men leading secret double lives with other men? What will the lie detector test results reveal about Kanecha and Mike?
programme.sub-title: Do I Have a Child With a Gay Man?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...
programme.desc: Sharina thinks that Clarence is cheating on her because he’s always out late. Plus, Chrystal doesn’t want Earnie’s ex Tenyia to live with them just because she’s the mother of his child.
programme.sub-title: Wait! Don't Read The Results Yet Steve...

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Shocking Betrayal
programme.desc: Korey is positive that his girlfriend Dominique is cheating on him and is also worried that she might be selling sex. She says that his suspicions have caused him to become abusive. Then, Gregory thinks that his girlfriend Robin isn’t faithful!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
programme.desc: Russell wants to put his family back together after his three children died in a fire. Next, Tatiana believes her 2-year-old nephew was abused. And she's accusing her sister's ex-fiancé Chris. Chris says he's not an abuser.
programme.sub-title: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Invasion of the Angry Lovers
programme.desc: Josh and Amy will find out today that their partners have been unfaithful. Next, Madeline reveals to Andre that she's been sleeping with Diante. Then, Quincy is engaged to Callie but she doesn't know that Quincy has been cheating with Amy.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: High Class Call Girls
programme.desc: Bambi gives us a rare, honest look into her ultra-exclusive lifestyle in LA. Tiffany confronts C.T. over a rotten business deal.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Bridezillas Attack!
programme.desc: Heather says that her fiancé Bud might cheating with her friend. Summer won't let the love of her life marry her cousin Kelly. Plus, Cherie is here to stop her daughter's wedding.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show
programme.desc: Pimp Hotlanta will set Nika straight about their relationship. Stephanie confronts her pal Erika for having sex with her man. Gloria was crushed when she found out that her sister stole her man.
programme.sub-title: I'm Your Pimp, Not Your Boyfriend

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: It's Your Fault I'm Cheating!
programme.desc: Anita is ready to dump her husband for her ex-lover. Next, Theresa is cheating on her fiancé with his brother! Later, Kevin is here to tell his girlfriend's ex, Jermaine, to back off.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show
programme.desc: Jerry is 58 years old and has had three big changes. He is currently happily engaged to a woman named Joy and speaks about his past gender confusion.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Sizzling Sex Secrets!
programme.desc: Torrance admits to cheating on his girlfriend with a shocking twist. Then, Heather wants her boyfriend’s ex Tramisha to stop interfering with their relationship.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Secret Sex Lives
programme.desc: Greg will reveal to his girlfriend, Deidra, that he secretly works as a gay, male escort. Madrina's boyfriend keeps cheating on her with his ex. Then, Ro-Ro has two girlfriends and today they'll force her to choose between them.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Fiery Ultimatums
programme.desc: Punching princesses face off! Naomi suspects that her lover is cheating on her. Kristy and Emmy force Adam to choose! Lori admits how much she hates her son's fiancée!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have A Secret For My Man!
programme.desc: Friends Tatiana and Latasha have both been keeping a big secret from their boyfriends! Today they're here to come clean!
programme.sub-title: I Have A Secret For My Man!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man
programme.desc: Jackie’s family doesn't trust her boyfriend around her children, but she insists on staying with him. What horrible truth will Shaqualla's lie detector test reveal about her man?
programme.sub-title: I Punch a Woman like I Punch a Man

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve, I Think He's Gay
programme.desc: Monique’s friend claims that Adrian advertised himself on a “Gay for Pay” website. Then, pregnant Tyeasha suspects David of cheating on her with men. What will the polygraph say?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant
programme.desc: Megan is 14 and pregnant with 19 year old Michael’s baby, but he doesn’t see any problems with this situation. Laurie, Megan’s mother, turns to Steve to help get through to her!
programme.sub-title: I Got a 14 Year Old Pregnant

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Better Not Fail That Test!
programme.desc: Lainie and Justin have a 9-month-old baby together. Justin hurts Lainie because he thinks she’s cheating. But how will Steve react when he confronts Justin?
programme.sub-title: You Better Not Fail That Test!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Failed Five Times?
programme.desc: Michelle's current boyfriend Everett can't run from Robert's allegations about his daughter. Will Everett's lie detector test results prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: How Could You Cover for Him?
programme.desc: Gina believes that her daughter’s boyfriend Efrain is abusing her grandson. Her daughter wants to prove that Efrain is innocent, but her father Raul suspects she is covering for Efrain.
programme.sub-title: How Could You Cover for Him?

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Charlie tries to connect a series of murders to a voter fraud conspiracy and must track down who benefits the most from the rigged elections before more people die.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When a small plane mysteriously crashes, Charlie tests the flight computer and uncovers the truth behind what brought the plane down.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: While on the hunt for a serial letter bomber, Don and Charlie disagree over whether a suspected bomber, who had eluded conviction years earlier, is the person responsible for the latest murder.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don believes that a death row inmate has an ulterior motive when he suddenly wants to confess the whereabouts of bodies he buried during his days as a hit man for the mob.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and the FBI uncover a possible terrorist attack on Los Angeles that targets the city's water supply.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When thieves hijack a truck filled with valuable medical supplies, $50 million dollars intended for a relief effort in Zambia and two aid workers, the FBI races a second violent crew intent on getting to the goods first.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: In the wake of a deadly standoff with a mysterious, yet, brilliant bomber, Don and Charlie discover that he was poisoned to keep him from exposing a shocking secret that will change the FBI team forever, on the third season finale.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Agent Colby Granger lands in prison after the discovery that he was a mole within the FBI, but he escapes, and it's up to Don and his team to track him down and uncover the truth on the fourth season premiere.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: A typical morning at a coffee shop turns into a nightmare when a car collides into it, leaving one person dead and many injured. But what appears to be a car's accidental loss of control is soon exposed to be more.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: A series of secrets and blackmail involving a young, up and coming actor are exposed when Don and his team investigate the murder of a young woman in his Hollywood Hills mansion.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: After recognizing numerological patterns in the Bible verses that the killer leaves behind, Don and his team are able to track the killer's movements but are one step behind when a gripping twist brings the chase to an end.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: A bank for the rich and powerful is robbed but the stolen contents of the safety deposit boxes are being liquidated and donated to charities, and it's up to Don and Charlie to uncover the true motivation behind the humanitarian thief.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don feels responsible for the death of a participant in the Witness Protection Program after she is gunned down in her home.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and the team investigate the secret world of alternate reality games after a man plunges to his death while participating in one such game. Amita's life is in danger when her hidden gaming ability becomes the key to tracking down the killer.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When a mega-heiress is abducted by an extremist group looking to punish her industrialist father, Don and the team rush to find her captors, but their attempt to save her takes a startling turn when they to uncover the group's true motivation.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Charlie works to find an extremely rare comic that was stolen during a deadly robbery at a comic book convention. Wil Wheaton guest stars as Miles Sklar.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and the team come under pressure when a former FBI subcontractor shoots an agent inside the FBI headquarters and takes one of their own as a hostage, leaving them with a severely restricted plan of action.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Charlie becomes the target of physical intimidation aimed at disrupting his work on the case of a missing investigative journalist.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team work to track down a serial rapist who is using his position as a police officer to lure his victims.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and the team take down an inner-city meth lab, but it is Don's FBI instinct that leads to the arrest of a bystander who is discovered to have a greater scheme in the works.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team tracks a gang of military thieves after they kidnap family members of an ex-marine who is wanted for murder.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: A mass poisoning at a cult compound leads the FBI team into a maze of old grudges and a complex murder plot.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a rap star, the team uncovers a conspiracy of embezzlement and bribery which may be connected to his death. Meanwhile, Charlie prepares to meet Amita's parents for the first time.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and Charlie find themselves in conflict over their differing beliefs as they investigate a case involving national security. Meanwhile, Megan faces a crisis of conscience and leaves the team, on the fourth season finale.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and the team hunt down the killers of two rock climbers in possession of a stolen diamond, while Charlie decides if he should get his FBI clearance reinstated and a new agent joins the team, on the fifth season premiere.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team investigates a pattern of increased ATM kidnappings when a woman who was abducted and forced to withdraw random amounts of money from her ATM is murdered. Also, Charlie meets the man who will decide the fate of his FBI security clearance.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When eight people, including two police officers, are executed in a coffee shop, an LAPD detective gets the team on the case, and they uncover a trail of blackmail, romance and corruption. Also, McGowan's investigation of Charlie and Don deepens.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When a passenger train collides with a freight train carrying toxic chemicals, Don, Charlie and the team begin to investigate if foul play was involved.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team are called in to help a veteran FBI agent track down a con man who has eluded him for years. Also, Agent McGowan hands down his decision on Charlie's security clearance and Don's future with the FBI.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team hunts a crew stealing high-end goods from a shipping service and looks to an employee with savant-like abilities to lead them to those behind the scheme. Also, when one of Don's men is killed on duty, he questions his faith in the FBI.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: While on a date, David catches a disappearing act at a magic show but quickly becomes involved in the performance when the magician really vanishes.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When the death of a family friend is ruled an accident, Don and Charlie investigate, only to make a startling discovery.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The bombing of an influential charity's headquarters forces the team to sift through various rumors about the true reach of the organization's power.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When a vigilante group goes after a known criminal mastermind, Charlie is forced to turn to his rival for help. Also, Don wrestles with his emotions towards embracing religion.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don looks toward his newly found religious beliefs to help him contend with an escaped criminal bent on revenge.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team has only four hours to stop a group of hijackers who take a bus full of Hollywood tourists hostage.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: A feud between rival Chinese gangs leads to the kidnapping of an undercover agent and the re-appearance of the enigmatic Samuel Kraft.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team conducts an undercover sting to locate a cyber crime lord, but the operation is foiled by a charming, brilliant hacker whose desire to take over the online black markets puts him in a dangerous online turf war that could lead to murder.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: While tracking down a felon running a heroin ring inside a prison, Agent Ian Edgerton becomes a murder suspect when the informant he meets with ends up dead, sending a desperate Edgerton over the edge when he takes a member of Don's team hostage.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When robbers hit a diamond exchange and take hostages, Don and the team find an unlikely ally in convict John Buckley, who may help the team's investigation when they believe the men are copying Buckley's criminal strategies.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Blowback
programme.desc: Agent McGowan begynder sit angreb på Don, og Colby bliver en lille smule for involveret i en af de mistænkte, i en sag hvor en politibetjent er myrdet.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Jack of All Trades
programme.desc: Charlies og Dons skæbne står i stampe, mens holdet leder hele Los Angeles igennem, efter en professionel forbryder. Alan finder ud af at en af hans gamle projekter måske forsvinder med en ny byudvikling uden for byen.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Scan Man
programme.desc: Drabet på en agent sparker alle op i højere gear, men de falder ned igen, da deres hovedmistænkte viser sig at have autisme.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Magic Show
programme.desc: Charlies skepsis overfor magi blusser op, da et trick går helt galt og en tryllekunstner forsvinder, efterlader David til at samle stumperne af sit kærlighedsliv sammen.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Charlie Don't Surf
programme.desc: Faderen til en af Don og Charlies barndomsvenner, beder om Dons hjælp, da hans søn, en tidligere professionel surfer, bliver fundet død.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Thirty-six Hours
programme.desc: To tog kolliderer, et passagertog og et godstog, der transporterer giftige kemikalier. Don, Charlie og holdet kaldes til stedet for at efterforske en potentiel forbrydelse.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Conspiracy Theory
programme.desc: Hele holdet bliver en smule skøre, da samarbejdet med en konspirationsteoretiker, som skal hjælpe med løse en bombesag, eksponerer deres egne forskellige mærkværdigheder. En mystisk fremmed redder en agents liv.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Frienemies
programme.desc: Charlie og Penfield arbejder på deres samarbejdsproblemer, da Charlie er nødt til at konsultere ham i forbindelse med en sag om røveri, mord og hævn.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Arrow of Time
programme.desc: Buck Winters, der myrdede og stjal sammen med sin ældre elsker i starten af sæson 3, flygter fra fængslet og går efter Don. Don bruger sin nyfundne tro, til at guide sig igennem.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Jacked
programme.desc: Charlies evner indenfor computerhacking står sin prøve, da holdet forsøger at redde gidsler i en bus. Alan irriteres ved hans første oplevelse med tænketank-modellen.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Trouble in Chinatown
programme.desc: Bortførelsen af en undercover-agent bringer ex-CIA-agent, clairvoyante Simon Kraft, tilbage i brødrenes liv. Charlie forfølger en videnskabelig løsning og Don går efter en proceduremæssig én.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Sneakerhead
programme.desc: Holdet jagter et par specielle sneakers, der bliver ved med at forsvinde for dem, men efterlader døde og sårede i deres kølvand. Liz vejer sin forfremmelse op mod tabet af holdet i L.A. kontoret.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Holdet tager det meget personligt, da Robin Brooks taber en sag om mordet på en kilde. Morderen kan ikke sigtes to gange for samme forbrydelse, så holdet sætter gang i en efterforskning, og lade retfærdigheden ramme en international våbenhandler.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Cover Me
programme.desc: En gammel ven, der er i narkopolitiet, går med til at hjælpe Liz i en undercover operation, hvor Charlie bruger matematikken til at påvirke byens narkotrafik, men en fejlberegning og en afhængighed, sætter på Liz' liv og operation i fare.

programme.title: Numb3rs: First Law
programme.desc: Da en computer med kunstig intelligens dræber den videnskabsmand, der har skabt hende, åbnes en karrieredør for Charlie. Først må han og Amita dog finde ud af hvad der gik galt og det sætter Amitas liv i fare.

programme.title: Numb3rs: 12:01 AM
programme.desc: Charlie forhindres i at lægge matematikken oven i sit første job som basketball-træner, da en læge påstår at have beviser, der frikender en indsat på dødsgangen. Det giver kun meget kort tid til ham og holdet at sikre retfærdigheden.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Animal Rites
programme.desc: Charlie har en stærk, personlig interesse i sagen, da en professor bliver myrdet, under en demonstration for dyrerettigheder. Da først morderen er fundet, sætter Nikkis handlinger både operationen og civile liv i fare.

programme.title: Numb3rs: The Fifth Man
programme.desc: Charlie tager igen sit engagement med FBI, op til overvejelse, efter en fejlberegning sender Don på hospitalet, og hans hold leder efter årsagen til en række atypiske hjemmerøverier.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Disturbed
programme.desc: Charlie føler sig stadig skyldig for at Don blev såret, men fokuserer på at finde en skræmmende intelligent seriemorder, der er omhyggelig med at fjerne alle vidner til sine forbrydelser.

programme.title: On the Case: Broken Trust
programme.desc: When a young girl vanishes on the way home from school, her family and police are sent on a tormenting search for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: Stolen Dreams
programme.desc: John Greathouse finds his stepdaughter, Kelli Bailey, murdered in her bedroom; investigators find a video tape and a dead man's forged check and hope these clues will be the keys to bringing Bailey's cold-blooded killer to justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Twice Is No Accident
programme.desc: When Fran Smith mysteriously disappears her sister and daughter mount their own investigation... What they uncover sends police on a cross country man hunt for a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Hidden by Fire
programme.desc: When firefighters respond to a raging house fire they discover the blaze was just the cover up for a vicious murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Mixed Signals
programme.desc: Cell phone records may help solve the disturbing murder of a popular teenager.

programme.title: On the Case: Racing to Justice
programme.desc: A talented chef's abduction is the impetus for what will turn out to be a chilling homicide investigation.

programme.title: On the Case: Evil Repeats Itself
programme.desc: Beautiful teenager Mary Jayne Jones is found murdered in a desolate farmhouse while its owner is out of town.

programme.title: On the Case: Lying in Wait
programme.desc: A young mother goes out for a jog and runs into her killer. Does her teenage daughter hold the clue to solve the case?

programme.title: On the Case: A Terrible Secret
programme.desc: A bed sheet may prove to be the key to solving the murder of a 13-year-old girl who is found strangled on a riverbank.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer in Town
programme.desc: Paula Zahn examines how police raced to track down a vicious killer on his deadly cross-country journey.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder At Sunset- Part 1
programme.desc: A mother and two daughters are discovered floating in Tampa Bay after a brutal triple homicide. Police must rely on a victim who survived a similar attack to bring the killer to justice in this special two-hour On The Case.

programme.title: On the Case: A Drop of Blood
programme.desc: A single mother is murdered at work. Will a single drop of blood lead police to her killer?

programme.title: On the Case: Murder Ordained?
programme.desc: When a young minister's wife is found dead, it appears to be a tragic accident. But then, another member of the congregation is murdered. Police begin to wonder if its just a coincidence or a calculated plot.

programme.title: On the Case: The East Area Rapist
programme.desc: A sexual sadist known as the East Area Rapist terrorizes California and its law enforcement officers for decades.

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Silence
programme.desc: An 18-year-old woman never returns home after a night out with friends, and the police come up against a wall of silence that keeps them from uncovering the truth.

programme.title: On the Case: A Harvest of Grief
programme.desc: Paula Zahn examines the tragic case of a trail of blood and broken cornstalks leads police to the body of a young girl.

programme.title: On the Case: Painful Memories
programme.desc: A young marine comes home and finds his nine month pregnant wife savagely beaten in their bedroom. Was he an innocent victim or could he have been responsible for the terrible crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Betrayal in Big Cottonwood Canyon
programme.desc: A young woman is ambushed and murdered in Utah's Big Cottonwood Canyon.

programme.title: On the Case: Trapped by Lies
programme.desc: Before police can catch a depraved killer of a 15 year old girl, they must first unravel a puzzling series of lies.

programme.title: On the Case: One Month of Terror
programme.desc: After abducting a 17 year old girl in front of her home her kidnapper taunts the family with phone calls and disturbing letters. But a tiny mistake will eventually lead police to his door.

programme.desc: Det är dags för finalceremoni där ett av paren kommer stå som vinnare av Paradise 2023. För att komma dit krävs både lista och mutor – men kommer det fungera? Och den stora frågan kvarstår – hur ska prissumman på en halv miljon kronor fördelas?

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 117
programme.desc: Det er blevet tid til Paradise Personlighedsuge, og derfor er der photoshoot, hvor deltagerne skal vise deres personlighed. Men det er ikke alle, der er helt tilpas med den opgave.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 118
programme.desc: Det skal nu afgøres, hvem der får lov at kæmpe om titlen som årets Paradise Personlighed, der er nemlig ikke plads til alle i finalen

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 119
programme.desc: Det er blevet finaletid, hvor årets Paradise Personlighed skal kåret, og finalisterne skal lave en performance, der imponerer juryen for at vinde.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 120
programme.desc: En ny pige flytter ind på Paradise, og så spiller én af drengene spiller højt spil op til aftenens partnerceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 121
programme.desc: Dagen står i underholdningens tegn, når deltagerne skal finde deres bedste og mest unikke skills frem, når en ny person skal imponeres.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 122
programme.desc: Der er lagt op til den helt store festaften på Paradise, men det er ikke alle, der kan nyde festen til fulde

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 123
programme.desc: Der bliver stillet nærgående spørgsmål når Pandoras Boks åbner. Og så kommer følelserne helt udenpå tøjet, når der deles ud af nogle meget personlige oplevelser.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 124
programme.desc: Én af pigerne får en chance, der giver hende en mulighed for at få stor indflydelse på aftenens partnerceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 125
programme.desc: Deltagernes kreativitet bliver sat på prøve, når der skal males skilte og findes på slogans. Det er nemlig blevet tid til en vaskeægte Paradise-demonstration.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 126
programme.desc: Én af deltagerne får en opgave, der sætter ekstra gang i hemmelighedskræmmeriet på Paradise. Og så får Paradise endnu en ny beboer.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 127
programme.desc: Tre af deltagerne får en opgave, der involverer en tur på stranden. Her finder de noget, der kan få stor betydning for deres overlevelse på Paradise.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 128
programme.desc: Der skal reddes en masse tråde ud inden aftenens plastikceremoni, hvor to partnerskaber skal dyste mod hinanden i en livsfarlig duel.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 129
programme.desc: Deltagerne står op til en anderledes dag på Paradise. Det bliver nemlig tid til at fokusere på afslapning og indre ro.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 130
programme.desc: Til dagens Pandora bliver alle udfordret på deres usikkerheder, og det sætter gang en masse ærlige snakke.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 131
programme.desc: Paradise’ helt egen guru får en magt, hvor én person fravælges, og det falder bestemt ikke i god jord.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 132
programme.desc: Ingen kan vide sig sikre til aftenens krystalceremoni, hvor et forkert valg kan have store konsekvenser.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 133
programme.desc: Der er stor forvirring ved morgenbordet, da én af deltagerne kommer ud fra Solo. Hvad er der mon sket i løbet af natten?

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 134
programme.desc: Én af deltagerne står pludselig med et svært valg om at spille taktisk eller med hjertet – begge dele kan få store konsekvenser.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 135
programme.desc: Der skal tages en vigtig beslutning op til aftenens ceremoni. Bliver det kollektivets mening, der vinder, eller spiller folk for sig selv?

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 136
programme.desc: Finaleugen er lige rundt om hjørnet, og alle kæmper for deres plads. Men pludselig sker der noget, der gør, at situationen spidser endnu mere til.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 137
programme.desc: Indholdet af en video får afgørende betydning for én af de tilbageværende deltageres liv på Paradise.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 138
programme.desc: Hvem har gennemgået den største personlige udvikling på Paradise? Dette bliver det afgørende spørgsmål, når de resterende deltagere skal lave deres Paradise-cv.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 103
programme.desc: Tre af deltagere får muligheden for at sikre sig en stol til Partnerceremonien, men det kræver, at de har talegaverne i orden.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 104
programme.desc: Der skal kæmpes for sin sag, når den allerførste partnerceremoni finder sted. Og med de nye regler, så er alle dem, der ikke har sikret sig en stol i fare.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 105
programme.desc: Livet er fyldt af vigtige valg og dilemmaer, sådan er det også på Paradise, når deltagerne bliver udsat for alverdens fristelser. Og så flytter en ny beboer ind.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1112
programme.desc: En oväntad tvist sätter skräck i hotellets gäster. Det är viktigare än någonsin att kunna lita på sin allierade för att ta sig säker hem från veckans sista destination: parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1113
programme.desc: En häxa checkar in och visar sig vara ett bekant ansikte för en av gästerna, något som sätter käppar i hjulet för vissa deltagare. Svartsjuka, hämndlystnad men även kärlek frodas på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1114
programme.desc: Tarotkorten avgör gästernas öde och en före detta gäst återvänder från de döda. Hemligheter kommer upp till ytan och skapar osäkerhet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1115
programme.desc: Den dåliga stämningen på hotellet fortsätter och somliga har svårt att acceptera en ursäkt. Häxornas makt ökar ytterligare och två gäster får checka ut. Dessutom har det blivit dags för parceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1116
programme.desc: Dags för game show-vecka och hotellets gäster kämpar emot varandra för att ta sig vinnande ur spelet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1117
programme.desc: Revanschlystna gäster gör allt för att kamma hem vinsten när game show-veckans tävlingar fortsätter, men viljan att vinna är inte lika stark hos alla.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1118
programme.desc: Kunskap om ens partner kommer bli avgörande i veckans sista game show-tävling där vinsten kan innebära både en fördel eller en nackdel till kvällens parceremoni, beroende på vem som får den.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1119
programme.desc: Nina checkar in som kalaspingla, men det blir allt annat än kalas-stämning när Marcelo upptäcker vem det är som gömmer sig bakom fiskdammen. Hur snabbt kan man egentligen komma över någon?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1120
programme.desc: Obekväma sanningar kommer fram och skapar dålig stämning på hotellet. En gammal deltagare dyker, bokstavligen, upp och även om några blir glada så gäller det långt ifrån alla.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1121
programme.desc: Det är dags att fira två födelsedagar i paradiset, men bara en gäst kommer att bli firad med en immunitet. Två gäster kommer att få lämna hotellet innan kvällen är slut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1122
programme.desc: Gästerna har återigen hamnat i skolbänken när det blivit dags för skolvecka! Klassens nya elev checkar in och gästerna förbereder sig inför första provet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1123
programme.desc: Vargflocken håller på att splittras och ett turbulent klassråd skapar förvirring bland gästerna. Stressen över var immuniteten har hamnat skapar stort drama under festen.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1124
programme.desc: Vem som får bäst resultat på provet är helt avgörande för vem som får stanna kvar på hotellet inför kvällens parceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1125
programme.desc: En bandit härjar på hotellet och gäst efter gäst försvinner. De kvarvarande gästerna är inte helt överens om vem som får sakna vem och bråk uppstår.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1126
programme.desc: En sheriff checkar in för att ta fast banditen, men vad som är bäst för gästerna skiljer sig från person till person. Ska sheriffen lyckas med sitt uppdrag eller inte?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1127
programme.desc: Ett dilemma uppstår när en gäst vill hålla saker som hänt hemliga och en annan vill avslöja allt. Hur en gäst behandlar en annan under dagen får stor betydelse i parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel: Avsnitt 1128
programme.desc: Hotellet har förvandlats till en levande Talangshow och en av gästernas speciella relation med domaren sprider nervositet bland de andra.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 15: Avsnitt 1501
programme.desc: Tio förväntansfulla singlar checkar in på hotellet men två av dom är inga vanliga gäster, dom är i hemlighet kloner av paradisets största spelare. Redan första dygnet uppstår kärlek, svartsjuka och tillitsproblem.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 15: Avsnitt 1502
programme.desc: Trubbel har redan uppstått i paradiset och gårdagens bråk behöver redas ut. Ett välkänt ansikte, Bella Andersson, checkar in och gör tjejerna osäkra. Vems partner kommer Bella välja och vilken tjej hamnar på solo?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 15: Avsnitt 1503
programme.desc: Ytterligare ett välkänt ansikte, Jesper Bengtsson, checkar in och klonpakten är nu komplett. Det har också blivit dags för säsongens första kulceremoni, vem kommer bli först med att checka ut från hotellet?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: En gæst får chancen for at gå direkte efter en tidligere allieret, men til Parceremonien afsløres det, om angrebet backfire’r. En joker er i spil og kan vælte hele planen.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: En gammel kending vender tilbage og deler hotellet i to. Samtidig spirer kærligheden mellem flere gæster – men ikke alle følelser er gengældt, og dramaet ulmer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: En fyr får en grim overraskelse, da hotellets mest uønskede par skal findes. En skæbnesvanger beslutning truer med at splitte en af de stærkeste alliancer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Tillidsduellen tvinger gæsterne til et svært valg: følge flokken eller stå alene. Midt i kaos får én af pigerne uventet hjælp fra en overraskende kant.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: For at redde sig selv træffer en pige et valg, der skaber kaos i både spillet og hendes relationer. Pludselig er hun i stormvejr – og alle kræver svar.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Følelserne eksploderer, da en mission afsløres, og en pige må forklare sig. Samtidig ender et rivaliserende par i samme seng – og hele hotellet går amok.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Gæsterne vælger to ledere, men magten har en høj pris. Én af pigerne viser endelig, hvor hendes loyalitet ligger – og det kan ændre alt i spillet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: En pige står over for et valg, der kan koste en tæt allieret dyrt. Samtidig havner to af hotellets største rivaler i samme seng – kan de holde fingrene fra hinanden?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Angrebsceremonien tvinger finalisterne til at stå til ansvar over for juryen. Ikke alle tør være ærlige – og for én finalist brister drømmen brutalt.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Til reunion-festen med juryen spreder rygter sig om to drenges skumle planer, og helvede bryder løs. Dagen efter står én af pigerne overfor et svært valg.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: En afvisning får følelserne til at koge over ved hotellets sidste fest. Samtidig får to jury-medlemmer chancen for en finaleplads – hvis de kan tale sig til den.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Kun to finalister er sikre, og fire gæsters skæbne hænger i en tynd tråd. I Troskabstesten afsløres det, om vinderne virkelig kan stole på hinanden, når 500.000 kr. er på spil.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: 9 maskerede paradisoer checker ind på Paradise Hotel, men det bliver en anderledes start for de nye gæster, der skal nemlig finde sig en partner uden at kunne se hinanden. For hvem gemmer sig bag maskerne?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: En gammel kending checker ind på hotellet, og det gør drengene ekstra nervøse. Solo-pigen får mulighed for at få lidt kvalitetstid med to af drengene – til stor frustration for drengenes partnere.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Et par har en hed og lang nat sammen. Og så venter sæsonens første Parceremoni, hvor flere er i fare for at ryge hjem. Og der kæmpes til det sidste, for ingen vil være de første, der sendes hjem.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Dobbeltspillet er i fuld gang på hotellet efter aftenens Parceremoni, for nu skal der dannes alliancer. Og så får gæsterne sig en opvågning, de sent vil glemme, da to nye checker ind på hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Der er godt gang i festen, hvor der snaves igennem på dansegulvet. Alt ændrer sig, da en tjener kommer ind med to kister, for nu skal to piger kæmpe for ikke at komme i fare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Én af pigerne skal klare en farlig opgave, der kan få fatale konsekvenser, og her viser nogle af hendes mest betroede allierede deres sande kulør. Nu gode råd dyre, for der skal skabes nye alliancer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Pandoras Æske er åbnet, og nu skal sandheden frem. Pludselig får ét af hotellets nyeste gæster en magt, der ændrer de taktiske planer for ét af hotellets fasttømrede par.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22

programme.desc: Rancher helps a friend claim a spread he's inherited, only to get involved in his murder.

programme.title: Sam Whiskey

programme.title: The Sundowners
programme.desc: Brother is pitted against brother in this tale of fueding ranchers in the old west.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: Mountain Rhythm
programme.desc: Unscrupulous Pueblo Springs Valley resort owners wreak havoc for Frog’s Aunt Mathilda and neighboring ranchers in an effort to scare them off land recently placed for sale by the US Government.

programme.title: The Big Trees
programme.desc: A Quaker colony tries to save the giant sequoias from a timber baron.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

programme.title: Hills Of Utah
programme.desc: Gene Autry returns to the town where his father was murdered and finds a mine owner and cattleman feuding. Things get complicated when a boy dies and the mine owner comes gunning for Gene.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The Duellists
programme.desc: Keith Carradine och Harvey Keitel spelar huvudrollerna i den här dramatiska filmen om två officerare i Napoleons armé som våldsamt konfronterar varandra i en rad dueller.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Efter en eldstrid med nästan dödlig utgång, minns Marcus sin resa från föräldralös rännstensunge i Bronx till framgångsrik knarkhandlare, och hans partnerskap med en gammal fängelsekompis (Terrence Howard) i ett försök att bli framgångsrik rapartist.

programme.title: Hard Eight
programme.desc: John, en ganska misslyckad äventyrare som fastnat i Reno, har nästan slut på pengar när Sydney bjuder honom på frukost och ger honom tips om hur man tjänar pengar i casinon. Två år senare är John Sydneys partner.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1987 the New Mexico Penitentiary housed hundreds of violent offenders, rapists, killers, men the juries put behind bars to protect society. On July fourth, seven of those men escaped.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1992, a woman disappeared from her Memphis home. When the ransom went uncollected, the FBI suspected a desperate amateur and feared the worst.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Næsten 20 år efter, at TV-kultserien Galaxy Quest blev stoppet, beder en race af rumvæsner holdet fra serien om hjælp til at redde universet.

programme.title: The Rules of engagement
programme.desc: Oberst Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) er en elitesoldat med en pletfri karriere, indtil en rutineoperation i Yemen ender i en katastrofe. Demonstranter foran den amerikanske ambassade går amok og åbner ild.

programme.title: Big Kill
programme.desc: Jim Andrews tager til byen Big Kill for at slutte sig til sin bror. Undervejs møder han to mænd eftersøgt af den mexicanske hær og hyrer dem til at vejlede og beskytte ham. Når de først er der, står de ansigt til ansigt med en truende prædikant.

programme.title: Joint Security Area
programme.desc: Skud lyder i grænsezonen mellem Nord- og Sydkorea. To døde, én såret – men hvad skete der? En schweizisk efterforsker afslører en sandhed, der kan udløse en international krise.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programme.desc: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Marvels farligste dame, Elektra, blir brakt tilbake til livetetter å ha fått livstruende skader i ”Daredevil”. Menhennes nyeste oppdrag som leiemorder tvinge hennetil å ta…

programme.title: Down Terrace
programme.desc: Etter å ha sonet fengsel for en mystisk forbrytelse, slipper Bill og Karl seg ut av fengselet og blir opptatt av å finne ut hvem som leverte dem til politiet. På toppen av det, er "familiebedriften" på steinene

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: The Way Back forteller den sanne historien til syv fangers umulige plan om å flykte fra en sovjetisk fangeleir i 1941. Deres flukt til frihet tar dem på en reise gjennom verdens mest nådeløse landskap.

programme.title: Revolutionary Road
programme.desc: Basert på Richard Yates' bestselger, følger denne fengslende og gripende historien et lidenskapelig, ungt par i forstads-Connecticut som bestemmer seg for å risikere alt og følge sine drømmer.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Manuset er basert på bøkene The Snowden Files: The Inside Story of the World's Most Wanted Man av Luke Harding og Time of the Octopus av Anatoly Kucherena.

programme.title: Rough Stuff
programme.desc: En gruppe aktivister vil lage en film for å avdekke overtramp hos et stort gruveselskap, og de inngår en avtale med noen folk som lever utenfor loven, i Australias ødemark. Spenningen stiger når det viser seg at begge gruppene er på hver sin skattejakt.

programme.title: A Civil Action
programme.desc: Jan er personskadeadvokat, men tar bare store saker der han kan inngå forlik utenfor rettssalen. Selv om hans nye sak først ser enkel ut, blir han snart innblandet i en episk kamp, som han er villig til å satse karrieren sin på.

programme.title: The Arrival
programme.desc: Astronomen Zane oppdager intelligent utenomjordisk liv, men romvesenene holder på en dødelig hemmelighet og gjør hva som helst for å hindre Zane i å få vite den.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerende fortelling om basketballtrener Ken Carter, som fikk både ris og ros da han skapte overskrifter med å sette hele sitt ubeseirede lag på benken på grunn av dårlige akademiske prestasjoner.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: A crew of officers at an armored transport security firm embarks on the ultimate heist – against their own company. The seemingly foolproof plan proves useless when an unexpected witness interferes, and it quickly unravels.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
