programme.title: RWBY: Volume 5
programme.desc: The members of RWBY each have their own journey, but they share a single destination: Haven Academy.

programme.title: RWBY: Volume 6
programme.desc: RWBY is reunited and now they must begin the perilous job of escorting the Relic of Knowledge to Atlas.

programme.title: RWBY: Volume 7
programme.desc: Team RWBY are brought the Relic of Knowledge to Atlas, but the futuristic city looks can be deceiving.

programme.title: RWBY: Volume 8
programme.desc: Team RWBY's worst fears have materialized. Salem has arrived, and the timing couldn't be worse.

programme.title: RWBY: Volume 9
programme.desc: RWBY have been thrust into an unknown world known as the Ever After! But appearances are deceptive.

programme.title: World War II in HD Color
programme.desc: In 1945, Germany is crumbly on both fronts. The Western Allies cross the Rhine and take most of Germany, while the Red Army quickly advances into Berlin. After Hitler's suicide, Germany surrenders and is divided among the allied powers.

programme.title: World War II in HD Color
programme.desc: Japan continues its suicidal resistance, and invading it looks costly. After 2 atomic bombs, the Emperor intervenes and stops the War. Stalin grabs territory in East Asia. The War is over, and the Atomic Era and the Cold War start.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: The battles of the first world war were battles of attrition and trenches; the battles of the second world war were vastly different. In this episode we study tank battles, blitzkrieg, commando raids, amphibious landings, and mobile warfare in the desert.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: The second world war was conflict on an unprecedented scale. Its battles set new marks for the sheer size of forces deployed and for the power of their weapons. In this episode we study the first battle at sea, and the largest army to have ever marched.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: A war that reached every continent and touched every sort of terrain demanded every sort of strategy. In this episode we examine battles fought at sea, and in the jungle, in city streets, invasions from the air, and retreats from the land.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: Battles are almost always about territory. Advancing the front line, seizing the port, the city, the oil field. The fate of nations in the war rose and fell on battles that took territory. Singapore, Monte Casino, Stalingrad...all about territory.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: Every war seized new tactics; some inspired, some desperate, all attempting to influence the course of battles. Campaigns waged against non military targets to demoralize. Suicide missions launched when traditional weapons failed. Rules were rewritten.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: A world war is a patchwork of actions. Land. Sea. Air. Massive, or small scale. The stories of these actions, are just as varied. This episode describes battles of amphibious forces, climate, geography, and the problems of supply.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: Through history, armies marched to face each other on favored ground and clashed to decide a campaign, a war, an empire. With the 20th century that changed. The battles of the WWII happened anywhere and everywhere, in every weather and climate.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won and Lost
programme.desc: Some words transcend their origins as humble place names. They are carved into history as turning points which influenced the course of WWII, the fate of nations, and the make-up of our world. El Alameine, Okinawa, and Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: 1917 - The Real Story
programme.desc: Documentary of the True Story behind the International Blockbuster Film \\"1917\\" . Insight into the story behind the film. The real-life characters and what became of them.

programme.title: All Quiet On The Western Front - The True story
programme.desc: Discover the riveting true events of World War II that inspired the gripping Netflix TV series. Delve into the historical backdrop and real-life experiences that shaped the narrative, offering a fascinating glimpse into the origins of this acclaimed show.

programme.title: Allied Commanders of WWII
programme.desc: Heroism was not unique to US commanders, these generals battled the Nazis on all fronts. A look at Bernard Law Montgomery, Georgi Zhukov, and Sir Arthur Harris.

programme.title: Allied Commanders of WWII
programme.desc: The commanders of World War II who led on the high seas and on the homefront. Charles Nimitz, George Marshall, and Joseph Stillwell are seen in profile.

programme.title: Allied Commanders of WWII
programme.desc: From Island-hopping to thirty seconds over Tokyo, this is a look at the battles of Douglas MacArthur, Hap Arnold, and James Doolittle.

programme.title: Anzacs: In The Face Of War
programme.desc: 'ANZACS In the Face of War' presents an historical profile of Australia and new Zealand at the outbreak of war. The legacy of WWI the shared experiences and expectations of WWII.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Dunkirk (September 1, 1939)
programme.desc: To keep France free, 400,000 English soldiers have manned the battlefields. Germany's strength is too great and pushes the British to the coast town of Dunkirk.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: Fall of Poland
programme.desc: German tanks roll into Poland in September 1939.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: The Battle of Norway (Early 1940)
programme.desc: Early in the war, the Germans decide they need to guarantee access to the Norwegian port of Narvik to ensure their supplies of Swedish iron ore. The British, however, send destroyers to up-end the German plan.

programme.title: BATTLEFRONT: WWII ROAD TO VICTORY: The Bombing of England (Fall 1940)
programme.desc: After invading France, Hitler is planning to cross the Channel. His only obstacle is the Royal Air Force. Throughout the summer of 1940, both sides lose an incredible number of daring flyers.

programme.title: Smockan i luften
programme.desc: Smockan i luften börjar med att våra vänner kör dött lopp i en hysterisk stock car-tävling och måste göra upp om vem som får lägga labbarna på den läckra vinstbilen. En korvätartävling på ett tivoli blir den givna lösningen..

programme.title: Mitt namn är Nobody
programme.desc: Nobody (Terence Hill) är en revolverhjälte som är lika snabb på avtryckaren som han är rapp i käften! Hans kompanjon är Beauregard (Henry Fonda), en ärrad gammal gunfighter på jakt efter sin brors mördare.

programme.title: Även änglar äter bönor
programme.desc: Fribrottaren Charlie (Bud Spencer) och drömmaren Sonny (Giuliano Gemma) är två fattiga tuffingar i 30-talets New York som hoppas på bättre tider. De får chansen till stora pengar när de börjar arbeta för en maffiaboss.

programme.title: Skumma Polare
programme.desc: Två laglösa hjälper bybor att slåss mot ett gäng och en korrupt sheriff, som har upptäckt att det finns guld under byn. När ett gäng våldsamma brottslingar försöker ta över staden, visar det sig att hans sanna talang är att slå ner skurkar

programme.title: Rid aldrig ensam
programme.desc: Terence Hill spelar den snabbskjutande Cat med ett änglaliknande ansikte, precis hack i häl på den desperata Bill och hans folk, som just rånade ett tåg och dödade alla ombord. Hutch följer Cat när han finner att Cat kan vägleda honom till brottslingarna.

programme.title: Trinity klipper till igen
programme.desc: Västerns värsta vildhjärnor rider tillsammans igen och då blir västern verkligen vild. De är bröderna som din mamma varnade dig för. Och din doktor! Och alla begravningsbyråer! Och framförallt läkarna som måste ta hand om alla som skrattat käkarna ur led!

programme.title: Mitt namn är fortfarande Nobody
programme.desc: Terence Hill har fått miljoner svenska biobesökare att jubla! Först kom Trinity, sedan Nobody. Nu är Terence Hill tillbaka som Joe Thanks, den galnaste och snabbaste revolvermannen i vilda västern.

programme.title: Dom kallar meg Trinity - Djävulens högra hand
programme.desc: Han har en käft lika väloljad som hans revolver. Han säger att han är en fredens man - men vem vågar tro honom? Hans namn är Trinity - Djävulens högra hand.

programme.title: Fem red ut
programme.desc: Efter att ha varit i fängelse i 5 år, för ett brott han inte begått, är Bill Kiowa äntligen släppt. Han går med i en grupp beväpnade män för att jaga en ligist vid namn El Fego, mannen som är ansvarig för hans fängelse och död hans unga indiska fru.

programme.title: Mit navn er Nobody
programme.desc: I denne klassiske western er den berygtede og legendariske revolvermand Jack Beauregard (Henry Fonda) på jagt efter sin brors mordere. Han har sat sig for, at denne morderjagt skal blive afslutningen på en lang karriere.

programme.title: Jeg hedder stadig Nobody
programme.desc: Den charmerende og dovne svindler, Joe Thanks - også kaldet Nobody (Terence Hill), rejser fra by til by og optræder som en anden gøgler med mere eller mindre realistiske revolverdueller.

programme.title: Fingrene væk fra øen
programme.desc: Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er tilbage i den vildeste skattejagtskomedie. I håbet om at finde en begravet skat på en øde ø, prøver Hill at stikke af med Spencers båd, men efter et slagsmål ender de begge i vandet.

programme.title: Hjælp, jeg ser rødt
programme.desc: Morskaben begynder i Miami, da politiaspiranten Dave Speed spillet af den hysterisk morsomme Terence Hill, sendes ud til et øde sumpområde for at aflevere en bøde. Da han kommer derud, udsættes han ved et uheld for et radioaktivt stof...

programme.title: De kalder mig Trinity - Djævlens højre hånd
programme.desc: Den seje dusørjæger Trinity (Terence Hill) beslutter at besøge sin halvbror Bambino (Bud Spencer), der ernærer sig som hestetyv og plattenslager.

programme.title: Jeg hedder stadig Trinity
programme.desc: Verdens populæreste spaghettihelte, Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er denne gang meget mod deres vilje kommet til at optræde som tapre mænd.

programme.title: Vi holder med flodhestene
programme.desc: Som altid er de to brødre konstant på kant, men en ting kan få dem til at finde sammen igen. Hvis der er andre, der skal have nogle øretæver og det sker tit. Denne gang er de taget til Afrika, hvor de lever af at tage skydegale turister på safari.

programme.title: Gi' den hele armen
programme.desc: Trinity brødrene, som vi har vredet os af grin over som western helte, skal her opleves som luftens cowboys. Luften over Sydamerika er blevet temmelig usikker. De to helte skal sørge for at få gamle højt forsikrede flyvemaskiner til at styrte ned.

programme.title: Buddy gi'r en håndfuld øretæver
programme.desc: Trinity-seriestjernen Bud Spencer vender tilbage til det vilde vesten i komedien om fupmageren, Buddy, der forveksles med en læge, efter at hans ven, Cocoa utilsigtet stjæler en kuffert med kirurgiske instrumenter.

programme.title: Lige eller ulige
programme.desc: Halvbrødrene Johnny (Terence Hill) og Charlie (Bud Spencer) sendes på en hemmelig mission for at afsløre bagmændende bag gangstervældet, der har bredt sig i Floridas sports og spille miljø.

programme.title: Mit navn er Nobody
programme.desc: En ordentlig spagetti-western signert Sergio Leone. Den beinharde, men slitne sheriffen (Henry Fonda) og hans beundrer og hjelper, den lynraske og frekke Nobody (Terence Hill) rydder opp.

programme.title: Mitt navn er fortsatt Nobody
programme.desc: Den sjarmerende og dovne svindler og revolversvinger Joe Thanks - også kaldt "Nobody" - reiser som en annen gjøgler fra by til by og opptrer i mer eller mindre realistiske revolverdueller.

programme.title: To helskrudde agenter
programme.desc: Rosco lurer fengselsfuglen Doug til å banke opp noen trailersjåfører som har presset ham av veien. I desperasjon tar de flyet på Miami, men nå tror alle at de er CIA-agenter.

programme.title: Vi holder med flodhestene
programme.desc: En av Terence Hill og Bud Spencers aller største suksesser – og det sier ikke lite.

programme.title: Gi' den hele armen
programme.desc: Radarparet Bud Spencer og Terrence Hill har forlatt Ville vesten for et mer moderne miljø. Pilotene Plata og Salud har en jobb utenom det vanlige - ett av oppdragene slår feil og de krasjer i Amazonas' jungel, midt blant råbarkede diamant-tyver.

programme.title: Vestens hardeste neve
programme.desc: I en liten, nedslitt prærieby har Colorada Slim og ganden han overtatt kontrollen. Buddy og indianervennen Cocoa besøker byen, og dessverre for Slim og banden han forstyrrer de Buddy - mens han spiser. Og det kan gjøre Buddy sint - meget sint!

programme.title: Sammen er vi kaos
programme.desc: I Miami begår politiet en utrolig brøler ved å ansette Wilbur Walsh (Spencer) og Matt Kirby (Hill) som patruljerende politiassistenter. Deres utradisjonelle arbeidsmetoder vekker begeistring, selv om de gang på gang prøver å bli kastet ut.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Bud Spencer er Banana Joe, en vennlig kjempe av en banandyrker som bor i en liten Søramerikansk by. Det går livet sin vante gang helt til et stort selskap vil ta over bananplantasjen og sette Joe i fengsel.

programme.title: Skurker og banditter
programme.desc: Tony Roma er tidenes sleipeste gigolo, en skøyer som tar det meste på sparket, spesialisert på å rappe rike husmødres diamanter. Til slutt kobles den hemmelige politimannen Parker inn for endelig å få fakket gigoloen.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape bor i den amerikanska småstadshålan Endora tillsammans med sin familj. Han tyngs av vetskapen att han aldrig lär komma från hems, men en dag kommer strandsatta Becky till staden, och hon får Gilbert att tänka på ett och annat.

programme.title: Domaren
programme.desc: Hovrättsdomaren Fiona försöker rädda livet på den svårt sjuke sjuttonåringen Adam. Hans föräldrar vägrar honom en livsviktig blodtransfusion på grund av sin religiösa övertygelse. Lagen ger Fiona rätt att gå mot deras vilja, men vad vill Adam själv?

programme.title: A Bronx Tale
programme.desc: 9-årige Calogero bor i ett italienskt kvarter i Bronx. En dag bevittnar han ett mord som begås av den lokale maffiabossen Sonny. Calogero väljer att inte tjalla på Sonny, och som tack blir Sonny hans extrapappa. Calogeros hederlige far kan dock inte...

programme.title: Like Crazy
programme.desc: En brittisk collegestudent faller för en amerikansk student. De måste sedan skiljas åt när USA förbjuder henne att vara i landet efter att visumet har passerat.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: År 1941. Under en snöstorm lyckas sju fångar fly från ett av de fruktade sovjetiska arbetslägren i Gulag där de suttit inspärrade under Stalins terrorvälde.

programme.title: The F**K-It List
programme.desc: En ambitiös sistaårselev på high school får se sitt liv sprängt i bitar efter ett spratt. Nu tänker han ta sig an en lista över saker han velat göra annorlunda.

programme.title: Powder Blue
programme.desc: I Los Angeles skuggsida – långt ifrån neonljus och berömmelse – kämpar fyra separata människor en kamp mot ett ensamt och tröstlöst liv.

programme.title: Patrick
programme.desc: Sarah Francis är en ung kvinna vars liv är lite rörigt. Det sista hon behöver är någon annan att ta hand om. Ändå har hennes farmor låtit henne ärva en mycket bortskämd hund, Patrick – hennes mops. Säkert hade hon en tanke bakom det?

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: I 1900-tallets Paris presses Colette af sin mand til at skrive bøger i hans navn. Da bøgerne bliver en succes, forråder han hende, og hun må kæmpe for at få en stemme i en mandsdomineret forfatterverden samt den anerkendelse, som hun fortjener.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Baseret på den sande historie om fire udenforstående, der så, hvad de store banker, medierne og regeringen nægtede at se, det globale økonomiske kollaps.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: New York, 1921. Den polske kvinde Ewa sejler til Amerika i jagten på et nyt liv. Her møder hun den charmerende, men ondskabsfulde mand Bruno, der presser hende ud i prostitution. Men tryllekunstneren Orlando kan blive hendes håb og redning fra Bruno.

programme.title: The Truth Matters
programme.desc: Efter den 11. september 2001 invaderer Præsident Bush Irak for at fjerne Saddam Hussein. Mange accepterer dette, men et hold journalister graver dybere og afslører, hvordan magtmisbrug indledte den længste og dyreste krig i amerikansk historie.

programme.title: Alle ved det
programme.desc: Oscar-vinderne Penélope Cruz og Javier Bardem spiller hovedrollerne i dobbelt-Oscar-vinder Asghar Farhadis intense drama, der udspiller sig i en idyllisk landsby lidt uden for Madrid. Her samles familiemedlemmer fra nær og fjern til stor fest.

programme.title: Certified Copy
programme.desc: En kvinde og en forfatter udforsker identitet og kærlighed i Toscana. Romantik med Juliette Binoche.

programme.title: The Lunchbox
programme.desc: I Mumbai bringer en frokostlevering to skæbner sammen: Enkemanden, Saajan, modtager ved en fejl den frokost som husmoderen, Ila, har tilberedt til sin mand. Måltidet bliver starten på en brevudveksling i madkassen om passion, længsel og fremtidshåb.

programme.title: The Bookshop
programme.desc: Vi møter den unge enken Florence Green (Emily Mortimer) som vil åpne en bokhandel i en liten by i Øst-England på slutten av 50-tallet. Hun møter overraskende nok høflig men hensynsløs lokal opposisjon mot bokhandelen.

programme.title: Rett Vest
programme.desc: Georg Margrethe får et mentalt sammenbrudd etter konens bortgang. For å komme seg vekk fra elendigheten bestemmer de seg for å reise over fjellet til øya Ona, for å representere sin nylig avdøde kone i norgesmesterskapet i quilting.

programme.title: 10 Things we should do before we break up
programme.desc: Den kvelden da Abigail, enslig mor til to små barn, møter Ben på en bar, lager de på fleip en liste over ting å gjøre før et tenkt brudd, enda de godt vet at de aldri kommer til å innlede noe forhold engang.

programme.title: Jackie
programme.desc: Jackie' er et portrett av et av de viktigste og mest tragiske øyeblikkene i amerikansk historie, sett gjennom øynene til førstedamen, den ikoniske Jacqueline Kennedy. Vi følger henne gjennom den første uken etter drapet på hennes mann.

programme.title: JFK
programme.desc: Når statsadvokat Jim Garrison (Kevin Costner) gransker rapporten om mordet på president Kennedy begynner han å mistenke at det ligger mer bak historien enn det allmennheten vet.

programme.title: God Bless America
programme.desc: Arbeidsløs, nyskilt og dødssyk, har Frank fått nok av den nedadgående spiralen Amerika har påført seg selv. Med, i hans øyne, alt å vinne, tar Frank med børsa og plaffer ned de dummeste, grusomste og mest frastøtende medlemmene av samfunnet.

programme.title: Good Kids
programme.desc: GOOD KIDS følger fire studenter fra Cape Cod, som nettopp har fullført sin videregående utdanning. De har brukt hele studietiden på å streve etter toppkarakterer.

programme.title: The Motorcycle Diaries (Diarios De Motocicleta)
programme.desc: Følg Ernesto "Che" Guevaras liv på et livsforandrende road trip gjennom Sør-Amerika.

programme.title: Dear Frankie
programme.desc: A loving mom (Emily Mortimer) hides her young son from the truth about his father by hiring a handsome stranger (Gerard Butler) to pose as the boy's dad.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain Parts Unknown
programme.desc: This unique episode looks closely at the “other” Massachusetts far away from the blue blood getaways of Nantucket or the urban sprawl of Boston that most people know so little about.

programme.desc: I en inte alls avlägsen framtid överlistar sju identiska systrar den ettbarnspolitik som råder genom att turas om att anta identiteten av en person. De lämnar lägenheten en dag var, tills den dag då en av systrarna inte kommer hem.

programme.title: P.S.
programme.desc: En nyligen skild kvinna får chansen att återuppleva sitt förflutna när hon träffar en ung man som verkar vara hennes gymnasiekärlek, som dog många år tidigare.

programme.title: Hemma i Hampstead

programme.desc: Brennan är upprörd över Adam, som berättar att han anförtrotts att hålla en hemlighet och lämnar efter att ha pratat med den personen. Mannen letar efter någon och är villig att döda vem som helst för att komma åt den personen.

programme.title: Mutant X: Hard Time
programme.desc: Teamet går under täckmantel för att undersöka oförklarliga dödsfall i ett fängelse.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Bödelns mask
programme.desc: När en modell blir vanställd i ansiktet efter att ha tagit på sig en fransk bödelmasker försöker Sydney och Nigel hitta graven för att vända förbannelsen.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Den kungliga ringen
programme.desc: När British Museum ber Sidney och Nigel att hjälpa till att leta efter en ring av kung Henrik VIII på Tudor-platser konfronteras Nigel med sin självsäkra, pestande storebror Preston Bailey.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Satt i sten
programme.desc: I ett kloster spetsar riddare Gabriel en demon som förvandlas till sten. År 2001 anländer Nigel och Sydney med ett brev från en munk, men abboten hävdar att det är en förfalskning och stänger ute dem.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Tidsfrist
programme.desc: Allan kommer till Sydney och berättar att han har 12 timmar på sig innan ett Necron-virus dödar honom om han inte levererar Tau till en utpressare som har motgiftet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dans av majflugor
programme.desc: Andromeda räddar döende människor från en drivkraft, men de förvandlas snart till zombies som styrs av en hivemind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himmelrik finns nu tre
programme.desc: Skapelsens motor kan skriva om universum enligt ägarens önskemål. Dylan, Beka och Trance måste få tag på den innan någon med mörka planer får tag på den.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saker som vi inte kan ändra på
programme.desc: Ett svart hål slår ut Dylan och skickar honom till en alternativ verklighet med fru och barn.
programme.sub-title: Saker som vi inte kan ändra på

programme.title: Andromeda: The Fair Uknown
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en av de sedan länge försvunna grundarna av Samväldet, men upptäcker att hon kan vara mer besvärlig än vad hon är värd.

programme.title: Mutant X: Once Around
programme.desc: Teamet tar över för att skydda ett av åklagarens huvudvittnen vars liv har hotats före rättegången.

programme.title: Mutant X: Den slutliga domen
programme.desc: En mystisk domstol finner Adam skyldig till att ha försökt dominera världen med sina supermutanter och dömer honom till döden, vilket skickar resten av teamet på ett uppdrag att rädda honom.

programme.title: Mutant X: Inferno
programme.desc: Teamet är på spåren av en pyromanisk mutant som orsakar kaos, medan Shalimar tvingas lägga sin rädsla för eld åt sidan för att rädda Emma.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvunget perspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan bliver arresteret for at have myrdet en diktator for 300 år siden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summen af dens dele
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver bordet af en drone fra Consensus of Parts, et mytisk mekanisk samfund. Ibegyndelsen er dronen venlig, men den forsøger at tvinge skibet til at slutte sig til Consensus.

programme.title: Mutant X: Blodbånd
programme.desc: Jesse bliver indblandet i en dødelig undercover-mission af sin fremmede far, som arbejder imod Eckhart.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ændret ego
programme.desc: En ung ny mutant fra Adams fortid dukker op og søger hævn for sin fars død.

programme.title: Mutant X: Lazarus syndrom
programme.desc: Holdet støder på en mutant, der dræber andre mutanter ved at dræne dem for energi, og som også kan komme tilbage til livet efter at være blevet dræbt.

programme.title: Mutant X: interface
programme.desc: Emma genforenes med en gammel ven, der har telecyberkræfter.

programme.title: Andromeda: Frygt og afsky i Mælkevejen
programme.desc: Gerentex er tilbage, og han kræver, at Trance og Harper hjælper ham med sin nye plan: at finde Tarn-Vedra.

programme.title: Andromeda: Djævelen tager det længste strå
programme.desc: Dylan og Rev Bem hjælper et fredeligt samfund med at stå op mod deres potentielle slavehandlere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Honningtilbuddet
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at skabe fred mellem to forskellige nietzscheanske stoltheder ved at eskortere prinsessen fra det ene sted til hendes arrangerede ægteskab med prinsen fra det andet sted.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stjernekrydsede
programme.desc: Rommies avatar bliver forelsket i det, der viser sig at være avataren af et krigsskib ved navn Gabriel. Gabriel forsøger at inficere Rommie med en virus, der sender sine planer til krigsskibet.

programme.title: Mutant X: Formodes skyldig
programme.desc: Adam bliver sat i en fælde for mord af en ny mutant med evnen til at stjæle folks hukommelse.

programme.title: Mutant X: Intet at være bange for
programme.desc: En mutant med telepatiske evner, der kan få folk til at opleve alt, hvad han vil, mentalt, formår at komme ind i Mutant X's sind.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dans på barbermaskinen
programme.desc: Da Mutant X og Genomex bliver fanget på film ved hjælp af deres kræfter, må de begge tage sig af den journalist, der planlægger at offentliggøre oplysningerne.

programme.title: Mutant X: ex markerer stedet
programme.desc: Shalimars tidligere kæreste dukker op og forsøger at genfinde et Fabergé-æg, der indeholder en mikrochip med ekstraordinære kræfter.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Livet efter døden og døden
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i Cairo, Egypten, og derefter i Amsterdam. De skal slå den rivaliserende relikviejæger Avery Ko til farao Thutmose's diamant, før den bliver skåret op og solgt.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Ætset i sten
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og Stewie Harper tager til Stockholm i Sverige for at finde kong Jann I af Norges runesten.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Irish Crown Affair
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel tager til Dublin i Irland for at finde den sidste irske konges forsvundne krone.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: En forsvindende kunst
programme.desc: Sammen med tryllekunstneren Max rejser Sydney og Nigel til Atlantic City i New Jersey på jagt efter Ungarns forsvundne og angiveligt forbandede kongelige scepter.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det er et dejligt lys
programme.desc: Beka tager Andromeda med til Tarn-Vedra, men længere tid i slipstrømmen giver bivirkninger. For at bekæmpe dem begynder Beka at tage Flash og bliver snart afhængig.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endelig er tiden kommet
programme.desc: En gammel erindring fra Andromeda aktiveres ved et uheld, hvilket sender hende på en mission og efterlader Dylan og besætningen ude af stand til at tilsidesætte kommandoen

programme.title: Andromeda: Det voksende kredsløb
programme.desc: Dylan og Rommie skal redde Tyr, Harper og Rev fra et Magog-verdenskib.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dark Star Rising
programme.desc: Teamet møter noen mennesker som prøver å bryte seg inn i et Genomex-laboratorium og oppdage at de er feraler.

programme.title: Mutant X: Whiter Shade of Pale
programme.desc: En ny mutant med usynlighetens kraft arbeider mot både Eckhart og Adam, til tross for at hun tidligere var involvert med Adam.

programme.title: Mutant X: Double Vision
programme.desc: En gammel venn av Brennan lokker ham og Emma i en felle. Emma ender opp i to separate enheter, en god og en ond.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Diamond in the Rough
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og den rivaliserende relikviejegeren Kurt Reiner prøver å finne den tapte baseballhanske til Jimmy Jonesboro.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Alle som stjeler en statue som representerer den egyptiske kattegudinnen Mafdet, blir drept. Nå er statuen forsvunnet, og Sidney og Nigel har til oppgave å hente den.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: The Book of Love
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i Milano, Italia for å søke etter Casanovas tapte kjærlighetsbok

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Myth of the Maze
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og Claudia besøker Athen, Hellas for å lete i Minotaurs labyrint etter den legendariske gylne hyssing.

programme.title: Andromeda: Musikk fra en fjern tromme
programme.desc: Tyr krasjlander Eureka Maru på en Nietzschean-planet og utvikler hukommelsestap. Han må huske hva han gjør før Nietzscheans oppdager ham og hans kasse med stjålne varer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0
programme.desc: Harper mottar kunnskapsgaven fra en døende Perseid, bare for å oppdage at Perseid ble etterlyst av en dusørjeger som nå har vendt oppmerksomheten mot Harper.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvunget perspektiv
programme.desc: Dylan blir arrestert for å ha myrdet en diktator for 300 år siden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Summen av delene
programme.desc: Andromeda styres av en drone fra Consensus of Parts, et mytisk mekanisk samfunn. Mens den først var vennlig, prøver dronen å tvinge skipet til å bli med i konsensus.

programme.title: Mutant X: Blood Ties
programme.desc: Jesse blir tauet inn i et dødelig undercover-oppdrag av sin fremmede far, som jobber mot Eckhart

programme.title: Mutant X: Altered Ego
programme.desc: En ung ny mutant fra Adams fortid dukker opp og søker hevn for farens død

programme.title: Mutant X: Lazarus Syndrome
programme.desc: Teamet møter en mutant som dreper andre mutanter ved å tappe energien og kan også komme tilbake til livet etter å ha blitt drept.

programme.title: Mutant X: Interface
programme.desc: Emma gjenforenes med en gammel venninne som har telecyber-krefter. Gjenforeningen blir imidlertid farlig når Michelle prøver å overgi Emma til GSA.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Afterlife and Death
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel er i Kairo, Egypt og deretter Amsterdam. De må slå den rivaliserende relikviejegeren Avery Ko til Farao Thutmoses diamant før den blir kuttet opp og solgt.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Etched in Stone
programme.desc: Sydney, Nigel og Stewie Harper drar til Stockholm i Sverige for å finne Runestone av kong Jann I av Norge.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Irish Crown Affair
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel drar til Dublin, Irland på jakt etter den manglende kronen til den siste kongen av Irland.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: A Vanishing Art
programme.desc: Ledsager Max tryllekunstneren, Sydney og Nigel reiser til Atlantic City, New Jersey på jakt etter Ungarns tapte og angivelig forbannede Royal Scepter.

programme.title: Andromeda: Frykt og avsky i Melkeveien
programme.desc: Gerentex er tilbake, og han krever at Trance og Harper hjelper ham med sitt nye opplegg: å finne Tarn-Vedra.

programme.desc: Dylan og Rev Bem hjelper et fredelig samfunn med å stå opp mot sine kommende slaver, men de må være forsiktige: hvis Dylan lærer dem å drepe, vil barna deres bli født og vite det.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Biocrime (REDUX)

programme.desc: During a 'sting' operation, Callie is critically wounded. The crew of the Tulip race against the clock to track down her powerful family, who may have the means to save her.

programme.desc: While exploring a debris field, the Trans-Utopian discovers a sarcophagus floating in space. Mishkin, the lone occupant, spreads an experimental mind-warping disease among the crew that empowers their alter-egos and cause dangerous conflicts.

programme.title: Salvation
programme.desc: - Grace and Darius slip off to Russia behind Harris' back in an attempt to stop a potential nuclear conflict.

programme.title: Salvation
programme.desc: - Framed for murder, Darius and Grace must try to escape from Russia, and Liam tries to convince Jillian to come back to Tanz.

programme.title: Salvation
programme.desc: - Grace narrowly escapes a deadly assassin and Darius and Liam forge unlikely alliances.

programme.title: Salvation
programme.desc: - Grace and Darius seek answers from the President and Harris discovers deadly secrets.

programme.title: Steven Spielberg Presents Taken
programme.desc: Capt. Owen Crawford (Joel Gretsch) comes up empty in his search for alienhybrid Jacob Clarke (Anton Yelchin), but his secret government project is rejuvenated after frequent abductee Jesse Keys (James Kirk) pays him a visit.

programme.title: Steven Spielberg Presents Taken
programme.desc: The sins of the father come to light when Owen Crawford's (Joel Gretsch) sons take opposite positions on their father's secret government project.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Gramma/Personal Demons/Cold Reading
programme.desc: A young boy cares for his grandmother, confronting fears to step up/A screenwriter with writer's block is haunted by unseen creatures/Actors in a radio play realize their words manifest reality.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Becoming Shiva (REDUX)
programme.desc: A Terran terrorist group protesting the ecological disasters that have plagued them detonate a bomb on the city state space station, Ring Sheppard. The crew are hired to track them down and break the ring up. More easily said than done.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: The Third Thing (REDUX)
programme.desc: The the in-brain reality TV series "The Third Thing", follow the crew of the Trans-Utopian. Marcus, is given the job of capturing a petty criminal for the show. As the "simple" mission unfolds, it becomes much deadlier than it seemed.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Torment (REDUX)
programme.desc: Percy, Travis, and crew try to rescue a man's parents caught in a cruel time-dilation trap; kidnapped years earlier into a high-speed orbit, they only age 8 months relative to their son's 50 years.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Painless (REDUX)
programme.desc: Roan, a friend of the Montana family, is killed by Anestha, a new street drug. As Travis hunts for Bliss, a narcotics ringleader, he stumbles upon a deep scam that could only happen in the 23rd century.

programme.title: Starhunter Redux: Skin Deep (REDUX)
programme.desc: Callie's reunion with old friend Lena goes awry when a rival starhunter attempts to arrest Lena for murder. Percy and Marcus leave the ship to buy an anti-matter stabilizer, but the deal goes poorly and the two find themselves stranded in Io's Syn City.

programme.title: Meteorite Men: Sahuarita, Arizona
programme.desc: A hot tip sends the guys to southern Arizona in order to investigate a possible cold find.

programme.title: Meteorite Men: Sweden
programme.desc: Geoff and Steve cross the Arctic Circle on one of their most daring expeditions yet. With the help of a Swedish meteorite-hunting family, the guys attempt to uncover ancient space rocks that were transported by glaciers during the last Ice Age.

programme.title: Meteorite Men: Buzzard Coulee & Whitecourt Crater
programme.desc: In Canada, Geoff and search for pieces of the Buzzard Coulee Meteorite. Also, the meteorite hunters receive a surprise invitation to visit the newly discovered, and highly protected, Whitecourt Crater and hunt the surrounding area.

programme.title: Meteorite Men: Pultusk, Poland
programme.desc: In this episode, Geoff and Steve travel over 6,000 miles to eastern Poland in hopes of securing a piece of one of the most famous meteorite falls in history.

programme.title: Naked Science: Anatomy Of Tornado
programme.desc: Tornados are one of the most destructive forces of the planets with winds at 300 miles an hour. They can destroy buildings and hurl cars hundreds of feet through the air.

programme.title: Naked Science: What's Wrong With Pluto
programme.desc: Naked Science investigates the violent cosmological forces that create planets and discover what it is that makes a planet a planet.

programme.title: Naked Science: Jupiter
programme.desc: By far the largest planet, 1300 times the size of Earth, it’s a world so enormous it could swallow every planet and moon in the solar system and still have room to spare.

programme.title: Naked Science: The Great Flood
programme.desc: Almost every culture on Earth tells the story of an ancient flood – details vary but the basic plot is the same - An angry God wipes out an unrepentant population.

programme.title: Naked Science: Mars
programme.desc: Mars our closest neighbor now a lifeless planet – but it may once have had water and therefore life. Naked Science investigates the red planet to learn how it was formed, how it became barren, and ask whether it ever will be possible to colonize it?

programme.title: Naked Science: Snowball Earth
programme.desc: There is a theory that scientists once dismissed as absurd - that long ago the Earth became so cold every inch of it was entombed in ice.

programme.title: Naked Science: Magnetic Earth
programme.desc: The Earth hurtles through space protected by an invisible force field, known as a magnetosphere.

programme.title: Naked Science: Super Flares - Could They Cause Mass Extinction?
programme.desc: Superflares are amongst the greatest events of the Universe. These magnetic explosions can release energy millions of times greater than atomic bombs. They produce streams of highly energetic particles which can be highly destructive to life.
programme.sub-title: Super Flares - Could They Cause Mass Extinction?

programme.title: Naked Science: Atmosphere
programme.desc: We breathe it every day, it protects us from solar radiation, controls our weather – it’s the atmosphere. Naked Science takes a trip from the earth to near space to understand how the earth’s atmosphere affects all life on the planet.

programme.title: Naked Science: Great Lakes
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are sometimes referred to as inland seas; they are the largest freshwater system in the world. Naked Science examines the early history of these amazing bodies

programme.title: Naked Science: Inside The Mind Of Stephen Hawking
programme.desc: Stephen Hawking, though suffering from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis has developed a unique understanding of the universe.
programme.sub-title: Inside The Mind Of Stephen Hawking

programme.title: Naked Science: Diamonds
programme.desc: Naked Science follows the story of a diamond from the creation of carbon inside the heart of a dying sun, through to the cutting of a diamond mine in South Africa.

programme.title: Naked Science: Venus
programme.desc: Earth has an evil twin. Venus. It is shrouded in a lethal atmosphere of carbon dioxide and acid rain. The surface temperature is hot enough to melt lead and the pressure high enough to crush a nuclear submarine.

programme.title: Naked Science: Making Mountains
programme.desc: The Rockies. Magnificent and awe-inspiring mysterious, the Rockies are one of the longest mountain ranges in the world. Naked Science investigates the geological processes that build these massive mountains.

programme.title: Naked Science: How To Destroy A Planet
programme.desc: The Earth is built to last. It is a 4,550,000,000-year-old, 5,973,600,000,000,000,000,000-tonne ball of rock and iron. It has taken more devastating asteroid hits in its lifetime than you've had hot dinners, and it still orbits happily around the sun.

programme.title: Meteorite Men

programme.title: Urban Legends: Bloody Mary

programme.title: The Possession of Hannah Grace
programme.desc: Following a failed exorcism, Megan Reed (Shay Mitchell) is working overnight at the morgue when she takes delivery of a disfigured cadaver. Soon, Megan begins to experience horrifying visions and starts to suspect that a demon may possess her body.

programme.title: Vacancy
programme.desc: A suspenseful, classic thriller, in the tradition of Alfred Hitchcock, starring Luke Wilson and Kate Beckinsale, that will keep you on the edge of your seat and your heart pounding! Rated: R

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Rosario
programme.desc: Trapped by a snowstorm with her estranged grandmother's corpse, Rosario (Emeraude Toubia) faces terrifying supernatural forces and a deadly family curse.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends have found the mysterious and fiercely powerful Book of the Dead, which releases a violent demon on a bloodthirsty quest to possess them all.

programme.title: The Ruins

programme.title: The Twilight Zone

programme.title: The Twilight Zone

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.
programme.sub-title: Five Characters in Search of an Exit

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Old Ben, who is able to transform himself into anything, tries to help a crippled little girl.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: After successfully stealing a gold shipment, a group of criminals and their scientist accomplice put themselves in suspended animation in a remote desert cave. When they awaken decades later, complications ensue when their truck is destroyed.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A man considers several possibilities when offered one wish by a genie.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Jeff Myrtlebank comes back to life at his own funeral and soon begins to act very strangely...
programme.sub-title: The Last Rites of Jeff Myrtlebank

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: When a woman investigates a clamor on the roof of her rural house, she discovers a small UFO and little aliens emerging from it. Or so it seems.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: After being shot to death, Rocky Valentine encounters the amiable white-haired Mr. Pip, who gives Rocky everything he wishes for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone

programme.sub-title: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms

programme.title: The Twilight Zone
programme.desc: The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programme.desc: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.
programme.sub-title: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.
programme.sub-title: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Overlord
programme.desc: After a careful campaign of disinformation that throws the German defenders off-guard, the Western Allies finally land on Normandy.France is liberated.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Weapons That Changed The World examines the RPG-7, renowned for its ability to take on tanks and level buildings. Host Wil Willis traces its evolution from WWII's Bazooka to modern counterparts like the AT-4 and Carl Gustav.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When a stranger arrives to marry the town spinster, two brothers who want her land try to discourage him with threats and a beating.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark finds himself in grave danger when two unscrupulous detectives searching for a man's long-lost son claim that it's Mark.

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An elderly couple moves to North Fork under an assumed name to hide the fact that they are the parents of a vicious killer. The plan backfires when the son shows up at their home.

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A condemned killer being transported by train murders a marshal and takes Mark hostage.

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: The Rifleman

programme.title: The Lone Ranger: Rustler's Hideout
programme.desc: A group of ranchers capture a notorious outlaw, sparking a child's abduction by the outlaw's gang.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: After $100,000 goes missing from the bank where he works, Daryl Tyler, a friend of Bubba's, is framed for theft and kills himself. Only his young son knows the truth that could clear his late father's name; however, for now, he won't say a word.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Althea Tibbs finds Lydia Crane, an elderly resident of a local nursing home, wandering along the railroad tracks in the early morning hours. Ms. Crane informs Chief Gillespie that a murder has taken place at the home, and she fears she is next.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: When Sgt. Lonnie Jamison picks up Jana Craven and her friends for cutting school, a simple truancy bust turns into a complicated murder case for the Sparta police involving the disappearance of Jana's mother, Colleen, and her abusive father, Frank.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Someone mysteriously leaves a baby on Lieutenant Bubba Skinner's doorstep. When the Sparta police search for the mother, they uncover a car submerged in a lake and the dead body of the baby's mother inside, but who and where is the baby's father?

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: A conservative minister is murdered while trying to close down a traveling bordello operating near his church, but a surprising side of the man is revealed when the Sparta police investigate his death and, later, his wife's. Diane Ladd guest stars.
programme.sub-title: Home Is Where The Heart Is

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Cagney & Lacey investigate a homicide that occurred during an attempted burglary. They discover that the gun used was purchased illegally. In light of this information, Lacey also discovers that her son, Michael, has been playing with her revolver.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey investigate a series of fire-bombings in the garment district, and the trucking company that they suspect is behind them. Meanwhile, Harvey Lacey switches occupations and becomes a tax-shelter salesman.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey investigate a larceny case after a stray bullet offers a new development in 32,000 petty theft cases. A singular credit department employee appears to be behind it all. Meanwhile, Dory McKenna proposes to Cagney.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Cagney is requested by Capt. Hennessey to partner with him in the investigation of the murder of a foreign diplomat while Lacey is on desk duty. Everything becomes complicated when Cagney becomes a victim of sexual harassment by Capt. Hennessey.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Cagney witnesses a stabbing and apprehends a vicious criminal. But when the victim is found murdered, she becomes the only witness to hold the killer responsible. The killer, who has a history of making people disappear, begins to stalk Cagney.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: After an employee of the high school is a no-show for work, it is discovered her car was run off the road by the driver of a semi-truck, resulting in her death. Later, the prime suspect, her ex-husband, is also murdered. Who wanted them both dead?

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: After her involvement in a crime committed in Philadelphia, Regina, an old friend of Althea's runs to Sparta. She stays with Althea and sparks fly with Officer Sweet, but her past catches up when a dead body is found, and it's connected to her.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Tibbs is convinced that the right man is in custody for the recent murder in the Bottoms of a cab driver. The initial evidence points to his suspect, but Gillespie has his doubts and asks Tibbs to consider that race may be a factor in his choice.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Sparta Councilperson Harriet DeLong’s sister, Natalie, is found murdered, and Chief Gillespie has a suspect in mind, but it happens to be the most powerful man in town, so he’s keeping it quiet as he builds a case, much to the frustration of Tibbs.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Harriet DeLong is determined to bring her sister Natalie's killer to justice and decides to try handling things on her own. Meanwhile, the murder of Jay Turkus causes Gillespie and Tibbs to concentrate on V.J. Trundel and his devious staff.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey search for a young boy whose mother fears is missing. The detectives, however, suspect the child is working as a runner for a drug dealer. Lacey is reluctant to go to the doctor after she fears she might have breast cancer.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: After finally visiting the doctors, Lacey receives the news that she must have a mastectomy, forcing her to face her own mortality and what that could mean for her family. Meanwhile, members of the 14th precinct are preparing for the Sergeant's exam.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey
programme.desc: While Lacey recovers from her surgery, she realizes that there may be more to life and wonders if she should retire from the police force. Meanwhile, Cagney is upset when her yellow Corvette is stolen with a piece of graffiti as the clue.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Secret Girlfriend
programme.desc: Dangle and the gang solve Reno's biggest mystery: who is Garcia's new girlfriend?

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Son
programme.desc: While Dangle spends time with a beautiful young man who might be his son, the other deputies enjoy the new department Humvee.

programme.title: RENO 911!: CSI: Reno
programme.desc: The deputies work as security guards when "CSI: Miami" comes to Reno, and Wiegel and Dangle get a homeless man into a bathtub.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Naked Stake-Out
programme.desc: After a drug sting goes wrong, Dangle and Junior race back to the station on foot -- and naked.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel and Craig Get Married
programme.desc: Good news and bad news for Wiegel: her boyfriend proposed, but he's going to be executed for multiple murders.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's Pregnant
programme.desc: Did Dangle and Garcia freeze to death? Did Wiegel's serial killer husband get lethally injected? What is Carrot Top doing in Reno, and why is he so mad?

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Junior Bros.
programme.desc: While Garcia goes undercover to bust undocumented workers and the people who hire them, Junior spends his day off with his brothers.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jet Ski Blues
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department inherits a beautiful, cursed jet ski from a fallen deputy.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Rick's On It
programme.desc: Rick the Citizens' Patrolman one-ups the Sheriff's Department in investigating a crime spree, and Garcia receives a visit from an old, unpredictable friend.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Spanish Mike Comes Back
programme.desc: Spanish Mike Alvarez returns to tempt the deputies, and Jones and Garcia work security at a Ted Nugent concert.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Son of a Chechekevitch
programme.desc: The deputies vow to avenge Sheriff Chechekevitch's death, and Wiegel studies with Lamaze instructor Guy Gerricault.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Investigation Continues
programme.desc: The investigation into Sheriff Chechekevitch's murder zeroes in on his ex-wife, and Williams and Wiegel attend a Lamaze class.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Corporate Sponsor
programme.desc: Hotty's Restaurants sponsors the Reno Sheriff's Department, and the gang gets burned by the deal.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Christian Karaoke Singles' Mixer
programme.desc: Clemmy scandalizes Kimball's Christian singles karaoke club, and Dangle takes bets on the origins of Wiegel's baby.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Proposition C
programme.desc: As Williams and Wiegel consider tampering with the vote for deputies' raises, Jones and Garcia tangle with a drug dealer who may be a D.E.A. agent.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Reno Mounties
programme.desc: Jones and Garcia discover that not just anyone can dispense justice from horseback.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters of the Night
programme.desc: Los cazadores de África salen de sus escondites por la noche. Dormían la mayor parte del día para evitar el calor. Están equipados con supersentidos que les permiten encontrar a sus presas en completa oscuridad mientras permanecen invisibles.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: Para ganar un desafío, un acaudalado hombre de negocios se hace pasar por camarero para una velada en un club, pero para ganar la apuesta tendrá que apaciguar a los asistentes a la fiesta y ganar fastuosas propinas.

programme.title: Falling
programme.desc: John Petersen vive con Eric y su hija adoptiva en el sur de California. La familia recibe al conservador padre de John en casa antes de jubilarse, pero este empieza a dar signos de estar perdiendo la cordura.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Mientras investiga una inminente guerra entre la mafia y los Yakuza, Nick Davis, un agente secreto del FBI, se infiltra en la familia yakuza Tendo y acaba envuelto en una lucha entre mafias y agentes del FBI.

programme.title: Crímenes del futuro
programme.desc: Los humanos están mutando y el dolor prácticamente ha desaparecido. En este nuevo mundo, dos artistas performativos han hecho de las operaciones un exitoso y lucrativo arte.

programme.title: La celda
programme.desc: Paco vive con su mujer Elena en una celda custodiada por dos inquietantes cuidadores, que pretenden conseguir una cesión de poderes para hacerse con el control de su bodega.

programme.title: Las seductoras
programme.desc: Max y su hija Page son dos timadoras profesionales que utilizan sus dotes de seducción para estafar a millonarios, pero cuando intentan engañar a un magnate del tabaco la cosa sale mal porque una de ellas se enamora.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Once cortometrajes de diferentes directores muestran que en Nueva York, el amor está en todas partes. Las historias se desarrollan en barrios específicos de la ciudad, pintando un retrato de lo que es la vida en esta metrópoli tan emblemática.

programme.title: Feriados
programme.desc: Un mosaico de historias se conectan unas con otras en el lapso de un año. Cada historia particular encierra un conflicto, en el cual se conocen las distintas facetas de cada protagonista.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Un chef se derrumba tras la muerte de su mujer, pero decide poner su vida en orden convirtiendo un pub de country en un restaurante gourmet. Sus grandes esfuerzos atraen la atención de una crítica gastronómica de la que terminará enamorándose.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa por correo intenta equilibrar su vida amorosa entre su marido rico y amoral, y su desaliñado pero encantador amante.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: “Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to connect with the spirit of 53-year-old, Cynthia Greenwood-Smith, to unravel the lies and discover the grim truth surrounding her disappearance from her Gold Coast home in 2001.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Taken Out
programme.desc: Was Donovan Reidy deliberately run down and left to die? In 1995, 23-year-old Donovan Reidy was at a party when he got into a fight. A short while later, his bloodied body was found on the side of a major New Zealand highway.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: In Too Deep
programme.desc: In 1999, Kiwi engineer Aaron Hopa and his English colleague Robert Glazzard were murdered on board a survey ship in the Persian Gulf in.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Fallen Angel
programme.desc: In this episode of Sensing Murder we learn about the murder of Angela Blackmoore, a 21 year old woman with a 2 year old child. The child was not harmed and the killer has not been found.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Into Thin Air
programme.desc: Jim Donnelly was a hard-working family man living a quiet life in suburban Auckland. For 20 years he’d worked as a scientist at the Glenbrook Steel Mill, south of Auckland. On the 21st of June 2004, he simply vanished into thin air.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: Our new team of “ Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to unmask the killer – or killers – of vivacious New Zealand hairdresser Paula Brown who was plucked from Sydney’s downtown after a night out with friends.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Stone Cold
programme.desc: In 2004, Brendan Percy was found dead of hypothermia and dehydration in a sub alpine area above Oamaru in suspicious circumstances.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: A Bump in the Night
programme.desc: In 1980, six-year-old Alicia O'Reilly was raped and murdered in her bed, while her sister slept less than a metre away, and her mother sleeping across the hallway.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Out of Aces
programme.desc: Garth Doull trained to be a policeman but the lure of the race track saw him swap sides of the law to become a consummate con-man. On the 8th of September 1989, his body was found floating in Wellington harbour.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Lost Soul
programme.desc: In 1985, 25-year-old Luana 'La Verne' Williams disappeared from her Tauranga home. Eight years later her disappearance was upgraged to a murder enquiry. Her body has never been found.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Walk of Innocence
programme.desc: In 1970, eighteen-year-old Olive Waiker disappeared as she walked across Rotorua to babysit her nieces and nephews. Her semi-naked body was found hours later in a rest area south of the city..

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Now You See Me
programme.desc: 26-year-old deaf woman Alexa Cullen vanished from her home in Manaia, on the Coromandel Peninsular in 1995. She had a history of hitch-hiking and police suspected she’d run away. But three years later, ominous rumors began circulating in the community.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Sensing Murder Insights - Special
programme.desc: Police detectives from around New Zealand reveal exciting new developments sparked by the Sensing Murder psychics in Series 1.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Girl in The Ditch
programme.desc: When 12 year old Agnes Ali'iva'a drowned in a ditch in 1992, the police initially thought her death was accidental. It was four years before public and political pressure forced police to re-investigate her death.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: “Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to connect with the spirit of murdered Christchurch scrap-metal dealer, John Reynolds, to discover his killer and reveal the truth surrounding the violent attack.

programme.title: South Park: Towelie
programme.desc: Towelie: Stan's mother buys the boys a console called The Okama Gamesphere but it is stolen whilst they are at school. To get it back they must help a talking towel take on the government! (S5, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants
programme.desc: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants: The boys send $1 to Afghan children and receive a goat back. When they try to return it an adventure ensues! First episode to air after 9/11. (S5, E09)
programme.sub-title: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants

programme.title: South Park: How To Eat With Your Butt
programme.desc: How To Eat With Your Butt: It's school photo time. Kenny decides to play a prank by wearing his parka upside down and revealing his buttocks. Cartman decides to take it a step further. (S5, E10)
programme.sub-title: How To Eat With Your Butt

programme.title: South Park: The Entity
programme.desc: The Entity: Kyle's annoying cousin arrives in town and it's not long before the boys are doing their best to get rid of him. Mr Garrison invents a slightly sexual new mode of transport. (S5, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Here Comes The Neighbourhood
programme.desc: Here Comes The Neighbourhood: Token is picked on for being rich so decides to market the town as a millionaire's playground - cue Will Smith and Snoop Dogg moving in! Class war follows! (S5, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Kenny Dies
programme.desc: Kenny Dies: When Kenny is diagnosed with a terminal illness, Stan takes it especially hard. Will Cartman's truck load of foetuses help with a cure? Or does he have other plans for them... (S5, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Butter's Very Own Episode
programme.desc: Butters' Very Own Episode: Butters' mum asks him to spy on his dad, however what he discovers leaves Mrs Stoch acting slightly unhinged. Will this be the end of our lil blonde haired buddy? (S5, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Professor Chaos (Part 1)
programme.desc: Professor Chaos (1): Butters is sacked by the boys as their replacement best friend for Kenny - the hunt for a new friend is on! Out for revenge, Butters becomes... Professor Chaos! (S6, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Simpsons Already Did It (Part 2)
programme.desc: Simpsons Already Did It (2): Professor Chaos gets distraught as he realises all of his plans have already appeared on The Simpsons! Cartman gets very excited about growing Sea People. (S6, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Red Hot Catholic Love
programme.desc: Red Hot Catholic Love: A sexual abuse scandal involving priests hits South Park and is taken all the way to the Vatican. (S6, E08)

programme.title: South Park: Free Hat
programme.desc: Free Hat: Kyle, Stan, Cartman & Tweek get angry about Steven Spielberg and George Lucas' habit of altering their films with each "re-re-re-release". They go on a mission to steal the movies.(S6, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Bebe's B**bs Destroy Society
programme.desc: Bebe's B**bs Destroy Society: Returning from school break, all the boys notice something different about Bebe... out comes the primitive man as they fight to see who'll play with her! (S6, E10)

programme.title: South Park: A Ladder to Heaven
programme.desc: A Ladder To Heaven: The boys break into the McKormick house to try and find a winning ticket. Whilst there Cartman mistakenly drinks Kenny's ashes and starts to have some strange visions... (S6, E12)

programme.title: South Park: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers
programme.desc: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers: The boys are dressed up in full 'Middle Earth' gear, and are sent on a quest by Randy to deliver a video to Butter's parents. (S6, E13)
programme.sub-title: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers

programme.title: South Park: The Death Camp of Tolerance
programme.desc: The Death Camp of Tolerance: Mr. Garrison does what he can to get fired for being gay so he can sue the school for millions of dollars. (S6, E14)

programme.title: South Park: The Biggest Douche in the...
programme.desc: The Biggest Douche in the Universe: Cartman is rushed to hospital after again being possessed by Kenny. Chef believes a TV psychic can help but Stan isn't so sure... (S6, E15)

programme.title: South Park: My Future Self n' Me
programme.desc: My Future Self 'n' Me: After meeting his failed self from the future, Stan decides to avoid drink and drugs - but why does Butters also have a good-for-nothing future self staying with him? (S6, E16)

programme.title: South Park: Red Sleigh Down
programme.desc: Red Sleigh Down: Cartman's 'naughty or nice' accountant informs him that he has been too bad to earn his Christmas gift. All aboard Mr Hankey's Poo-Choo train for a trip to the North Pole! (S6, E17)

programme.title: South Park: Freak Strike
programme.desc: Freak Strike: The boys decide to create a freak in order to win a prize on a TV show - will Butters' case of "Chinballalitis" be enough to win? And will he be discovered by the freaks union? (S6, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Den nya Terrance and Phillip-filmtrailern
programme.desc: Alla barn i South Park kan knappt bärga sig innan de får se trailern till den senaste Terrance & Phillip-filmen.

programme.title: South Park: Ät, be, muttprutta!
programme.desc: Någon spelar grabbarna ett spratt på första april, och det går inte hem.

programme.title: South Park: Kristna rockar fett
programme.desc: Cartman är fast besluten att spela in en platinaskiva med sitt nya kristna rockband Faith+1.

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reser sig
programme.desc: Mysterions hemliga identitet avslöjas. Samtidigt hånas Coon av sina Superhjältar och vill utkräva hämnd.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman hittar kärleken
programme.desc: Det flyttar in en ny flicka i South Park, och Cartman försöker att para ihop henne med en kille.

programme.title: South Park: Listan
programme.desc: Pojkarna stjäl en lista från tjejerna där de har rangordnat pojkarna efter deras utseende. Upptäckten påverkar pojkarna på olika sätt.

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporr
programme.desc: Killarna använder spelet Minecraft för att försöka att förhindra att deras föräldrar gör varandra illa.

programme.title: South Park: Coon
programme.desc: 'The Coon' föds ur soporna och tar sin plats som en ensam hämnare som bekämpar kriminaliteten i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Befria Willzyx
programme.desc: Pojkarna besöker Sea World och upptäcker en pratande val. Ovetandes om att de utsatts för ett spratt försöker de hjälpa valen att ta sig tillbaka till sitt ursprungliga hem - månen.

programme.title: South Park: Förlorarna
programme.desc: Pojkarna är trötta på att spela baseball och kokar ihop en plan som går ut på att förlora en viktig match. Randy tränar hårt för att bli den största fulla idioten på varje match.

programme.title: South Park: Terrance och Phillip: Bakom kulisserna
programme.desc: Precis som Wham har de väderspända kanadensiska superstjärnorna Terrance och Phillip gått skilda vägar på grund av kreativa meningsskiljaktigheter.

programme.title: South Park: Russin
programme.desc: Wendy dumpar Stan och han blir depprockare för att kunna leva ut sin smärta.

programme.title: South Park: Skulle skippat linbanan
programme.desc: Killarna ser fram emot farans tjusning när de ska åka linbana i Coloradobergen en dag - men det enda de riskerar är att dö av uttråkning.

programme.title: South Park: Usch, en penis!
programme.desc: Mr Garrison vill bli man igen och medan han är bort från skolan blir Cartman vikarie.

programme.title: South Park: Cupid Ye
programme.desc: Cartman är avundsjuk på vänskapen mellan Kyle och Tolkien och beslutar som att göra nåt åt saken.

programme.title: South Park: Kunglig pudding
programme.desc: Den kanadensiska prinsessan blir kidnappad under sitt bröllop, så Ike kallas till Kanada för att hjälpa till att hitta henne. Vilket monster utför ett sånt illdåd?

programme.title: South Park: Tegridy Farms Halloween Special
programme.desc: Det är Halloween och Randy hanterar sin dotters marijuanaproblem.

programme.title: South Park: Trädgårdstomtar (kalsongträdgårdstomtar)
programme.desc: Pojkarna har fått i uppdrag att skriva en uppsats. Tweek föreslår att de ska skriva om trädgårdstomtarna som besöker honom varje natt och stjäl hans kalsonger.

programme.title: South Park: Succuban
programme.desc: Cartman besöker optikern, en man som gör sig lustig över Cartmans viktproblem genom att kalla honom 'Piggy'.

programme.title: South Park: Anabola aber
programme.desc: Det är dags för Special Olympics i South Park. Cartman måste övertyga kvalificeringskommittén om att han är handikappad så att han kan slå Jimmy i det kommande evenemanget.

programme.title: South Park: Tittarkampen
