programme.desc: Peter Mullen informe ses camarades de classe que ses parents (entre autres !) regardent 'Informative Murder Porn', une émission susceptible de les inciter à s'entretuer. Les enfants décident donc de bloquer les chaines.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Depuis qu'il a appris que George Zimmerman n'était pas coupable du meurtre de Trayvon Martin, un jeune noir dans un quartier résidentiel aux Etats-Unis, Cartman est perturbé par une personne qu'il considère comme une menace pour l'humanité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Henrietta, une des gothiques de l'école, est envoyée dans un camp pour enfants en difficulté. Elle en revient transformée en emo. En l'apercevant, les autres gothiques vont paniquer et demander de l'aide aux vampires.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Monsieur Mackey annonce aux élèves de South Park que l'école est maintenant dotée d'un nouveau système informatique : "Intellilink". En essayant d'en faire une démonstration, il s'avère que celui-ci ne fonctionne pas comme prévu.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les préparatifs de la plus grosse journée de shopping de l'année ont commencé. L'hiver approche et cela ne peut signifier qu'une seule chose : la lutte pour être le premier à entrer dans le centre commercial le fameux "Vendredi noir" est lancée.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le black friday approche, les armées des clans de Cartman et Kenny vont s'affronter dans un bain de sang, l'enjeu : les nouvelles consoles de jeu vidéo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cet épisode est la bataille final entre les pro X-BOX one et PS4, les deux clans plmus que jamais divisés vont se battre jusqu'au bout pour défendre leur console préférée.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les enfants de South Park découvre Photoshop et son pouvoir d'amélioration physique. Et Wendy va tout faire pour montrer aux garçons que ce n'est pas la vérité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Afin de ne plus être obligés d'aller à l'école ou de faire quoi que ce soit, Stan, Kyle, Cartman, Kenny et Butters décident de créer leur startup en utilisant Kickstarter pour la financer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: M. Mackey agace tout le monde à propos de son régime alimentaire sans gluten. Après avoir été témoins des risques liés au gluten, les habitants changent radicalement leur comportement alimentaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dans le but d'utiliser les toilettes des filles pour échapper aux toilettes bondés des garçons, Cartman annonce qu'il est transgenre. Pendant ce temps, Randy se démène avec sa double identité de Lorde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le nouveau service de transport de Timmy destiné à recueillir des fonds pour le camp d'été lui fait beaucoup d'ennemis.

programme.desc: Cartman découvre les drônes et en profite pour filmer l'intimité des habitants de South Park. Ce qui va entraîner une paranoïa autour de l'utilisation des drônes.

programme.desc: Cartman a acheté l'Oculus Rift et les enfants ne savent plus s'ils sont dans le monde réel ou dans le monde virtuel.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Randy apprend le secret qui se cache derrière la comédie musicale, il ne peut s'empêcher d'y emmener Sharon. Andrew Lloyd-Webber et Elton John le supplient de ne pas révéler leur secret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après la visite à l'école d'un intervenant venu expliquer les affres du harcèlement, Stan décide de réaliser un clip vidéo (sous forme de lip dub) pour sensibiliser le reste du monde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy Marsh change radicalement les règles du football à l'école élémentaire de South Park. Sa nouvelle version du jeu devient le sport le plus populaire du pays.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman prend conscience de son poids et décide de conduire un scooter pour handicapé. Kyle constate que de plus en plus de personnes mènent sans honte ce genre de vie autour de lui. C'est alors que Cartman se découvre une rivale.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle pense que sa mère a une liaison avec un livreur UPS. Lorsque la méfiance du public tombe sur lui, la livraison de colis dans le quartier est menacée, et Eric Cartman achète un système de sécurité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Quand Butters sort de l'école, ses parents se rendent compte qu'il est temps de lui dire pourquoi il n'est pas comme tous les autres enfants. Il doit se rendre dans un lieu étrange pour apprendre les voies de son peuple.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: The Enterprise reaches a Federation colony where the adults have all killed themselves but the children play without care.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: When coming to a xenophobic isolationist planet, Captain Kirk and his landing party are punished for trespassing.

programme.desc: When the Enterprise brings aboard Klingon prisoners, an alien entity pits both sides against each other in an ever-escalating struggle.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: Kirk is trapped in interphase, while the Enterprise is trapped by a powerful energy web.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: After Dr. McCoy helps the leader of a planet populated by people with powerful psionic abilities, they decide to force him to stay by torturing his comrades until he submits.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: Hyper-accelerated aliens, invisible to the naked eye, take over the Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: On a planet doomed to destruction, Kirk, Spock, and McCoy become involved with two aliens who use them as laboratory animals in a bizarre series of tests on an alien empath who may be the savior of her planet.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series
programme.desc: The Enterprise must escort an alien princess to her marriage to seal an interplanetary alliance. In their journey, she becomes attracted to Kirk.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series

programme.title: Star Trek: The Original Series

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture (1979)

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Enterprises besättning ger sig ut på den ultimata resan på jakt efter Gud och kosmos mysterier, som båda tros finnas på den legendariska planeten Sha Ka Ree.

programme.title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: Da et uidentificeret objekt ødelægger de tre mægtige Klingon-krydsere vender kaptajn James T. Kirk (William Shatner) tilbage til det nyligt ombyggede U.S.S. Enterprise(tm) for at overtage kommandoen.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Det er 2200-tallet. Føderationens U.S.S. Enterprise er på en træingsopgave, og admiral James T. Kirk (William Shatner) har forsonet sig med, at inspektionen kan blive den sidste rumrejse i hans karriere. Men Khan er tilbage.

programme.title: Star Trek III: Jagten På Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirks sejr over Khan og oprettelsen af Genesis-planeten er tomme sejre. Spock er død, og McCoy bliver på uforklarlig vis drevet til vanvid. Så giver et overraskende besøg af Sarek, Spocks far, en opsigtsvækkende åbenbaring..

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Det er det 23. århundrede, og en rumvæsenmagt fordamper havene. For at redde menneskeheden må Kirk og hans besætning rejse tilbage til 1986, hvor de finder en verden fuld af Punk, Pizza og byttebusser, er vildfremmed for dem!

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Besætningen om bord på føderations stjerneskib Enterprise beordres til Nimbus III, den intergalaktiske fredsplanet. De må kun forhandle i en sag om kidnapning for blot at finde ud af, at kidnapperen er i familie med Spock.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Efter flere års krig forbereder føderationen og Klingon-imperiet en fredskonference, da et Klingon-skib næsten bliver ødelagt af et tilsyneladende angreb fra Enterprise. De to verdener ruster sig til deres endelige kamp.

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picards eneste håb for en fremtid hviler hos Nexus...og en legendarisk kaptajn fra fortiden.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact

programme.title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan

programme.title: Star Trek 3 - Jakten På Spock

programme.desc: When two hikers accidentally free the evil witch Tuatha, she feeds them to her enchanted serpent, just for not knowing where her jeweled wand is, then sends the serpent to find it.

programme.title: Charmed

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: The sisters are faced with the demon that killed their mom when it decides to start killing innocents again, twenty years after her death.

programme.title: Charmed

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: When Cupid has his magic ring of love stolen by Drazi, the demon of hate, he visits Phoebe asking her to help him. She prepares a magic potion to vanquish Drazi, but the ring saves his life.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: While in the police station with Darryl, Phoebe touches an abandoned baby called Matthew and she has a premonition of a ghost killing the Matthew's father.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: On Valentine's Day eve, three college mates of Phoebe buy a witchcraft book to cast a spell seeking dates, transforming animals in humans for twenty-four hours.

programme.title: Charmed

programme.title: Charmed

programme.title: Charmed

programme.desc: Three old ladies summon the demon of vanity Kryto and promise to resurrect him, exchanging for health, beauty, and youth for the senior trio.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Teresa Cristina y Griselda se enfrentan por el bebé de Patricia y Antonio, yéndose casi a las manos, pero interviene a tiempo Reinaldo y se lleva a su esposa. José, aprovechando que está sólo en casa, comienza a buscar el tesoro por el que volvió.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Reinaldo visita a Griselda y conoce a José. Los dos abuelos unen fuerzas para apoyar a sus hijos en esa nueva etapa. Patricia acepta mudarse con Griselda a su nueva mansión y ser vecina de su madre. Teresa Cristina se pone histérica cuando se entera.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Amalia rompe con Rafael al enterarse que es un ladrón por boca de Susana. Teresa Cristina se cuela con Ro en la nueva mansión de Griselda con un plan macabro. Griselda pone a prueba a Iris con la ayuda de José. Esther y Juan Pablo hacen el amor.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Teresa Cristina y Ro hacen colapsar los baños de la nueva mansión de Griselda. Elsa le cuenta a Griselda que todo fue un plan de su patrona. El "Marido en Alquiler" arregla el desperfecto y le devuelve un putrefacto regalito a su elegante vecina.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Constanza le cuenta a Rodrigo todo el calvario vivido en el manicomio; también le habla de su relación con Gabriela y Lucho. David se muda a casa de Francisca y Antonia enfurece. Los guardaespaldas de Verónica salvan a Gastón de un atentado.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Constanza arremete contra Aníbal y jura llevarlo ante la justicia. El senador Villegas pide perdón y se queja de su salud. Antonia y Verónica saben que la guerra está declarada. Rodrigo duda de la identidad de Dantés. David y Cecilia se reconcilian.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Constanza enfrenta a Antonia delante de todos. La acusa de beneficiarse de su encierro y del de Gabriela para apoderarse del Chamuco. Guerra encuentra una nueva aliada. Aníbal se recupera de su infarto y ya no es senador. La salud de Lucía empeora.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Irene le pide perdón a Verónica y horas más tarde recibe una carta de Gabriela donde dice: “Te perdono”. Constanza quiere demostrar que Antonia es cómplice de Aníbal Villegas. El senador tiene las cuentas congeladas. Guerra prepara una coartada.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Jimena invita a Norma a cenar en la casa de Juan, él tiene miedo de perderla. Franco recibe una oferta de trabajo de Eduvina Trueba, una viuda millonaria que hace lo imposible para seducirlo.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Gabriela piensa en el cumpleaños de Jimena, cree que es un día amargo para su hija, pero Norma y ella se divierten con Juan y Óscar. Franco se enreda al aceptar ser el secretario de Eduvina.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Jimena le cuenta a Norma sus sospechas sobre las intenciones de Óscar y Juan, luego que los escucha hablar de la fortuna Elizondo y encuentra fotos de Libia, se aterran al recordar quién era.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Hortencia, una de las vendedoras del mercado, le cuenta todo a Jimena acerca de la muerte de Libia. Franco renuncia a su empleo con Eduvina, y ella le arma un escándalo a Rosario en el bar.

programme.desc: Reinaldo visita a Griselda y conoce a José. Los dos abuelos unen fuerzas para apoyar a sus hijos en esa nueva etapa. Patricia acepta mudarse con Griselda a su nueva mansión y ser vecina de su madre. Teresa Cristina se pone histérica cuando se entera.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Amalia rompe con Rafael al enterarse que es un ladrón por boca de Susana. Teresa Cristina se cuela con Ro en la nueva mansión de Griselda con un plan macabro. Griselda pone a prueba a Iris con la ayuda de José. Esther y Juan Pablo hacen el amor.

programme.title: Marido en alquiler
programme.desc: Teresa Cristina y Ro hacen colapsar los baños de la nueva mansión de Griselda. Elsa le cuenta a Griselda que todo fue un plan de su patrona. El "Marido en Alquiler" arregla el desperfecto y le devuelve un putrefacto regalito a su elegante vecina.

programme.title: La patrona
programme.desc: Irene le pide perdón a Verónica y horas más tarde recibe una carta de Gabriela donde dice: “Te perdono”. Constanza quiere demostrar que Antonia es cómplice de Aníbal Villegas. El senador tiene las cuentas congeladas. Guerra prepara una coartada.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The final three teams race to Long Island, New York where, after five continents, 10 countries, and more than 34,000 miles, one will be crowned winner and awarded the $1 million prize.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: In a series first, 11 new teams of social media stars depart from their own homes all across the country and head for Mexico City, where they set off fireworks and dig deep at an archaeological Roadblock. .
programme.sub-title: I Should've Been a Boy Scout

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the Race travels to Colombia where Racers go mud-diving for emeralds in a volcano.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The race continues in Columbia, where claustrophobia could prevent a racer from going deep into the catacombs to retrieve their next clue.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: A romance blossoms between two racers, and teams are caught in one of the largest-ever footraces to the mat for first place.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The Race reaches new heights as teams climb 15,000 feet in the French Alps, and one team may be in jeopardy of elimination after dropping their clue down a mountain.
programme.sub-title: We're Only Doing Freaky Stuff Today

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: For the first time in THE AMAZING RACE history, teams travel to Yerevan, Armenia, where an express pass is on the line for the winner of the leg.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams travel to the country of Georgia where they learn how to make a traditional candy and go deep into the trenches at an old Georgian winery.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams travel to Dubai where they race camels and swim with sharks.
programme.sub-title: I Have a Wedgie and a Half

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: In a tight race to the mat, teams row and swim to the Pit Stop located on a boat, where the losers walk the plank and are eliminated.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Racers embark on a gut wrenching, 40-foot plunge and teams make a difficult decision when faced with a double U-turn.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The final four teams race for a spot in the finale and a high-stakes foot race to the mat will mark the end of one more team's journey.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: As the final three teams race from Shenzhen, China to Santa Barbara, Calif. for the final leg of the Race, they face a gut-wrenching leap of faith.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: In a brand new twist, all 22 Racers are complete strangers who will meet on the starting line. Before "GO," Racers will immediately compete in a challenge that will determine the order for picking a Teammate, based on nothing but first impressions.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams travel to Sao Paulo, Brazil where tensions rise between two teams when one goes back on their word.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Racers travel to Zanzibar, Tanzania where teams build and deliver desks to a local school. Also, tensions rise when teams face a blind double U-turn, and one team's Race may be in jeopardy when they misplace their passports.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: A previously played U-turn causes friction between two teams in Tanzania.

programme.desc: Gomer Pyle decides to join the Marine Corps and immediately falls afoul of his drill instructor Sergeant Carter.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Goober dismantles a car in the sheriff's office.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Barney suffers an ego blow when Gomer out-sings him for a part in the Mayberry Choir. Andy Griffith's wife, Barbara, appears in this episode as a member of the singing group.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern criminal detection methods to solve several burglaries at a filling station.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Barney and Thelma Lou have a lovers' quarrel. Andy tries to help but only succeeds in getting caught in the middle.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Aunt Bee invents a beau. When she's pressed for a name she names the butter and egg man who is married.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Otis Campbell acquires a car and threatens life and limb of Mayberry's pedestrian population.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Opie learns a lesson in friendship when he befriends a newcomer to Mayberry.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Joyce Jameson and Jean Carson appear as two fun-loving blondes who upset the sheriff's office.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Andy fears Opie has an imaginary friend when he starts telling tall tales.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Opie almost becomes $50 richer after finding a change purse.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: A beautiful prisoner threatens to crumble the security of the Mayberry jail, as both Andy and Barney fall for her charms.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show
programme.desc: Barney divides Mayberry into two hostile camps when he finds that an old assault case was never resolved.

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.title: The Andy Griffith Show

programme.desc: Barney Fife decides to dabble in real estate as a side job. He tries to get the sheriff to put his house up for sale.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, Investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror
programme.desc: Black Boxes: Little evidence is left after an airplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky. Investigators' best hope for an answer comes from the flight data recorder known as a black box.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Presumed Dead
programme.desc: What does it take to prove murder if the victim cannot be found? Investigators must go to extreme lengths to catch the killer when the victim is presumed dead.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Chemistry
programme.desc: The show examines cases of poison and deadly chemistry and shows how forensic experts are solving mysterious deaths today and from the past.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Critical Evidence
programme.desc: To the astute detective and forensic specialist, the biggest clues often hide in plain sight, and what seems trivial to some is in reality Critical Evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century
programme.desc: Forensics in the O.J. Simpson Murder Trial: Millions watched on television as the jury rendered their verdict. Orenthal James Simpson was found not guilty of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence
programme.desc: It is difficult to convict a murderer if the body can't be found. But forensic science is finding ways to do it. Devious killers can think up many was to dispose of their victim's remains, but they are often no matches for investigators.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Double Helix
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: True Crime
programme.desc: They know as much about crime as any crime fighter, or any criminal. They're the crime writers, and through their eyes we see murder most foul.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses. Lou and Lucas start disliking each other after she reveals plans to build a railroad on "worthless" land.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When a woman arrives in North Fork with symptoms of smallpox, Lucas, Lou Mallory, Doctor Burrage, and hotel occupants are quarantined in the hotel with an outlaw.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain. After Johnny leaves the saloon, Sweeney hurries to tell Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree with his character.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men until one of them shows up to challenge his story.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. Onboard is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a good friend from Lucas' past. But it's pleasure before business. Mario has been hired to kill Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The lazy Jackman brother's mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town. The family patriarch becomes marshal and deputizes his sons.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe. When some of the gunman's old outlaw friends arrive in town they propose he join them in robbing the bank.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a stranger who arrives in North Fork, the girl's older brothers accuse him of trifling with her affections and challenge him to fight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey
programme.desc: A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A World of His Own
programme.desc: A playwright makes characters come to life.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Profile in Silver/Button, Button
programme.desc: A time traveling researcher attending the assassination of John F. Kennedy impulsively changes history/An unhappy couple is given an unusual offer. Push a button on a box and someone they don't know will die, but they will get $200,000.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Passersby
programme.desc: On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Game of Pool
programme.desc: Championship pool player Fats Brown returns from the grave for one last game.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mirror
programme.desc: After a poor but ambitious Central American farm worker overthrows his country's tyrannical leader, he believes he sees assassins everywhere. A look in the mirror reveals his most dangerous enemy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Grave
programme.desc: Before he died, notorious gunslinger Pinto Sykes put a curse on hired-gun Conny Miller. Miller returns to town and is challenged to visit the grave of Sykes, despite the curse.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: There Was an Old Woman
programme.desc: A writer of children's books gives a book to a sick young fan. Later, she starts hearing the sound of children in her house.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trunk
programme.desc: A young man at a motel discovers an empty trunk that grants any wishes. He uses it for popularity, but at a party he discovers who his true friends are.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Appointment on route 17
programme.desc: After finishing a heart transplant, a man finds his personality has changed. He also discovers that he has a strange attraction to a waitress at a road diner.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Cold Equations
programme.desc: A rescue pilot on the frontiers of space is faced with unpleasant prospects when he finds an innocent stowaway on his ship.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: It's a Good Life
programme.desc: Little Anthony Fremont controls an entire town with his ability to read minds and make people do as he wishes.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Deaths-Head Revisited
programme.desc: A former Nazi SS Captain returns to the ruins of a concentration camp to reminisce and is met by one of his victims.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Midnight Sun
programme.desc: The Earth's orbit has been changed, drawing ever closer to the sun and promising imminent destruction.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Still Valley
programme.desc: Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Stranger in Possum Meadows
programme.desc: A young boy playing in a field meets an old man who is really an alien collecting specimens to bring back to his planet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Street of Shadows
programme.desc: While taking a walk in a wealthy neighborhood, an unemployed man living in a shelter experiences an unusual transformation

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Something in the Walls
programme.desc: A doctor arrives at his new job in a sanitarium. He discovers the case of a woman who is terribly frightened of things that appear on her walls.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Room 2426
programme.desc: Martin Decker is confined to a special room for acts and thoughts against the state. They want the formula for a weapon he does not want to reveal. Escape for Martin comes from the mind.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jungle
programme.desc: Alan Richards plans to build a dam in Africa on a tribe's ancestral land. The tribe's witch doctor puts a curse on him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Once Upon a Time
programme.desc: Woodrow, a janitor living in the year 1890, accidentally activates a time traveling helmet which transports him to 1962 - then promptly breaks down.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
programme.desc: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.
programme.sub-title: Five Characters in Search of an Exit

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Quality of Mercy
programme.desc: A gung-ho young soldier gets a new viewpoint on war when he inexplicably changes places with a Japanese officer trying to stop his superior from leading a charge against American forces.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mind of Simon Foster
programme.desc: In an impoverished future, Simon Foster goes to a pawnshop to sell some personal items to raise money for rent. The shop owner offers to buy some of his memories. In Simon Foster's life, what could be possibly be valuable?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Wall
programme.desc: A U.S. military experiment opens a portal to an unknown place. After sending through one team, the Army calls upon a career soldier to investigate, where he finds an idyllic planet. He has to decide whether to stay or go back to his old life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: A shy woman finds that a cat is actually a cursed "Casanova." She falls for the man but finds that her Prince Charming is actually a scoundrel.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Rendezvous in a Dark Place
programme.desc: An old woman with an obsession with death attends funerals for entertainment. One night when an injured thief breaks into her home, she lets him die and waits for Death to come and collect him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nothing in the Dark
programme.desc: A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: One More Pallbearer
programme.desc: Paul Radin has invited three people to join him in his bomb shelter.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dead Man's Shoes
programme.desc: A vagrant steps into a murdered gangster's expensive shoes and is taken over by the dead man's ghost, who vows to remain on Earth to seek revenge against his killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Hunt
programme.desc: On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Many, Many Monkeys
programme.desc: An epidemic breaks out and many people are struck blind. Something more happens, however: People have become cold and heartless toward each other

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Love Is Blind
programme.desc: A man plotting to murder his wife's lover meets a blind singer who seems to know all about his plans.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Crazy as a Soup Sandwich
programme.desc: A man sells his soul to a demon for some racing tips. After being terrified by the demon he goes for help from the criminal boss he borrowed the track money from

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Special Service
programme.desc: A man finds that his life has been on TV for the past five years

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Showdown with Rance McGrew
programme.desc: Actor Rance McGrew makes TV Westerns for a living, but he's a lousy actor and a worse cowboy. Despite that, each week he "wins" against the bad guys. Finally, the bad guys have had enough and decide to teach McGrew a lesson.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: A customer of the flower shop names Janet in his will, and she receives a vase. His nephew, Philip, an art collector, visits Janet, and Jack thinks he lied about the value of the vase and is trying to get it back.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: All work no play makes Jack an angry boy when Janet hires him to work for her and acts like a tough boss.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Furley discovers that the nice young man that Janet and Jack have fixed Terri up with is a convicted murderer.
programme.sub-title: Breaking Up is Hard to Do

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Janet's date, a newspaper writer, offers to do a column on the trio's methods of coping with inflation. The published article, however, insinuates that their living arrangement is more intimate than practical.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: When an absent-minded policeman leaves his handcuffs at the trio's apartment, Chrissy and Jack playfully slap the cuffs on each other and then discover there's no key. Guest Star(s): Heather Lowe

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: A letter to a lovelorn column convinces Chrissy and Janet that the other is having a love affair with Jack.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Janet loses her cool when the groovy guy and campus Adonis of her high school shows up for a date, and Jack and Chrissy conspire to leave them alone in the apartment.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack and Janet are shocked as evidence mounts that Chrissy seems compelled to steal, not only from them but also from the Ropers.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack, realizing he can't meet his obligations to pay his share of the rent, gets a part-time modeling job only to find out that he's expected to pose nude. Guest Star(s): Sally Kirkland

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Cheryl asks Jack to father her child, but Jack refuses. Janet thinks Cheryl wants to marry Jack because she's going to have his baby, so she talks Jack into complying with Cheryl's wishes. Guest Star(s): Joanna Kerns

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: The women in Jack's life go to a nude beach protest and run into trouble with the cops.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Roper feels convinced that his niece will be safe going out with Jack, and Jack would rather be with Janet and Chrissy celebrating Janet's birthday, until he sees the niece.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack Tripper's cooking lesson with the seductive wife of a mobster becomes dangerously spiced with hot romance.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: A tiny tyke terrorizes Jack and Chrissy with the threat of tears after Janet presses them into service as inexperienced, substitute sitters.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack defends Chrissy's honor when a man who misunderstood her friendliness shows up at the apartment and no one knows he's a cop. Guest Star(s): James Cromwell

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack pretends he's a doctor to impress his visiting grandfather, who's eager to observe Jack's hospital practice.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack snows a stunning skier named Inga into believing he's a downhill champion.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack adopts a new image and changes his career plans to please an affluent woman who'd like to marry him.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Chrissy gets a new job selling cosmetics door-to-door, and unexpectedly finds herself in Ralph Furley's winner-take-all strip poker game.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack gets a preview of the great hereafter when Larry hatches a plan to save him from his girl's murderously jealous other boyfriend.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Larry arranges a blind date for Jack - with a jewel thief who mistakes him for a fence.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Ralph Furley tries to impress his childhood rival by introducing Chrissy as his new bride.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack and Chrissy apparently do Janet a disfavor by talking her into trying for a promotion at the florist shop where she works.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack becomes caught in a dilemma when Chrissy believes he has bought her an expensive birthday present and the gift turns out to be a surprise for Roper's wife.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack has two dates, so he talks Larry into posing as him and spending the day with his unwanted date, Janet's childhood friend, who is visiting from out of town.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: A ruffled Helen Roper takes a cafeteria job to teach husband Stanley a lesson, but returns a wreck from the experience.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Janet is happy that her old friend, Randy, is dating Jack - until she discovers that Randy is married.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: After a night on the town with his old navy buddies, Jack discovers he has a tattoo on his derriere. When Jack goes to the hospital to have it removed, Janet thinks he is having a vasectomy and Furley thinks he is having a sex change.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack lies to his girlfriend in order to keep a date with his new romantic interest.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Janet invites an attractive man to the apartment, expecting that they will be alone, but to her surprise, she finds Jack and Chrissy in the bedroom.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Nosy landlord Furley misunderstands when he overhears Jack and Chrissy laughing in the bathtub.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: Jack Tripper finally meets his match when a devilish 12-year-old boy wins the girls' sympathy and moves into the apartment.

programme.title: Three's Company
programme.desc: A fault-finding efficiency expert drives Janet to quit her job at the flower shop.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.desc: Après s'être disputé avec ses frères, Raphael va prendre l'air pour évacuer sa colère.
programme.sub-title: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Fungus Monstruosus
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja découvrent d'étranges champignons dans les égoûts de New York. Ce sont des champignons mutants, qui ont avalé du mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0
programme.desc: Donatello pense avoir réparé et amélioré Tête d'Acier, mais le robot continue d'avoir des bugs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Des rats et des hommes
programme.desc: Le Roi des Rats a créé un sérum de croissance au mutagène qu'il a injecté à ses rats. Ceux-ci enlèvent des humains, destinés à devenir une armée d'hommes-rats. Casey et Irma, une amie d'April, sont kidnappés et enfermés dans des cages dans les égoûts

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Donatello teste un nouvel appareil sur April, censé mesurer ses pouvoirs psychiques. Mais par un phénomène étrange, elle se met à voir à travers les yeux d'un volatile mutant géant, mélange de lombric, d'oiseau, et de poisson.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Leonardo se fait attaquer par un daim dans la forêt, suite à quoi, il décide d'organiser une retraite pour lui et ses frères afin de se reconnecter avec Mère Nature.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent par un flash info que tout va bien à New York, mais que la ville a été mise en quarantaine. Ce message est tout sauf rassurant, et elles décident de retourner dans la grosse pomme.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues retournent dans leur ancien repaire. Elles en ramènent des souvenirs et autres objets précieux. Leonardo a récupéré le vieux portrait de famille de Maître Splinter. Quand celui-ci revoit Karaï bébé, son émotion est vive et perceptible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues poursuivent leur mission qui est de retrouver Karaï. Elles ne disposent que d'un seul indice et se séparent pour chercher dans plusieurs lieux sélectionnés par Donnie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey joue dans le laboratoire de Donnie et fabrique accidentellement du rétro-mutagène. Splinter ordonne aux quatre frères de rendre leur apparence humaine aux New-Yorkais krang-formés par les Krangs.
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, première partie

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues embarquent dans leur ballon dirigeable et partent à l'assaut de la Dimension X.
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey Jones garde une dent contre les tortues, pour ne pas avoir été du voyage dans la Dimension X. Il aura à cœur de démontrer que la ville de New York peut compter sur lui comme justicier.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder envoie Rocksteady et Bebop récupérer des produits chimiques pour mettre au point un sérum de manipulation mentale pour Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder et Stockman la mouche tiennent enfin la substance indispensable pour mettre au point leur formule de contrôle de la pensée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey et Mikey font du skate et rencontrent un nouveau mutant, Jason, qui est devenu un gecko.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Stockman mouche a rendu sa forme humaine à Karaï. Il lui enfonce un parasite dans l'oreille, qui conditionne son cerveau à obéir aux ordres de Shredder sans discuter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Leo et ses frères font une étrange rencontre, venue du futur. La jeune et belle Reinette est poursuivie par un horrible démon mutant du nom de Savanti Romero. Celui-ci veut lui subtiliser le Sceptre du Temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les quatre frères poursuivent leur voyage dans le temps et se retrouvent au Japon, dans un passé pas si lointain. Aucune trace de Reinette. Par contre, ils sont cernés par des ninjas du clan Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives ratées et une entorse au pied, les tortues réussissent à s'introduire dans le labo de Stockman la mouche et dérober un parasite du cerveau. Le but : permettre à Donnie d'inverser le processus et de sauver Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones
programme.desc: Après s'être disputé avec ses frères, Raphael va prendre l'air pour évacuer sa colère.
programme.sub-title: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Fungus Monstruosus
programme.desc: Les tortues ninja découvrent d'étranges champignons dans les égoûts de New York. Ce sont des champignons mutants, qui ont avalé du mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0
programme.desc: Donatello pense avoir réparé et amélioré Tête d'Acier, mais le robot continue d'avoir des bugs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Des rats et des hommes
programme.desc: Le Roi des Rats a créé un sérum de croissance au mutagène qu'il a injecté à ses rats. Ceux-ci enlèvent des humains, destinés à devenir une armée d'hommes-rats. Casey et Irma, une amie d'April, sont kidnappés et enfermés dans des cages dans les égoûts

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 2
programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Shredder met sa menace à exécution et fait exploser le collier de mutagène de Baxter Stockman, toujours incapable de lui fournir une armée de mutants digne de ce nom. Stockman mute en mouche et devient Stockman la mouche.
programme.sub-title: La triste mutation de Baxter Stockman

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le retour du Tritonateur
programme.desc: Raph trouve que son partenaire Casey n'est pas à la hauteur. De mystérieux justiciers éliminent les Krangs : il s'agit de Slash, l'ex-tortue Spike de Raph et du Tritonateur.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La colère de Tiger Claw
programme.desc: Shredder confie à Tiger Claw la mission de détruire les tortues. Karai doit leur tendre un piège. Elle réussit à convaincre April qu'elle est du côté des tortues.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête de pizza
programme.desc: Changement de propriétaire chez Antonio, le roi des pizzas. Le nouveau chef est un mutant, à tête de pizza. Tous les clients qui consomment ses créations sont changés en zombies, destinés à finir roulés en calzone dans l'estomac du mutant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La légende du Kuro Kabuto
programme.desc: Steranko, un obscur marchand d'armes borgne, est à la recherche d'un objet qui viendra compléter sa collection d'armures. Il s'agit du « Kuro Kabuto », le casque de Shredder.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Plan 10
programme.desc: Les Krangs testent une nouvelle machine pour envahir la Terre, qui consiste à permuter les cerveaux. Ils pourront ainsi manœuvrer les leaders terriens et parvenir à leurs fins.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le goût de la vengeance
programme.desc: Karai est enfermée dans les prisons de Shredder. Les tortues la font évader et la ramènent au repaire. Splinter lui explique l'histoire de la guerre entre le Clan des Foot et la famille Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le fantôme de Chinatown
programme.desc: Pendant qu'ils cherchent Karaï, les tortues croisent les Dragons Pourpres qui paraissent beaucoup plus forts qu'à l'accoutumée. En effet, un mystérieux esprit sorti d'une dague les a dotés de pouvoirs. L'un maîtrise la foudre ; l'autre, le tonnerre.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Voyage dans la Dimension X
programme.desc: En voulant trouver une source d'énergie pour sa Tortue Mécha, Donnie ouvre un portail vers la dimension X. Il capte alors un message de Leatherhead, qui est prisonnier des Krangs. Celui-ci l'informe que les Krangs ont perfectionné le mutagène.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 1
programme.desc: Les tortues n'ont toujours pas retrouvé Karaï. L'inquiétude atteint son paroxysme lorsque Splinter leur annonce que l'invasion des Krangs est imminente. Dans la ville, April et Irma sont poursuivies par des Footbots.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'invasion - partie 2
programme.desc: Suite du premier épisode. Léo se bat contre les acolytes de Shredder et affronte successivement les Footbots, Tiger Claw et Fishface. Puis Shredder porte le dernier coup et fendille sa carapace. Le père d'April est « krang-formé ».

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après l'invasion de New York, April, Casey et les tortues trouvent refuge dans la maison de campagne de la famille O'Neil. Trois mois ont passé et Leonardo est toujours inconscient.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Raphael organise une partie de cache-cache dans la forêt pour que Mikey et Donnie apprivoisent leur nouvel environnement. Mais ils tombent nez-à-nez avec une créature légendaire, le Big Foot.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
